sql: WITH down_ports AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, b.HOST AS host, b.VIF_TYPE AS vif_type, ia.IP_ADDRESS AS ip_address, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY ia.IP_ADDRESS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b JOIN PORTS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' ), HostCounts AS ( SELECT host, COUNT(DISTINCT ip_address) AS down_allocated_ips FROM inner_cte GROUP BY host ), AverageHostCounts AS ( SELECT AVG(down_allocated_ips) AS avg_down_allocated_ips FROM HostCounts ) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.host, i.vif_type, i.ip_address, i.window_column, hc.down_allocated_ips, (hc.down_allocated_ips - ahc.avg_down_allocated_ips) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN HostCounts hc ON i.host = hc.host CROSS JOIN AverageHostCounts ahc ), port_security_rollup AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC ), PortAdminStats AS ( SELECT p.status, CASE WHEN p.admin_state_up = 1 THEN 'Up' ELSE 'Down' END AS admin_state_label, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status, admin_state_label ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(pas.status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE pas.status END AS status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(pas.admin_state_label) = 1 AND GROUPING(pas.status) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE pas.admin_state_label END AS admin_state_label, MAX(pas.binding_count_range) AS binding_count_range, AVG(pas.binding_count_variance) AS binding_count_variance, AVG(pas.binding_count_stddev) AS binding_count_stddev FROM PortAdminStats AS pas JOIN inner_cte AS ic ON ic.status = pas.status GROUP BY pas.status, pas.admin_state_label WITH ROLLUP ) SELECT dp.port_id, dp.tenant_id, dp.host, dp.vif_type, dp.ip_address, dp.window_column, dp.down_allocated_ips, dp.deviation_from_avg, psr.status AS port_status, psr.admin_state_label, psr.binding_count_range, psr.binding_count_variance, psr.binding_count_stddev FROM down_ports dp JOIN port_security_rollup psr ON psr.status = 'DOWN';

SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, b.HOST AS host, b.VIF_TYPE AS vif_type, ia.IP_ADDRESS AS ip_address, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY ia.IP_ADDRESS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b JOIN PORTS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' ), HostCounts AS ( SELECT host, COUNT(DISTINCT ip_address) AS down_allocated_ips FROM inner_cte GROUP BY host ), AverageHostCounts AS ( SELECT AVG(down_allocated_ips) AS avg_down_allocated_ips FROM HostCounts ) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.host, i.vif_type, i.ip_address, i.window_column, hc.down_allocated_ips, (hc.down_allocated_ips - ahc.avg_down_allocated_ips) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN HostCounts hc ON i.host = hc.host CROSS JOIN AverageHostCounts ahc;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC ), PortAdminStats AS ( SELECT p.status, CASE WHEN p.admin_state_up = 1 THEN 'Up' ELSE 'Down' END AS admin_state_label, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status, admin_state_label ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(pas.status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE pas.status END AS status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(pas.admin_state_label) = 1 AND GROUPING(pas.status) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE pas.admin_state_label END AS admin_state_label, MAX(pas.binding_count_range) AS binding_count_range, AVG(pas.binding_count_variance) AS binding_count_variance, AVG(pas.binding_count_stddev) AS binding_count_stddev FROM PortAdminStats AS pas JOIN inner_cte AS ic ON ic.status = pas.status GROUP BY pas.status, pas.admin_state_label WITH ROLLUP;

question: For the port statuses that are in the top 10 by variance of STANDARD_ATTR_ID among ports with an IP allocation and a non-null standard attribute ID, and where at least one of those ports has a floating IP allocated, return the status, the STANDARD_ATTR_ID variance, the total number of distinct ports, the floating-IP flag, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of STANDARD_ATTR_ID for ports that have both a security group port binding and a port security binding, and the overall average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all statuses. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, VARIANCE(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM PORTS AS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.STATUS ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC ) SELECT i.STATUS, i.standard_attr_id_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT p2.ID) AS total_ports, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT f.ID) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_floating_ips FROM inner_cte i JOIN PORTS p2 ON p2.STATUS = i.STATUS JOIN IPALLOCATIONS ia2 ON ia2.PORT_ID = p2.ID LEFT JOIN FLOATINGIPS f ON f.FIXED_PORT_ID = p2.ID WHERE p2.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i.STATUS, i.standard_attr_id_variance ORDER BY i.standard_attr_id_variance DESC LIMIT 10 ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.status, STDDEV(p.standard_attr_id) / NULLIF(AVG(p.standard_attr_id), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM securitygroupportbindings AS sgpb JOIN ports AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN portsecuritybindings AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(p.standard_attr_id) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT inner_cte.status, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, avg_cov.avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ) AS avg_cov ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT q1.status, q1.standard_attr_id_variance, q1.total_ports, q1.has_floating_ips, q2.coefficient_of_variation, q2.avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.status = q2.status WHERE q1.has_floating_ips = 'Yes' ORDER BY q1.standard_attr_id_variance DESC;

SELECT p.status, STDDEV(p.standard_attr_id) / NULLIF(AVG(p.standard_attr_id), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM securitygroupportbindings AS sgpb JOIN ports AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN portsecuritybindings AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(p.standard_attr_id) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, VARIANCE(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM PORTS AS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.STATUS ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC ) SELECT i.STATUS, i.standard_attr_id_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT p2.ID) AS total_ports, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT f.ID) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_floating_ips FROM inner_cte i JOIN PORTS p2 ON p2.STATUS = i.STATUS JOIN IPALLOCATIONS ia2 ON ia2.PORT_ID = p2.ID LEFT JOIN FLOATINGIPS f ON f.FIXED_PORT_ID = p2.ID WHERE p2.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i.STATUS, i.standard_attr_id_variance ORDER BY i.standard_attr_id_variance DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.status, STDDEV(p.standard_attr_id) / NULLIF(AVG(p.standard_attr_id), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM securitygroupportbindings AS sgpb JOIN ports AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN portsecuritybindings AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(p.standard_attr_id) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT inner_cte.status, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, avg_cov.avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ) AS avg_cov ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For each port status whose average STANDARD_ATTR_ID (considering only ports bound with VIF type 'ovs') is greater than the overall average STANDARD_ATTR_ID across all 'ovs'-bound ports, show the port status, the minimum ADMIN_STATE_UP for that status, that status’s average STANDARD_ATTR_ID, and (from ports with port security enabled) the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of allocated IP address string length split by admin-state category (Admin Up vs Admin Down), including any SUBTOTAL and GRAND TOTAL rows produced by the rollup. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH OvsPortStatusStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' GROUP BY p.STATUS) SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, inner_cte.min_admin_state_up, inner_cte.avg_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte JOIN PORTS p ON p.STATUS = p.STATUS JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' GROUP BY p.STATUS, inner_cte.min_admin_state_up, inner_cte.avg_standard_attr_id HAVING inner_cte.avg_standard_attr_id > ( SELECT AVG(p2.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) FROM PORTS p2 JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b2 ON p2.ID = b2.PORT_ID WHERE b2.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' ) ), PortSecurityIpLenCvRollup AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.status, STDDEV(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) / NULLIF(AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM portsecuritybindings psb JOIN ports p ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON p.id = ia.port_id WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1 GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), PortStatusAdmin AS ( SELECT p.status, CASE WHEN p.admin_state_up = 1 THEN 'Admin Up' ELSE 'Admin Down' END AS admin_state, STDDEV(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) / NULLIF(AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM portsecuritybindings psb JOIN ports p ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON p.id = ia.port_id JOIN inner_cte ic ON ic.status = p.status WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1 GROUP BY p.status, admin_state HAVING AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) > 0 ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE status END AS status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(admin_state) = 1 AND GROUPING(status) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE admin_state END AS admin_state, AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM PortStatusAdmin GROUP BY status, admin_state WITH ROLLUP ) SELECT opss.port_status, opss.min_admin_state_up, opss.avg_standard_attr_id, psic.admin_state, psic.coefficient_of_variation FROM OvsPortStatusStats opss JOIN PortSecurityIpLenCvRollup psic ON psic.status = opss.port_status ORDER BY opss.avg_standard_attr_id DESC, psic.admin_state;

sub_sqls: SELECT MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' GROUP BY p.STATUS;

SELECT p.status, STDDEV(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) / NULLIF(AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM portsecuritybindings psb JOIN ports p ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON p.id = ia.port_id WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1 GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' GROUP BY p.STATUS) SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, inner_cte.min_admin_state_up, inner_cte.avg_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte JOIN PORTS p ON p.STATUS = p.STATUS JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' GROUP BY p.STATUS, inner_cte.min_admin_state_up, inner_cte.avg_standard_attr_id HAVING inner_cte.avg_standard_attr_id > ( SELECT AVG(p2.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) FROM PORTS p2 JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b2 ON p2.ID = b2.PORT_ID WHERE b2.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' );

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.status, STDDEV(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) / NULLIF(AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM portsecuritybindings psb JOIN ports p ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON p.id = ia.port_id WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1 GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), PortStatusAdmin AS ( SELECT p.status, CASE WHEN p.admin_state_up = 1 THEN 'Admin Up' ELSE 'Admin Down' END AS admin_state, STDDEV(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) / NULLIF(AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM portsecuritybindings psb JOIN ports p ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON p.id = ia.port_id JOIN inner_cte ic ON ic.status = p.status WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1 GROUP BY p.status, admin_state HAVING AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) > 0 ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE status END AS status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(admin_state) = 1 AND GROUPING(status) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE admin_state END AS admin_state, AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM PortStatusAdmin GROUP BY status, admin_state WITH ROLLUP;

question: For each tenant, return the tenant ID, the total number of administratively up ports that have at least one IP allocation, the total number of IP allocations across those ports, the total number of subnet-id rows across those allocations, and the average number of such ports per tenant across all tenants, but only for tenants whose number of distinct subnets used by DOWN-status ports is greater than the average such subnet count across all tenants. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.NAME AS port_name, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, ia.IP_ADDRESS AS ip_address, ia.SUBNET_ID AS subnet_id, AVG(p.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY p.ID ORDER BY ia.IP_ADDRESS) AS window_column FROM PORTS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' ORDER BY ia.IP_ADDRESS ), SubnetAllocations AS ( SELECT ia.subnet_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.ip_address) AS allocated_ips FROM IPALLOCATIONS ia GROUP BY ia.subnet_id ), AverageAllocations AS ( SELECT AVG(allocated_ips) AS avg_ips FROM SubnetAllocations ) SELECT i.port_id, i.port_name, i.mac_address, i.ip_address, i.subnet_id, i.window_column, sa.allocated_ips AS subnet_allocated_ips, (sa.allocated_ips - aa.avg_ips) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN SubnetAllocations sa ON i.subnet_id = sa.subnet_id CROSS JOIN AverageAllocations aa ORDER BY i.ip_address ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ) SELECT inner_cte.tenant_id AS ports_tenant_id, COUNT(inner_cte.port_id) AS total_admin_up_ports_with_ip_allocations, SUM(inner_cte.ip_allocation_count) AS total_ip_allocations, SUM(inner_cte.subnet_id_rows) AS total_subnet_id_rows, avg_ports.avg_port_count AS avg_ports_per_tenant FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count FROM ( SELECT COUNT(port_id) AS port_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY tenant_id ) AS sub ) AS avg_ports GROUP BY inner_cte.tenant_id, avg_ports.avg_port_count ), TenantDownPortSubnetCoverage AS ( SELECT p.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.subnet_id) AS down_port_subnet_count FROM PORTS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' GROUP BY p.tenant_id ) SELECT q2.ports_tenant_id AS tenant_id, q2.total_admin_up_ports_with_ip_allocations, q2.total_ip_allocations, q2.total_subnet_id_rows, q2.avg_ports_per_tenant, tdc.down_port_subnet_count FROM q2 JOIN TenantDownPortSubnetCoverage tdc ON tdc.tenant_id = q2.ports_tenant_id WHERE tdc.down_port_subnet_count > ( SELECT AVG(down_port_subnet_count) * 1.0 FROM TenantDownPortSubnetCoverage );

SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.NAME AS port_name, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, ia.IP_ADDRESS AS ip_address, ia.SUBNET_ID AS subnet_id, AVG(p.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY p.ID ORDER BY ia.IP_ADDRESS) AS window_column FROM PORTS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' ORDER BY ia.IP_ADDRESS ), SubnetAllocations AS ( SELECT ia.subnet_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.ip_address) AS allocated_ips FROM IPALLOCATIONS ia GROUP BY ia.subnet_id ), AverageAllocations AS ( SELECT AVG(allocated_ips) AS avg_ips FROM SubnetAllocations ) SELECT i.port_id, i.port_name, i.mac_address, i.ip_address, i.subnet_id, i.window_column, sa.allocated_ips AS subnet_allocated_ips, (sa.allocated_ips - aa.avg_ips) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN SubnetAllocations sa ON i.subnet_id = sa.subnet_id CROSS JOIN AverageAllocations aa ORDER BY i.ip_address;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ) SELECT inner_cte.tenant_id AS ports_tenant_id, COUNT(inner_cte.port_id) AS total_admin_up_ports_with_ip_allocations, SUM(inner_cte.ip_allocation_count) AS total_ip_allocations, SUM(inner_cte.subnet_id_rows) AS total_subnet_id_rows, avg_ports.avg_port_count AS avg_ports_per_tenant FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count FROM ( SELECT COUNT(port_id) AS port_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY tenant_id ) AS sub ) AS avg_ports GROUP BY inner_cte.tenant_id, avg_ports.avg_port_count;

question: For each IPv4 subnet (by subnet name), show the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of IP allocation pools per subnet (considering only subnets that have at least one DNS nameserver entry), the deviation of each subnet’s pool-count range from the average pool-count range, and also the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of DNS nameserver order values with its deviation from the average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across IPv4 subnets. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH pool_range_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, MAX(pool_count) - MIN(pool_count) AS pool_count_range, VARIANCE(pool_count) AS pool_count_variance, STDDEV(pool_count) AS pool_count_stddev FROM subnets AS s JOIN dnsnameservers AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN ( SELECT s2.id AS subnet_id, COUNT(*) AS pool_count FROM subnets AS s2 JOIN ipallocationpools AS p ON p.subnet_id = s2.id GROUP BY s2.id, p.id ) AS pool_stats ON pool_stats.subnet_id = s.id GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY pool_count_range DESC ), avg_ranges AS ( SELECT AVG(pool_count_range) AS avg_pool_count_range FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.pool_count_range, i.pool_count_variance, i.pool_count_stddev, (i.pool_count_range - a.avg_pool_count_range) AS deviation_from_avg_pool_count_range FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_ranges a ORDER BY i.pool_count_range DESC ), dns_order_cv AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, STDDEV(d.ORDER) / NULLIF(AVG(d.ORDER), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM subnets AS s JOIN dnsnameservers AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN ipallocationpools AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 GROUP BY s.name HAVING AVG(d.ORDER) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.coefficient_of_variation, (i.coefficient_of_variation - a.avg_coefficient_of_variation) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_cte a ORDER BY deviation_from_avg DESC ) SELECT pr.subnet_name, pr.pool_count_range, pr.pool_count_variance, pr.pool_count_stddev, pr.deviation_from_avg_pool_count_range, dc.coefficient_of_variation, dc.deviation_from_avg AS deviation_from_avg_dns_order_cv FROM pool_range_stats pr JOIN dns_order_cv dc ON dc.subnet_name = pr.subnet_name JOIN subnets s ON s.name = pr.subnet_name WHERE s.ip_version = 4 ORDER BY pr.pool_count_range DESC;

For each subnet (by subnet name), return the coefficient of variation of the DNS nameserver order values across all DNS nameservers on that subnet, considering only IPv4 subnets.

For each IPv4 subnet (by subnet name), return the coefficient of variation of the DNS nameserver order values across all DNS nameservers on that subnet, along with the deviation of that coefficient from the average coefficient of variation across all IPv4 subnets.
sub_sqls: SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, MAX(pool_count) - MIN(pool_count) AS pool_count_range, VARIANCE(pool_count) AS pool_count_variance, STDDEV(pool_count) AS pool_count_stddev FROM subnets AS s JOIN dnsnameservers AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN ( SELECT s2.id AS subnet_id, COUNT(*) AS pool_count FROM subnets AS s2 JOIN ipallocationpools AS p ON p.subnet_id = s2.id GROUP BY s2.id, p.id ) AS pool_stats ON pool_stats.subnet_id = s.id GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY pool_count_range DESC;

SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, STDDEV(d.ORDER) / NULLIF(AVG(d.ORDER), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM subnets AS s JOIN dnsnameservers AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN ipallocationpools AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 GROUP BY s.name HAVING AVG(d.ORDER) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, MAX(pool_count) - MIN(pool_count) AS pool_count_range, VARIANCE(pool_count) AS pool_count_variance, STDDEV(pool_count) AS pool_count_stddev FROM subnets AS s JOIN dnsnameservers AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN ( SELECT s2.id AS subnet_id, COUNT(*) AS pool_count FROM subnets AS s2 JOIN ipallocationpools AS p ON p.subnet_id = s2.id GROUP BY s2.id, p.id ) AS pool_stats ON pool_stats.subnet_id = s.id GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY pool_count_range DESC ), avg_ranges AS ( SELECT AVG(pool_count_range) AS avg_pool_count_range FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.pool_count_range, i.pool_count_variance, i.pool_count_stddev, (i.pool_count_range - a.avg_pool_count_range) AS deviation_from_avg_pool_count_range FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_ranges a ORDER BY i.pool_count_range DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, STDDEV(d.ORDER) / NULLIF(AVG(d.ORDER), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM subnets AS s JOIN dnsnameservers AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN ipallocationpools AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 GROUP BY s.name HAVING AVG(d.ORDER) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.coefficient_of_variation, (i.coefficient_of_variation - a.avg_coefficient_of_variation) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_cte a ORDER BY deviation_from_avg DESC;

question: For the top 10 security groups with the most DOWN ports, show the security group ID, the total number of DOWN ports, whether any of those DOWN ports belong to a tenant that has more than one DOWN port, the geometric mean of the standard attribute IDs of ports bound to that security group (considering only ports with standard attribute ID > 0), and the overall average of these per–security group geometric means across all security groups. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH down_ports_top10 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN') SELECT inner_cte.security_group_id, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.port_id) AS total_down_ports, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT t.tenant_id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_tenant_with_multiple_down_ports FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN (SELECT tenant_id FROM inner_cte GROUP BY tenant_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT port_id) > 1) AS t ON inner_cte.tenant_id = t.tenant_id GROUP BY inner_cte.security_group_id ORDER BY total_down_ports DESC LIMIT 10 ), sg_geomean AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, EXP(AVG(LN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID))) AS geometric_mean_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID > 0 GROUP BY s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY geometric_mean_standard_attr_id DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, inner_cte.geometric_mean_standard_attr_id, avg_sg.avg_geometric_mean_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_standard_attr_id) AS avg_geometric_mean_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte ) AS avg_sg ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_standard_attr_id DESC ) SELECT dpt.security_group_id, dpt.total_down_ports, dpt.has_tenant_with_multiple_down_ports, sg.geometric_mean_standard_attr_id, sg.avg_geometric_mean_standard_attr_id FROM down_ports_top10 AS dpt LEFT JOIN sg_geomean AS sg ON dpt.security_group_id = sg.security_group_id ORDER BY dpt.total_down_ports DESC;
sub_questions: For ports that are DOWN, show the port ID, tenant ID, MAC address, the security group ID from the security-group-to-port binding, and the rank of each port within its security group when ordered by port ID.

For each security group, show the security group ID and the geometric mean of the standard attribute IDs of the ports bound to that security group, considering only ports whose standard attribute ID is greater than 0.

sub_sqls: SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN';

SELECT s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, EXP(AVG(LN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID))) AS geometric_mean_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID > 0 GROUP BY s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY geometric_mean_standard_attr_id DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN') SELECT inner_cte.security_group_id, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.port_id) AS total_down_ports, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT t.tenant_id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_tenant_with_multiple_down_ports FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN (SELECT tenant_id FROM inner_cte GROUP BY tenant_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT port_id) > 1) AS t ON inner_cte.tenant_id = t.tenant_id GROUP BY inner_cte.security_group_id ORDER BY total_down_ports DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, EXP(AVG(LN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID))) AS geometric_mean_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID > 0 GROUP BY s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY geometric_mean_standard_attr_id DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, inner_cte.geometric_mean_standard_attr_id, avg_sg.avg_geometric_mean_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_standard_attr_id) AS avg_geometric_mean_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte ) AS avg_sg ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_standard_attr_id DESC;

question: For tenants that have ports on host "drive-59", list the DOWN ports that belong to security groups whose DOWN-port count is above the average across security groups, showing the port ID, tenant ID, MAC address, security group ID, the port’s rank within its security group (ordered by port ID), the security group’s DOWN-port total, the tenant’s total distinct ports on "drive-59", and whether the tenant has any ports with port security enabled. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH down_ports_sg AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN'), sg_counts AS ( SELECT security_group_id, COUNT(*) AS down_ports FROM inner_cte GROUP BY security_group_id ) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.mac_address, i.security_group_id, i.window_column, c.down_ports FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN sg_counts AS c ON i.security_group_id = c.security_group_id WHERE c.down_ports > (SELECT AVG(down_ports) FROM sg_counts)), host_drive59_tenants AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, p.TENANT_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE b.HOST = 'drive-59' ) SELECT i.TENANT_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT i.PORT_ID) AS total_ports, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT psb.PORT_ID) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_port_security_enabled FROM inner_cte AS i LEFT JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON i.PORT_ID = psb.PORT_ID GROUP BY i.TENANT_ID ORDER BY total_ports DESC) SELECT d.port_id, d.tenant_id, d.mac_address, d.security_group_id, d.window_column AS port_rank_within_security_group_by_port_id, d.down_ports AS down_ports_in_security_group, h.total_ports AS total_ports_on_drive_59_for_tenant, h.has_port_security_enabled FROM down_ports_sg AS d JOIN host_drive59_tenants AS h ON d.tenant_id = h.tenant_id;

sub_sqls: SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN';

SELECT b.PORT_ID, p.TENANT_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE b.HOST = 'drive-59';

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN'), sg_counts AS ( SELECT security_group_id, COUNT(*) AS down_ports FROM inner_cte GROUP BY security_group_id ) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.mac_address, i.security_group_id, i.window_column, c.down_ports FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN sg_counts AS c ON i.security_group_id = c.security_group_id WHERE c.down_ports > (SELECT AVG(down_ports) FROM sg_counts);

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, p.TENANT_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE b.HOST = 'drive-59' ) SELECT i.TENANT_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT i.PORT_ID) AS total_ports, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT psb.PORT_ID) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_port_security_enabled FROM inner_cte AS i LEFT JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON i.PORT_ID = psb.PORT_ID GROUP BY i.TENANT_ID ORDER BY total_ports DESC;

question: For each tenant that (1) has at least one port bound to a security group with admin_state_up = 1 and (2) has at least one port that is DOWN with port security enabled, list the tenant ID, the total number of DOWN ports with port security enabled and the average of that count across tenants, the total number of admin-up ports with security-group bindings along with total security-group bindings and DNS records and the average of that port count across tenants, and the ratio (rounded to 2 decimals) of DOWN+secure ports to admin-up security-group-bound ports.
sql: WITH down_secure_ports AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS down_ports_with_port_security_enabled FROM PORTS p JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND psb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED = 1 ) SELECT p.tenant_id AS ports_tenant_id, COUNT(p.id) AS total_down_ports_with_port_security_enabled, avg_counts.avg_down_secure_port_count FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON p.id = psb.port_id JOIN ( SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_down_secure_port_count FROM ( SELECT p2.tenant_id, COUNT(p2.id) AS port_count FROM ports p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings psb2 ON p2.id = psb2.port_id WHERE p2.status = 'DOWN' AND psb2.port_security_enabled = 1 GROUP BY p2.tenant_id ) AS sub ) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1 CROSS JOIN inner_cte WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND psb.port_security_enabled = 1 GROUP BY p.tenant_id, avg_counts.avg_down_secure_port_count ), sg_admin_up_ports AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN PORTDNSES pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name) SELECT inner_cte.tenant_id, COUNT(inner_cte.port_id) AS total_ports_with_sg_binding_admin_up, SUM(inner_cte.security_group_binding_count) AS total_security_group_bindings, SUM(inner_cte.dns_record_count) AS total_dns_records, avg_ports.avg_port_count AS avg_ports_with_sg_binding_admin_up_per_tenant FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count FROM ( SELECT COUNT(port_id) AS port_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY tenant_id ) AS sub ) AS avg_ports GROUP BY inner_cte.tenant_id, avg_ports.avg_port_count ) SELECT sap.tenant_id, dsp.total_down_ports_with_port_security_enabled, dsp.avg_down_secure_port_count, sap.total_ports_with_sg_binding_admin_up, sap.total_security_group_bindings, sap.total_dns_records, sap.avg_ports_with_sg_binding_admin_up_per_tenant, ROUND( dsp.total_down_ports_with_port_security_enabled / NULLIF(sap.total_ports_with_sg_binding_admin_up, 0), 2 ) AS down_secure_to_sg_admin_up_port_ratio FROM sg_admin_up_ports sap JOIN down_secure_ports dsp ON sap.tenant_id = dsp.ports_tenant_id ORDER BY down_secure_to_sg_admin_up_port_ratio DESC;
sub_questions: How many ports are in status 'DOWN' and have port security enabled (as indicated by the port security binding)?

For each port that is bound to a security group and has admin_state_up = 1, list the port ID, tenant ID, port name, and the number of security group bindings for that port along with the total number of DNS records associated with the port.

For each tenant, list the tenant ID, the total number of ports that are in status 'DOWN' and have port security enabled (as indicated by the port security binding), along with the average of that down-and-secure port count across all tenants.

For each tenant that has at least one port bound to a security group with admin_state_up = 1, list the tenant ID, the total number of such ports they have, the total number of security group bindings across those ports, the total number of DNS records across those ports, and the average number of such ports per tenant.
sub_sqls: SELECT COUNT(*) AS down_ports_with_port_security_enabled FROM PORTS p JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND psb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED = 1;

SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN PORTDNSES pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS down_ports_with_port_security_enabled FROM PORTS p JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND psb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED = 1 ) SELECT p.tenant_id AS ports_tenant_id, COUNT(p.id) AS total_down_ports_with_port_security_enabled, avg_counts.avg_down_secure_port_count FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON p.id = psb.port_id JOIN ( SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_down_secure_port_count FROM ( SELECT p2.tenant_id, COUNT(p2.id) AS port_count FROM ports p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings psb2 ON p2.id = psb2.port_id WHERE p2.status = 'DOWN' AND psb2.port_security_enabled = 1 GROUP BY p2.tenant_id ) AS sub ) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1 CROSS JOIN inner_cte WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND psb.port_security_enabled = 1 GROUP BY p.tenant_id, avg_counts.avg_down_secure_port_count;

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN PORTDNSES pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name) SELECT inner_cte.tenant_id, COUNT(inner_cte.port_id) AS total_ports_with_sg_binding_admin_up, SUM(inner_cte.security_group_binding_count) AS total_security_group_bindings, SUM(inner_cte.dns_record_count) AS total_dns_records, avg_ports.avg_port_count AS avg_ports_with_sg_binding_admin_up_per_tenant FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count FROM ( SELECT COUNT(port_id) AS port_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY tenant_id ) AS sub ) AS avg_ports GROUP BY inner_cte.tenant_id, avg_ports.avg_port_count;

question: Show (1) the network-status rollup (by network status and whether the network is External vs Internal) with the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED for networks that have security bindings, and (2) the IPv4 subnet rollup (by subnet name and whether the subnet’s standard attribute has an updated-at timestamp) with the row counts—return both result sets together in one output. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH NetworkStatusStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, VARIANCE(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_variance, STDDEV(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_stddev FROM NETWORKS AS n JOIN NETWORKSECURITYBINDINGS AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID GROUP BY n.STATUS ORDER BY port_security_enabled_variance DESC ), NetworkStatusExternal AS ( SELECT n.status, CASE WHEN en.network_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'External' ELSE 'Internal' END AS external_status, VARIANCE(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_variance, STDDEV(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_stddev FROM networks n JOIN networksecuritybindings nsb ON n.id = nsb.network_id LEFT JOIN externalnetworks en ON n.id = en.network_id GROUP BY n.status, external_status ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(nse.status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE nse.status END AS network_status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(nse.external_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(nse.status) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE nse.external_status END AS external_status, VARIANCE(nse.port_security_enabled_variance) AS port_security_enabled_variance, STDDEV(nse.port_security_enabled_stddev) AS port_security_enabled_stddev FROM NetworkStatusExternal nse CROSS JOIN inner_cte GROUP BY nse.status, nse.external_status WITH ROLLUP ), SubnetUpdateStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.NAME, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY sa.UPDATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES AS sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4), SubnetUpdateBuckets AS ( SELECT i.NAME, CASE WHEN sa.UPDATED_AT IS NOT NULL THEN 'Has Updated Timestamp' ELSE 'No Updated Timestamp' END AS updated_bucket, COUNT(*) AS total_rows FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBNETS s ON s.NAME = i.NAME JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID GROUP BY i.NAME, updated_bucket ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(NAME) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE NAME END AS NAME, CASE WHEN GROUPING(updated_bucket) = 1 AND GROUPING(NAME) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE updated_bucket END AS updated_bucket, SUM(total_rows) AS total_rows FROM SubnetUpdateBuckets GROUP BY NAME, sub_questions: For each network status, show the status and compute both the variance and the standard deviation of the security group binding order (PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) across networks that have at least one security binding.

For subnets whose IP version is 4, list each subnet name and the dense rank of its associated standard attribute ID when ordered by the standard attribute’s updated-at timestamp, using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows.

For each network status and whether the network is external or internal, show the network status, the external status label ('External' if the network appears in EXTERNALNETWORKS, 'Internal' otherwise), and compute both the variance and the standard deviation of PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED across networks that have at least one security binding. Include subtotals per network status and a grand total.

For subnets whose IP version is 4, group results by subnet name and a standard-attribute “recency bucket” (label as 'Has Updated Timestamp' when the standard attribute has a non-null updated-at timestamp, otherwise 'No Updated Timestamp'), and list the number of rows in each group. Include subtotals per subnet name and a grand total.
sub_sqls: SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, VARIANCE(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_variance, STDDEV(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_stddev FROM NETWORKS AS n JOIN NETWORKSECURITYBINDINGS AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID GROUP BY n.STATUS ORDER BY port_security_enabled_variance DESC;

SELECT s.NAME, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY sa.UPDATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES AS sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, VARIANCE(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_variance, STDDEV(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_stddev FROM NETWORKS AS n JOIN NETWORKSECURITYBINDINGS AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID GROUP BY n.STATUS ORDER BY port_security_enabled_variance DESC ), NetworkStatusExternal AS ( SELECT n.status, CASE WHEN en.network_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'External' ELSE 'Internal' END AS external_status, VARIANCE(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_variance, STDDEV(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_stddev FROM networks n JOIN networksecuritybindings nsb ON n.id = nsb.network_id LEFT JOIN externalnetworks en ON n.id = en.network_id GROUP BY n.status, external_status ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(nse.status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE nse.status END AS network_status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(nse.external_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(nse.status) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE nse.external_status END AS external_status, VARIANCE(nse.port_security_enabled_variance) AS port_security_enabled_variance, STDDEV(nse.port_security_enabled_stddev) AS port_security_enabled_stddev FROM NetworkStatusExternal nse CROSS JOIN inner_cte GROUP BY nse.status, nse.external_status WITH ROLLUP;

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.NAME, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY sa.UPDATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES AS sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4), SubnetUpdateBuckets AS ( SELECT i.NAME, CASE WHEN sa.UPDATED_AT IS NOT NULL THEN 'Has Updated Timestamp' ELSE 'No Updated Timestamp' END AS updated_bucket, COUNT(*) AS total_rows FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBNETS s ON s.NAME = i.NAME JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID GROUP BY i.NAME, updated_bucket ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(NAME) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE NAME END AS NAME, CASE WHEN GROUPING(updated_bucket) = 1 AND GROUPING(NAME) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE updated_bucket END AS updated_bucket, SUM(total_rows) AS total_rows FROM SubnetUpdateBuckets GROUP BY NAME, updated_bucket WITH ROLLUP;

question: For the top 10 tenants with the highest number of networks marked as default external networks (IS_DEFAULT = 0), show each tenant’s ID, the total count of those default external networks, the minimum MTU among those networks, and (considering only ACTIVE networks) the latest standard attribute UPDATED_AT timestamp for that tenant. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH active_network_latest_stdattr AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ) SELECT tenant_id, MAX(standard_attr_updated_at) AS latest_standard_attr_updated_at FROM inner_cte GROUP BY tenant_id ), top10_default_external_tenants AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT e.NETWORK_ID, e.IS_DEFAULT, n.TENANT_ID, n.NAME, n.STATUS, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP, n.MTU, n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID, MIN(n.MTU) OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.TENANT_ID) AS window_column FROM EXTERNALNETWORKS e JOIN NETWORKS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 ) SELECT i.TENANT_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT i.NETWORK_ID) AS total_default_external_networks, MIN(i.MTU) AS min_mtu_in_tenant FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.TENANT_ID ORDER BY total_default_external_networks DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT t.TENANT_ID, t.total_default_external_networks, t.min_mtu_in_tenant, a.latest_standard_attr_updated_at FROM top10_default_external_tenants t JOIN active_network_latest_stdattr a ON t.TENANT_ID = a.tenant_id ORDER BY t.total_default_external_networks DESC;

sub_sqls: SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE';

SELECT e.NETWORK_ID, e.IS_DEFAULT, n.TENANT_ID, n.NAME, n.STATUS, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP, n.MTU, n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID, MIN(n.MTU) OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.TENANT_ID) AS window_column FROM EXTERNALNETWORKS e JOIN NETWORKS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ) SELECT tenant_id, MAX(standard_attr_updated_at) AS latest_standard_attr_updated_at FROM inner_cte GROUP BY tenant_id;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT e.NETWORK_ID, e.IS_DEFAULT, n.TENANT_ID, n.NAME, n.STATUS, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP, n.MTU, n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID, MIN(n.MTU) OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.TENANT_ID) AS window_column FROM EXTERNALNETWORKS e JOIN NETWORKS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 ) SELECT i.TENANT_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT i.NETWORK_ID) AS total_default_external_networks, MIN(i.MTU) AS min_mtu_in_tenant FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.TENANT_ID ORDER BY total_default_external_networks DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For ports bound to security group ID 0008e629-5619-41e0-b86c-4eecfeaacb6c, list each port’s ID, status, allocated IP address, and the running sum of its standard attribute ID within its network (ordered by standard attribute ID); also include the owning tenant ID, that tenant’s total number of such ports and the average of these per-tenant totals across all tenants, and for the same port status report the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of standard attribute IDs (for ports that have both a security group port binding and a port security binding) along with the average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all statuses. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.STATUS AS port_status, ia.IP_ADDRESS AS ip_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY p.NETWORK_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID = '0008e629-5619-41e0-b86c-4eecfeaacb6c' ) SELECT inner_cte.port_id, inner_cte.port_status, inner_cte.ip_address, inner_cte.window_column, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, COUNT(p.ID) AS total_ports_for_tenant_in_sg, avg_ports.avg_port_count AS avg_ports_per_tenant_in_sg FROM inner_cte JOIN PORTS p ON inner_cte.port_id = p.ID JOIN ( SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count FROM ( SELECT COUNT(p2.ID) AS port_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb2 JOIN PORTS p2 ON sgpb2.PORT_ID = p2.ID WHERE sgpb2.SECURITY_GROUP_ID = '0008e629-5619-41e0-b86c-4eecfeaacb6c' GROUP BY p2.TENANT_ID ) AS sub ) AS avg_ports ON 1 = 1 GROUP BY inner_cte.port_id, inner_cte.port_status, inner_cte.ip_address, inner_cte.window_column, p.TENANT_ID, avg_ports.avg_port_count ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.status, STDDEV(p.standard_attr_id) / NULLIF(AVG(p.standard_attr_id), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM securitygroupportbindings AS sgpb JOIN ports AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN portsecuritybindings AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(p.standard_attr_id) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT inner_cte.status, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, avg_cov.avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ) AS avg_cov ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT subq1.port_id, subq1.port_status, subq1.ip_address, subq1.window_column, subq1.tenant_id, subq1.total_ports_for_tenant_in_sg, subq1.avg_ports_per_tenant_in_sg, subq2.coefficient_of_variation, subq2.avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.port_status = subq2.status;
sub_questions: For ports that are bound to the security group ID 0008e629-5619-41e0-b86c-4eecfeaacb6c, show the port ID, the port status, the allocated IP address, and the running sum of the port’s standard attribute ID within each network ordered by standard attribute ID.

For each port status, show the status and the coefficient of variation of the ports’ standard attribute IDs, considering only ports that have a security group port binding and a port security binding.

For ports that are bound to the security group ID 0008e629-5619-41e0-b86c-4eecfeaacb6c, show the port ID, port status, allocated IP address, and the running sum of the port’s standard attribute ID within each network ordered by standard attribute ID; additionally, for each tenant that owns these ports, include the total number of such ports they have and the average of these per-tenant totals across all tenants.

For each port status, show the status, the coefficient of variation of the ports’ standard attribute IDs (considering only ports that have both a security group port binding and a port security binding), along with the average coefficient of variation across all statuses.
sub_sqls: SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.STATUS AS port_status, ia.IP_ADDRESS AS ip_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY p.NETWORK_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID = '0008e629-5619-41e0-b86c-4eecfeaacb6c';

SELECT p.status, STDDEV(p.standard_attr_id) / NULLIF(AVG(p.standard_attr_id), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM securitygroupportbindings AS sgpb JOIN ports AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN portsecuritybindings AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(p.standard_attr_id) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.STATUS AS port_status, ia.IP_ADDRESS AS ip_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY p.NETWORK_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID = '0008e629-5619-41e0-b86c-4eecfeaacb6c' ) SELECT inner_cte.port_id, inner_cte.port_status, inner_cte.ip_address, inner_cte.window_column, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, COUNT(p.ID) AS total_ports_for_tenant_in_sg, avg_ports.avg_port_count AS avg_ports_per_tenant_in_sg FROM inner_cte JOIN PORTS p ON inner_cte.port_id = p.ID JOIN ( SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count FROM ( SELECT COUNT(p2.ID) AS port_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb2 JOIN PORTS p2 ON sgpb2.PORT_ID = p2.ID WHERE sgpb2.SECURITY_GROUP_ID = '0008e629-5619-41e0-b86c-4eecfeaacb6c' GROUP BY p2.TENANT_ID ) AS sub ) AS avg_ports ON 1 = 1 GROUP BY inner_cte.port_id, inner_cte.port_status, inner_cte.ip_address, inner_cte.window_column, p.TENANT_ID, avg_ports.avg_port_count;

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.status, STDDEV(p.standard_attr_id) / NULLIF(AVG(p.standard_attr_id), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM securitygroupportbindings AS sgpb JOIN ports AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN portsecuritybindings AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(p.standard_attr_id) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT inner_cte.status, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, avg_cov.avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ) AS avg_cov ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For the allowed address pairs on port ID `25d421c1-c76d-4c26-9550-9f871a1d5034`, list each allowed address pair’s MAC address and IP address, the port ID, and the bound security group ID, along with (a) the running average of that port’s standard attribute ID (ordered by allowed address pair IP) and its deviation from the overall average running average, and (b) the geometric mean of standard attribute IDs for ports bound to that same security group (considering only standard attribute IDs > 0) and its deviation from the overall average geometric mean across security groups. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH sg_geom AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, EXP(AVG(LN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID))) AS geometric_mean_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID > 0 GROUP BY s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY geometric_mean_standard_attr_id DESC), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_standard_attr_id) AS avg_geometric_mean_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, i.geometric_mean_standard_attr_id, (i.geometric_mean_standard_attr_id - a.avg_geometric_mean_standard_attr_id) AS deviation_from_avg_geometric_mean FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_cte a ORDER BY deviation_from_avg_geometric_mean DESC ), port_aap_window AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT aap.MAC_ADDRESS AS allowed_mac_address, aap.IP_ADDRESS AS allowed_ip_address, p.ID AS port_id, sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID AS security_group_id, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY p.ID ORDER BY aap.IP_ADDRESS ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN ALLOWEDADDRESSPAIRS AS aap ON p.ID = aap.PORT_ID WHERE p.ID = '25d421c1-c76d-4c26-9550-9f871a1d5034' ORDER BY aap.IP_ADDRESS ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.allowed_mac_address, i.allowed_ip_address, i.port_id, i.security_group_id, i.window_column, (i.window_column - a.avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_avg_window FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_cte a ORDER BY i.allowed_ip_address ) SELECT p.allowed_mac_address, p.allowed_ip_address, p.port_id, p.security_group_id, p.window_column, p.deviation_from_avg_window, g.geometric_mean_standard_attr_id, g.deviation_from_avg_geometric_mean FROM port_aap_window p JOIN sg_geom g ON p.security_group_id = g.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY p.allowed_ip_address;

sub_sqls: SELECT s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, EXP(AVG(LN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID))) AS geometric_mean_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID > 0 GROUP BY s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY geometric_mean_standard_attr_id DESC;

SELECT aap.MAC_ADDRESS AS allowed_mac_address, aap.IP_ADDRESS AS allowed_ip_address, p.ID AS port_id, sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID AS security_group_id, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY p.ID ORDER BY aap.IP_ADDRESS ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN ALLOWEDADDRESSPAIRS AS aap ON p.ID = aap.PORT_ID WHERE p.ID = '25d421c1-c76d-4c26-9550-9f871a1d5034' ORDER BY aap.IP_ADDRESS;

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, EXP(AVG(LN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID))) AS geometric_mean_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID > 0 GROUP BY s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY geometric_mean_standard_attr_id DESC), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_standard_attr_id) AS avg_geometric_mean_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, i.geometric_mean_standard_attr_id, (i.geometric_mean_standard_attr_id - a.avg_geometric_mean_standard_attr_id) AS deviation_from_avg_geometric_mean FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_cte a ORDER BY deviation_from_avg_geometric_mean DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT aap.MAC_ADDRESS AS allowed_mac_address, aap.IP_ADDRESS AS allowed_ip_address, p.ID AS port_id, sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID AS security_group_id, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY p.ID ORDER BY aap.IP_ADDRESS ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN ALLOWEDADDRESSPAIRS AS aap ON p.ID = aap.PORT_ID WHERE p.ID = '25d421c1-c76d-4c26-9550-9f871a1d5034' ORDER BY aap.IP_ADDRESS ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.allowed_mac_address, i.allowed_ip_address, i.port_id, i.security_group_id, i.window_column, (i.window_column - a.avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_avg_window FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_cte a ORDER BY i.allowed_ip_address;

question: For ACTIVE networks, list the network name, status, and admin_state_up together with each RBAC action and target tenant, the number of distinct RBAC target tenants per network, and the dense-rank value; restrict the results to networks whose owning tenant is among the top 10 tenants by total IPv4 subnet count (considering only IPv4 subnets with a non-null standard-attribute updated-at), and also show that tenant’s total IPv4 subnet count and whether they have any such updated standard-attribute record. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH tenant_ipv4 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.NAME, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY sa.UPDATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES AS sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 ) SELECT s.TENANT_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT s.ID) AS total_ipv4_subnets, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT sa.ID) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_any_updated_standard_attribute FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES AS sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID JOIN inner_cte AS ic ON ic.NAME = s.NAME WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND sa.UPDATED_AT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.TENANT_ID ORDER BY total_ipv4_subnets DESC LIMIT 10 ), active_network_rbac AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM networksecuritybindings b JOIN networks n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN networkrbacs r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE'), rbac_counts AS ( SELECT n.id AS network_id, COUNT(DISTINCT r.target_tenant) AS distinct_target_tenants FROM networksecuritybindings b JOIN networks n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN networkrbacs r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY n.id ) SELECT i.name, i.status, i.admin_state_up, i.action, i.target_tenant, c.distinct_target_tenants, i.window_column FROM inner_cte i JOIN rbac_counts c ON c.network_id = (SELECT n2.id FROM networks n2 WHERE n2.name = i.name AND n2.status = i.status AND n2.admin_state_up = i.admin_state_up LIMIT 1) ), network_tenant_map AS ( SELECT DISTINCT n.id AS network_id, n.tenant_id FROM networks n WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' ) SELECT anr.name AS network_name, anr.status AS network_status, anr.admin_state_up, anr.action AS rbac_action, anr.target_tenant, anr.distinct_target_tenants, anr.window_column AS network_dense_rank, t.total_ipv4_subnets, t.has_any_updated_standard_attribute FROM active_network_rbac anr JOIN networks n ON n.name = anr.name AND n.status = anr.status AND n.admin_state_up = anr.admin_state_up JOIN network_tenant_map ntm ON ntm.network_id = n.id JOIN tenant_ipv4 t ON t.tenant_id = ntm.tenant_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE';
