question: For IPv4 subnets whose ID is in ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48'), return (with tenant subtotals and a grand total) the average range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of routes per subnet (computed per next hop), and alongside that return (with rollup subtotals and a grand total) the RBAC action statistics for the **access_as_shared** permission: the average subnet IP version, the IP-version range (max minus min), and the variance of subnet IP version for subnets whose network is referenced by that RBAC entry. sql: WITH SubnetRouteRollup AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(route_count) - MIN(route_count) AS route_count_range, VARIANCE(route_count) AS route_count_variance, STDDEV(route_count) AS route_count_stddev FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN ( SELECT sr.SUBNET_ID, COUNT(*) AS route_count FROM SUBNETROUTES AS sr GROUP BY sr.SUBNET_ID, sr.NEXTHOP ) AS route_stats ON s.ID = route_stats.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY route_count_range DESC), SubnetTenantStats AS ( SELECT s.tenant_id, i.subnet_name, i.route_count_range, i.route_count_variance, i.route_count_stddev FROM inner_cte i JOIN subnets s ON s.name = i.subnet_name AND s.ip_version = 4 AND s.id IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(subnet_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(tenant_id) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(subnet_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE subnet_name END AS subnet_name, AVG(route_count_range) AS avg_route_count_range, AVG(route_count_variance) AS avg_route_count_variance, AVG(route_count_stddev) AS avg_route_count_stddev FROM SubnetTenantStats GROUP BY tenant_id, subnet_name WITH ROLLUP ), RbacIpVersionRollup AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.ACTION AS rbac_action, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, MAX(s.IP_VERSION) - MIN(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_range, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION IN (4, 6) AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_range DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(rbac_action) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE rbac_action END AS rbac_action, AVG(avg_ip_version) AS avg_ip_version, MAX(ip_version_range) AS ip_version_range, AVG(ip_version_variance) AS avg_ip_version_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY rbac_action WITH ROLLUP ) SELECT srr.tenant_id, srr.subnet_name, srr.avg_route_count_range, srr.avg_route_count_variance, srr.avg_route_count_stddev, rir.rbac_action, rir.avg_ip_version, rir.ip_version_range, rir.avg_ip_version_variance FROM SubnetRouteRollup srr CROSS JOIN RbacIpVersionRollup rir;

a.avg_binding_count_range) AS deviation_from_avg_binding_count_range FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_cte a ORDER BY i.binding_count_range DESC ) SELECT r.port_status, r.device_owner, r.port_count, r.earliest_standard_attr_update, s.binding_count_range, s.binding_count_variance, s.binding_count_stddev, s.deviation_from_avg_binding_count_range FROM port_status_owner_rollup r LEFT JOIN port_security_binding_stats s ON r.port_status = s.status ORDER BY r.port_status, r.device_owner;

question: For each IPv4 subnet (by subnet name) that is not on a network shared via `access_as_shared` to `*` or to tenant `9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b`, return the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of DNS nameserver order values, the overall average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all such subnets, and (when applicable) the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) for only those subnets whose coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is above that overall average. sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, STDDEV(d.order) / NULLIF(AVG(d.order), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM subnets AS s JOIN dnsnameservers AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN ipallocationpools AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id JOIN networks AS n ON n.id = s.network_id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT r.object_id FROM networkrbacs AS r WHERE r.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (r.target_tenant = '*' OR r.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY s.name HAVING AVG(d.order) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.subnet_name, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, avg_cv.avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ) AS avg_cv ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, STDDEV(d.order) / NULLIF(AVG(d.order), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM subnets AS s JOIN dnsnameservers AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN ipallocationpools AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id JOIN networks AS n ON n.id = s.network_id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT r.object_id FROM networkrbacs AS r WHERE r.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (r.target_tenant = '*' OR r.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY s.name HAVING AVG(d.order) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN subnets AS s ON s.name = i.subnet_name WHERE i.coefficient_of_variation > ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) FROM inner_cte ) ORDER BY i.coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT q1.subnet_name, q1.coefficient_of_variation, q1.avg_coefficient_of_variation, q2.coefficient_of_variation AS above_avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM q1 LEFT JOIN q2 ON q2.subnet_name = q1.subnet_name ORDER BY q1.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

sql: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address) SELECT p.network_id, MAX(inner_cte.ip_allocation_count) AS max_ip_allocations_on_a_port FROM inner_cte JOIN ports p ON p.id = inner_cte.port_id GROUP BY p.network_id), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.status, STDDEV(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) / NULLIF(AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM portsecuritybindings psb JOIN ports p ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON p.id = ia.port_id WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1 AND ia.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT ia.network_id, MAX(inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation) AS max_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte JOIN ports p ON p.status = inner_cte.status JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id GROUP BY ia.network_id) SELECT q1.network_id, q1.max_ip_allocations_on_a_port, q2.max_coefficient_of_variation FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.network_id = q1.network_id;

a.avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_avg_window_min FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_window a ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')) SELECT inner_cte.port_id, inner_cte.tenant_id, inner_cte.mac_address, inner_cte.window_column, tenant_counts.total_down_ports_for_tenant, avg_counts.avg_down_ports_across_tenants FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT p.tenant_id AS tenant_id, COUNT(p.id) AS total_down_ports_for_tenant FROM ports p WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' GROUP BY p.tenant_id) AS tenant_counts ON inner_cte.tenant_id = tenant_counts.tenant_id JOIN (SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_down_ports_across_tenants FROM (SELECT COUNT(p.id) AS port_count FROM ports p WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' GROUP BY p.tenant_id) AS sub) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1 ) SELECT subq1.NETWORK_ID, subq2.tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS joined_down_port_rows, AVG(subq1.deviation_from_avg_window_min) AS avg_deviation_from_avg_window_min, AVG(subq2.window_column) AS avg_running_sum_standard_attr_id_within_sg, MAX(subq2.total_down_ports_for_tenant) AS total_down_ports_for_tenant, MAX(subq2.avg_down_ports_across_tenants) AS avg_down_ports_across_tenants FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.MAC_ADDRESS = subq2.mac_address GROUP BY subq1.NETWORK_ID, subq2.tenant_id;

sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ) SELECT inner_cte.port_status, inner_cte.device_owner, inner_cte.port_count, inner_cte.earliest_standard_attr_update, avg_groups.avg_port_count_across_groups FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count_across_groups FROM inner_cte ) AS avg_groups ON 1 = 1 ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.earliest_standard_attr_update, (i.port_count - a.avg_port_count) AS deviation_from_avg_port_count FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_cte a ) SELECT s2.port_status, s2.device_owner, s2.port_count, s2.earliest_standard_attr_update, s1.avg_port_count_across_groups, s2.deviation_from_avg_port_count FROM subq2 s2 JOIN subq1 s1 ON s2.port_status = s1.port_status AND ( (s2.device_owner = s1.device_owner) OR (s2.device_owner IS NULL AND s1.device_owner IS NULL) ) WHERE s2.port_count > s1.avg_port_count_across_groups ORDER BY s2.port_count DESC;

question: For tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57' and ports that are administratively up, list each port’s ID and tenant ID along with two stacked “signals”: (1) a DNS signal showing the port’s DNS record count versus the overall average and its DNS category (HIGH_DNS/LOW_DNS/AVERAGE_DNS) for ports bound to a security group, and (2) an IP signal showing the port’s IP allocation count versus the overall average and its IP usage category (HIGH_IP/LOW_IP/AVERAGE_IP) for ports with at least one IP allocation. sql: WITH DnsPerPort AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN PORTDNSES pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name ), AverageDns AS ( SELECT AVG(dns_record_count) AS avg_dns_records FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.port_id, ic.tenant_id, ic.port_name, ic.security_group_binding_count, ic.dns_record_count, ad.avg_dns_records AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.dns_record_count > ad.avg_dns_records * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_DNS' WHEN ic.dns_record_count < ad.avg_dns_records * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_DNS' ELSE 'AVERAGE_DNS' END AS dns_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageDns ad ), IpPerPort AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ), AverageAllocations AS ( SELECT AVG(ip_allocation_count) AS avg_ip_allocations FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.port_id, ic.tenant_id, ic.mac_address, ic.ip_allocation_count, ic.subnet_id_rows, aa.avg_ip_allocations AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.ip_allocation_count > aa.avg_ip_allocations * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_IP' WHEN ic.ip_allocation_count < aa.avg_ip_allocations * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_IP' ELSE 'AVERAGE_IP' END AS ip_usage_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageAllocations aa ), CombinedPortSignals AS ( SELECT dpp.port_id, dpp.tenant_id, 'DNS' AS signal_type, dpp.dns_category AS category, dpp.dns_record_count AS signal_count, dpp.benchmark AS benchmark FROM DnsPerPort dpp UNION ALL SELECT ipp.port_id, ipp.tenant_id, 'IP' AS signal_type, ipp.ip_usage_category AS category, ipp.ip_allocation_count AS signal_count, ipp.benchmark AS benchmark FROM IpPerPort ipp ) SELECT port_id, tenant_id, signal_type, category, signal_count, benchmark FROM CombinedPortSignals ORDER BY tenant_id, port_id, signal_type;

sub_sqls: SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN PORTDNSES pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name;

SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN PORTDNSES pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name ), AverageDns AS ( SELECT AVG(dns_record_count) AS avg_dns_records FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.port_id, ic.tenant_id, ic.port_name, ic.security_group_binding_count, ic.dns_record_count, ad.avg_dns_records AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.dns_record_count > ad.avg_dns_records * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_DNS' WHEN ic.dns_record_count < ad.avg_dns_records * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_DNS' ELSE 'AVERAGE_DNS' END AS dns_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageDns ad;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ), AverageAllocations AS ( SELECT AVG(ip_allocation_count) AS avg_ip_allocations FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.port_id, ic.tenant_id, ic.mac_address, ic.ip_allocation_count, ic.subnet_id_rows, aa.avg_ip_allocations AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.ip_allocation_count > aa.avg_ip_allocations * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_IP' WHEN ic.ip_allocation_count < aa.avg_ip_allocations * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_IP' ELSE 'AVERAGE_IP' END AS ip_usage_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageAllocations aa;

question: For the RBAC action access_as_shared, show (1) the top 10 actions by subnet IP-version variance across referenced subnets including the average/variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP version and whether any referenced subnets have DHCP enabled, and (2) for the same action where the RBAC entry is public (target_tenant = '*'), also show the subnet IP-version variance and the total number of distinct subnets involved, aligned by action. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.ACTION, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACTION, inner_cte.avg_ip_version, inner_cte.ip_version_variance, inner_cte.ip_version_stddev, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 THEN s.ID END) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_dhcp_enabled_subnets FROM inner_cte JOIN NETWORKRBACS AS n ON n.ACTION = inner_cte.ACTION JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON s.NETWORK_ID = n.OBJECT_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY inner_cte.ACTION, inner_cte.avg_ip_version, inner_cte.ip_version_variance, inner_cte.ip_version_stddev ORDER BY inner_cte.ip_version_variance DESC LIMIT 10 ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT = '*' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(action) OVER (ORDER BY action_sort, action) = action THEN NULL ELSE action END AS action, ip_version_variance, distinct_subnets FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.action) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.action END AS action_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.action) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.action END AS action, i.ip_version_variance AS ip_version_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT s2.id) AS distinct_subnets FROM inner_cte i JOIN NETWORKRBACS n2 ON n2.action = i.action AND n2.action = 'access_as_shared' AND n2.target_tenant = '*' JOIN SUBNETS s2 ON s2.network_id = n2.object_id GROUP BY i.action, i.ip_version_variance WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY action_sort, action ) SELECT q1.ACTION, q1.avg_ip_version, q1.ip_version_variance AS top10_ip_version_variance, q1.ip_version_stddev, q1.has_dhcp_enabled_subnets, q2.ip_version_variance AS public_access_ip_version_variance, q2.distinct_subnets FROM q1 LEFT JOIN q2 ON q2.action = q1.action ORDER BY q1.ip_version_variance DESC;

sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ) SELECT inner_cte.port_status, inner_cte.device_owner, inner_cte.port_count, inner_cte.min_standard_attr_id, avg_counts.avg_port_count FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count FROM inner_cte ) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1 ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.port_status, ic.device_owner, ic.port_count, ic.min_standard_attr_id, ac.avg_port_count AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.port_count > ac.avg_port_count * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_GROUP' WHEN ic.port_count < ac.avg_port_count * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_GROUP' ELSE 'AVERAGE_GROUP' END AS group_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte ac ) SELECT s1.port_status, s1.device_owner, s1.port_count AS distinct_port_count, s1.min_standard_attr_id, s1.avg_port_count AS overall_avg_distinct_port_count, s2.benchmark AS overall_avg_port_count_benchmark, s2.group_category FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.port_status = s2.port_status AND s1.device_owner = s2.device_owner AND s1.port_count = s2.port_count AND s1.min_standard_attr_id = s2.min_standard_attr_id;

sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.ACTION AS rbac_action, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, MAX(s.IP_VERSION) - MIN(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_range, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION IN (4, 6) AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_range DESC ) SELECT i.rbac_action, i.avg_ip_version, i.ip_version_range, i.ip_version_variance, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 THEN s.ID END) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_dhcp_enabled_subnets FROM inner_cte i JOIN NETWORKRBACS n ON n.ACTION = i.rbac_action JOIN SUBNETS s ON s.NETWORK_ID = n.OBJECT_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION IN (4, 6) AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY i.rbac_action, i.avg_ip_version, i.ip_version_range, i.ip_version_variance ORDER BY i.ip_version_range DESC LIMIT 10 ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ), overall_avgs AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_ip_version) AS overall_avg_ip_version, AVG(ip_version_variance) AS overall_avg_variance, AVG(ip_version_stddev) AS overall_avg_stddev FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.ACTION, i.avg_ip_version, i.ip_version_variance, i.ip_version_stddev, (i.avg_ip_version - o.overall_avg_ip_version) AS deviation_avg_ip_version, (i.ip_version_variance - o.overall_avg_variance) AS deviation_ip_version_variance, (i.ip_version_stddev - o.overall_avg_stddev) AS deviation_ip_version_stddev FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN overall_avgs o ) SELECT q1.rbac_action, q1.avg_ip_version AS avg_ip_version_across_ip4_or_ip6, q1.ip_version_range, q1.ip_version_variance AS ip_version_variance_across_ip4_or_ip6, q1.has_dhcp_enabled_subnets, q2.avg_ip_version AS avg_ip_version_ip4_only, q2.ip_version_variance AS ip_version_variance_ip4_only, q2.ip_version_stddev AS ip_version_stddev_ip4_only, q2.deviation_avg_ip_version, q2.deviation_ip_version_variance, q2.deviation_ip_version_stddev FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.ACTION = q1.rbac_action ORDER BY q1.ip_version_range DESC;

question: For subnet ID 012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48, list (1) per-subnet IP allocation pool FIRST_IP range/variance for routes whose next hop is 10.30.19.197/8 (including each subnet’s deviation from the average FIRST_IP range across the selected subnets) and (2) per-subnet (plus tenant subtotals and a grand total) IPv4 route-count range/variance/stddev computed per next hop, combined into one result set with tenant_id, subnet_name, a stat_type label, and three metric columns. sql: WITH FirstIpRangeStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(p.FIRST_IP) - MIN(p.FIRST_IP) AS first_ip_range, VARIANCE(p.FIRST_IP) AS first_ip_variance FROM SUBNETROUTES r JOIN SUBNETS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE r.NEXTHOP = '10.30.19.197/8' AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY first_ip_range DESC ), avg_ranges AS ( SELECT AVG(first_ip_range) AS avg_first_ip_range FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.first_ip_range, i.first_ip_variance, (i.first_ip_range - a.avg_first_ip_range) AS deviation_from_avg_first_ip_range FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_ranges a ORDER BY deviation_from_avg_first_ip_range DESC ), RouteCountRollupStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(route_count) - MIN(route_count) AS route_count_range, VARIANCE(route_count) AS route_count_variance, STDDEV(route_count) AS route_count_stddev FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN ( SELECT sr.SUBNET_ID, COUNT(*) AS route_count FROM SUBNETROUTES AS sr GROUP BY sr.SUBNET_ID, sr.NEXTHOP ) AS route_stats ON s.ID = route_stats.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY route_count_range DESC), SubnetTenantStats AS ( SELECT s.tenant_id, i.subnet_name, i.route_count_range, i.route_count_variance, i.route_count_stddev FROM inner_cte i JOIN subnets s ON s.name = i.subnet_name AND s.ip_version = 4 AND s.id IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(subnet_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(tenant_id) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(subnet_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE subnet_name END AS subnet_name, AVG(route_count_range) AS avg_route_count_range, AVG(route_count_variance) AS avg_route_count_variance, AVG(route_count_stddev) AS avg_route_count_stddev FROM SubnetTenantStats GROUP BY tenant_id, subnet_name WITH ROLLUP ), CombinedSubnetStats AS ( SELECT s.tenant_id AS tenant_id, f.subnet_name AS subnet_name, 'FIRST_IP_POOL_STATS' AS stat_type, f.first_ip_range AS metric_1, f.first_ip_variance AS metric_2, f.deviation_from_avg_first_ip_range AS metric_3 FROM FirstIpRangeStats f JOIN SUBNETS s ON s.NAME = f.subnet_name AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') UNION ALL SELECT r.tenant_id AS tenant_id, r.subnet_name AS subnet_name, 'ROUTE_COUNT_STATS' AS stat_type, r.avg_route_count_range AS metric_1, r.avg_route_count_variance AS metric_2, r.avg_route_count_stddev AS metric_3 FROM RouteCountRollupStats r ) SELECT tenant_id, subnet_name, stat_type, metric_1, metric_2, metric_3 FROM CombinedSubnetStats ORDER BY tenant_id, subnet_name, stat_type;

question: For tenant ID `17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7`, how many rows are produced by (1) the port listing on host `drive-59` that shows port ID, tenant ID, MAC address, and a running sum of standard attribute IDs within each VIF type (including VIF-type subtotals), and (2) the per–security group geometric-mean summary of port standard attribute IDs (including a final TOTAL row)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH port_vif_rollup AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, p.TENANT_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE b.HOST = 'drive-59' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(vif_type) OVER (ORDER BY vif_type_sort, vif_type, standard_attr_id) = vif_type THEN NULL ELSE vif_type END AS vif_type, port_id, tenant_id, mac_address, window_column FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(b.VIF_TYPE) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE b.VIF_TYPE END AS vif_type_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(b.VIF_TYPE) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE b.VIF_TYPE END AS vif_type, i.PORT_ID AS port_id, i.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, i.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, i.window_column, p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID AS standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte i JOIN PORTS p ON p.ID = i.PORT_ID JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON b.PORT_ID = i.PORT_ID GROUP BY b.VIF_TYPE, i.PORT_ID, i.TENANT_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, i.window_column, p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY vif_type_sort, vif_type, standard_attr_id), security_group_geom_mean_rollup AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, EXP(AVG(LN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID))) AS geometric_mean_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID > 0 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY geometric_mean_standard_attr_id DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(security_group_id) OVER (ORDER BY security_group_id_sort, security_group_id) = security_group_id THEN NULL ELSE security_group_id END AS security_group_id, geometric_mean_standard_attr_id FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.security_group_id) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.security_group_id END AS security_group_id_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.security_group_id) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.security_group_id END AS security_group_id, AVG(i.geometric_mean_standard_attr_id) AS geometric_mean_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte AS i GROUP BY i.security_group_id WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY security_group_id_sort, security_group_id) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM port_vif_rollup) AS port_vif_rollup_row_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM security_group_geom_mean_rollup) AS security_group_geom_mean_rollup_row_count FROM port_vif_rollup pvr CROSS JOIN security_group_geom_mean_rollup sgmr LIMIT 1;

question: For the RBAC action restricted to the `access_as_shared` permission (and only where the average subnet IP version is greater than 4), show the action name along with the average, range (max minus min), and variance of subnet IP versions for referenced networks, and also include the average IP-version standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) for DHCP-enabled subnets on those networks (excluding networks shared via an `access_as_shared` RBAC to target tenant `'*'` or `'9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'`, and only counting actions with more than 5 matching subnets). sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.ACTION AS rbac_action, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, MAX(s.IP_VERSION) - MIN(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_range, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION IN (4, 6) AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_range DESC) SELECT rbac_action, avg_ip_version, ip_version_range, ip_version_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_ip_version > 4 ORDER BY ip_version_range DESC ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 AND s.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.ACTION HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY ip_version_stddev DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(action) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE action END AS action, AVG(ip_version_stddev) AS avg_ip_version_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY action WITH ROLLUP ) SELECT q1.rbac_action, q1.avg_ip_version, q1.ip_version_range, q1.ip_version_variance, q2.avg_ip_version_stddev FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.rbac_action = q2.action ORDER BY q1.ip_version_range DESC;

MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC ) SELECT i.status, i.binding_count_range, i.binding_count_variance, i.binding_count_stddev, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT f.id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_floating_ips FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN ports AS p ON p.status = i.status LEFT JOIN floatingips AS f ON p.id = f.fixed_port_id WHERE p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY i.status, i.binding_count_range, i.binding_count_variance, i.binding_count_stddev ORDER BY i.binding_count_range DESC ) SELECT q1.port_status, q1.device_owner, q1.port_count, q1.earliest_standard_attr_update, q1.has_floating_ips AS top10_combo_has_floating_ips, q2.binding_count_range, q2.binding_count_variance, q2.binding_count_stddev, q2.has_floating_ips AS tenant_ports_in_status_have_floating_ips FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.status = q1.port_status ORDER BY q1.port_count DESC;

sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.STATUS, VARIANCE(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM PORTS AS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NOT NULL AND ia.IP_ADDRESS IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.STATUS ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC), StatusNetworkVariance AS ( SELECT p.status, p.network_id, VARIANCE(p.standard_attr_id) AS network_level_variance FROM ports AS p JOIN ipallocations AS ia ON p.id = ia.port_id JOIN inner_cte AS ic ON ic.status = p.status WHERE p.standard_attr_id IS NOT NULL AND ia.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.status, p.network_id ) SELECT status, MAX(network_level_variance) AS max_network_standard_attr_id_variance FROM StatusNetworkVariance GROUP BY status ORDER BY max_network_standard_attr_id_variance DESC ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, VARIANCE(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM PORTS AS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NOT NULL AND ia.IP_ADDRESS IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.STATUS ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE status END AS status, SUM(standard_attr_id_variance) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY status WITH ROLLUP ) SELECT q2.status, q2.standard_attr_id_variance, q1.max_network_standard_attr_id_variance FROM q2 LEFT JOIN q1 ON q1.status = q2.status ORDER BY CASE WHEN q2.status = 'GRAND TOTAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, q2.status;

question: For subnets whose network RBAC action is 'access_as_shared' and whose RBAC target tenant is '1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b', for each IP version and its subnet-usage category, show the total number of matching subnets, the average deviation of subnet standard attribute IDs from the overall average standard attribute ID, the maximum running sum of standard attribute IDs within the IP version, and the average benchmark subnet count per IP version. Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each IP version as 'HIGH_SUBNET_USAGE' (at least 50% more than average), 'LOW_SUBNET_USAGE' (at least 50% less than average), or 'AVERAGE_SUBNET_USAGE'.
sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, n.TARGET_TENANT AS rbac_target_tenant, SUM(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.IP_VERSION ORDER BY s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN NETWORKRBACS AS n ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b')), AvgStdAttr AS (SELECT AVG(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN NETWORKRBACS AS n ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b')) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.subnet_cidr, i.rbac_target_tenant, i.window_column, (s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID - a.avg_standard_attr_id) AS deviation_from_avg_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBNETS s ON s.NAME = i.subnet_name AND s.CIDR = i.subnet_cidr CROSS JOIN AvgStdAttr a ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, n.TARGET_TENANT AS rbac_target_tenant, SUM(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.IP_VERSION ORDER BY s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN NETWORKRBACS AS n ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b')), IpVersionCounts AS (SELECT s.IP_VERSION, COUNT(*) AS total_subnets FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN NETWORKRBACS AS n ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b') GROUP BY s.IP_VERSION), AverageSubnets AS (SELECT AVG(total_subnets) AS avg_subnets FROM IpVersionCounts) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.subnet_cidr, i.rbac_target_tenant, i.window_column, c.IP_VERSION, c.total_subnets, a.avg_subnets AS benchmark, CASE WHEN c.total_subnets > a.avg_subnets * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_SUBNET_USAGE' WHEN c.total_subnets < a.avg_subnets * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_SUBNET_USAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_SUBNET_USAGE' END AS usage_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBNETS s2 ON s2.NAME = i.subnet_name AND s2.CIDR = i.subnet_cidr JOIN IpVersionCounts c ON c.IP_VERSION = s2.IP_VERSION CROSS JOIN AverageSubnets a ) SELECT q2.IP_VERSION, q2.usage_category, COUNT(*) AS total_filtered_subnets, AVG(q1.deviation_from_avg_standard_attr_id) AS avg_deviation_from_avg_standard_attr_id, MAX(q2.window_column) AS max_running_sum_standard_attr_id, AVG(q2.benchmark) AS avg_benchmark_subnets_per_ip_version FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.subnet_name = q2.subnet_name AND q1.subnet_cidr = q2.subnet_cidr AND q1.rbac_target_tenant = q2.rbac_target_tenant AND q1.window_column = q2.window_column GROUP BY q2.IP_VERSION, q2.usage_category ORDER BY total_filtered_subnets DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, n.TARGET_TENANT AS rbac_target_tenant, SUM(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.IP_VERSION ORDER BY s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN NETWORKRBACS AS n ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b')), AvgStdAttr AS (SELECT AVG(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN NETWORKRBACS AS n ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b')) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.subnet_cidr, i.rbac_target_tenant, i.window_column, (s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID - a.avg_standard_attr_id) AS deviation_from_avg_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBNETS s ON s.NAME = i.subnet_name AND s.CIDR = i.subnet_cidr CROSS JOIN AvgStdAttr a;

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, n.TARGET_TENANT AS rbac_target_tenant, SUM(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.IP_VERSION ORDER BY s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN NETWORKRBACS AS n ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b')), IpVersionCounts AS (SELECT s.IP_VERSION, COUNT(*) AS total_subnets FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN NETWORKRBACS AS n ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b') GROUP BY s.IP_VERSION), AverageSubnets AS (SELECT AVG(total_subnets) AS avg_subnets FROM IpVersionCounts) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.subnet_cidr, i.rbac_target_tenant, i.window_column, c.IP_VERSION, c.total_subnets, a.avg_subnets AS benchmark, CASE WHEN c.total_subnets > a.avg_subnets * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_SUBNET_USAGE' WHEN c.total_subnets < a.avg_subnets * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_SUBNET_USAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_SUBNET_USAGE' END AS usage_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBNETS s2 ON s2.NAME = i.subnet_name AND s2.CIDR = i.subnet_cidr JOIN IpVersionCounts c ON c.IP_VERSION = s2.IP_VERSION CROSS JOIN AverageSubnets a;

sql: WITH DownPortsAboveAvgRunningSum AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')) SELECT port_id, tenant_id, mac_address, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > (SELECT AVG(window_column) FROM inner_cte) ), AdminUpPortsAboveVifTypeWindowAvg AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), VifTypeAverages AS ( SELECT VIF_TYPE, AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte GROUP BY VIF_TYPE ) SELECT i.PORT_ID, i.HOST, i.VIF_TYPE, i.VNIC_TYPE, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, i.STATUS, i.DEVICE_OWNER, i.window_column FROM inner_cte i JOIN VifTypeAverages v ON v.VIF_TYPE = i.VIF_TYPE WHERE i.window_column > v.avg_window_column ) SELECT a.PORT_ID, a.HOST, a.VIF_TYPE, a.VNIC_TYPE, a.TENANT_ID, a.NETWORK_ID, a.MAC_ADDRESS, a.STATUS, a.DEVICE_OWNER, a.window_column AS admin_up_window_avg_standard_attr_id FROM AdminUpPortsAboveVifTypeWindowAvg a WHERE a.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') AND a.PORT_ID IN (SELECT port_id FROM DownPortsAboveAvgRunningSum) ORDER BY a.NETWORK_ID, a.PORT_ID;

sql: WITH ip_status_variance AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, VARIANCE(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM PORTS AS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NOT NULL AND ia.IP_ADDRESS IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.STATUS ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.status, inner_cte.standard_attr_id_variance, avg_vars.avg_standard_attr_id_variance FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(standard_attr_id_variance) AS avg_standard_attr_id_variance FROM inner_cte ) AS avg_vars ), status_owner_volume AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.earliest_standard_attr_update, a.avg_port_count AS benchmark, CASE WHEN i.port_count > a.avg_port_count * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VOLUME' WHEN i.port_count < a.avg_port_count * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VOLUME' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VOLUME' END AS volume_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_cte a ) SELECT sov.port_status, sov.device_owner, sov.port_count, sov.earliest_standard_attr_update, sov.benchmark, sov.volume_category, isv.standard_attr_id_variance, isv.avg_standard_attr_id_variance FROM status_owner_volume AS sov JOIN ip_status_variance AS isv ON isv.status = sov.port_status;

question: For subnets on networks shared via RBAC with action `access_as_shared` to target tenant `1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b`, return only those subnets (matched by subnet name) whose IPv4 DNS nameserver order coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is above the overall average (excluding subnets on networks shared to `*` or tenant `9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b`), and list the subnet name, CIDR, RBAC target tenant, the running sum of standard attribute IDs within each IP version ordered by standard attribute ID, the deviation of each subnet’s standard attribute ID from the filtered-subnet average, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP). sql: WITH SubnetRbacWindowAndDeviation AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, n.TARGET_TENANT AS rbac_target_tenant, SUM(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.IP_VERSION ORDER BY s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN NETWORKRBACS AS n ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b')), AvgStdAttr AS (SELECT AVG(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN NETWORKRBACS AS n ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b')) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.subnet_cidr, i.rbac_target_tenant, i.window_column, (s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID - a.avg_standard_attr_id) AS deviation_from_avg_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBNETS s ON s.NAME = i.subnet_name AND s.CIDR = i.subnet_cidr CROSS JOIN AvgStdAttr a), SubnetDnsCvAboveAvg AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, STDDEV(d.order) / NULLIF(AVG(d.order), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM subnets AS s JOIN dnsnameservers AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN ipallocationpools AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id JOIN networks AS n ON n.id = s.network_id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT r.object_id FROM networkrbacs AS r WHERE r.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (r.target_tenant = '*' OR r.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY s.name HAVING AVG(d.order) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN subnets AS s ON s.name = i.subnet_name WHERE i.coefficient_of_variation > ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) FROM inner_cte ) ORDER BY i.coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT s1.subnet_name, s1.subnet_cidr, s1.rbac_target_tenant, s1.window_column, s1.deviation_from_avg_standard_attr_id, s2.coefficient_of_variation FROM SubnetRbacWindowAndDeviation AS s1 JOIN SubnetDnsCvAboveAvg AS s2 ON s2.subnet_name = s1.subnet_name WHERE s1.rbac_target_tenant IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b') ORDER BY s2.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, STDDEV(d.order) / NULLIF(AVG(d.order), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM subnets AS s JOIN dnsnameservers AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN ipallocationpools AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id JOIN networks AS n ON n.id = s.network_id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT r.object_id FROM networkrbacs AS r WHERE r.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (r.target_tenant = '*' OR r.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY s.name HAVING AVG(d.order) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN subnets AS s ON s.name = i.subnet_name WHERE i.coefficient_of_variation > ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) FROM inner_cte ) ORDER BY i.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: Return (1) the count of ports that are DOWN in network ID `0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d` with security-group bindings and the average deviation of each port’s windowed minimum `admin_state_up` from the overall average of that windowed minimum, together with (2) the TOTAL number of IP allocations and TOTAL number of subnet-id rows for administratively up ports in tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57` that have at least one IP allocation. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH q1_inner_cte AS (SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d')), q1_avg_window AS (SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM q1_inner_cte), q1 AS ( SELECT i.NAME, i.NETWORK_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, i.ADMIN_STATE_UP, i.STATUS, i.DEVICE_OWNER, i.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, i.window_column, (i.window_column - a.avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_avg_window_min FROM q1_inner_cte i CROSS JOIN q1_avg_window a ), q2_inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ), q2 AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(port_id) OVER (ORDER BY port_id_sort, port_id) = port_id THEN NULL ELSE port_id END AS port_id, tenant_id, mac_address, ip_allocation_count, subnet_id_rows FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.port_id) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.port_id END AS port_id_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.port_id) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.port_id END AS port_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.port_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE i.tenant_id END AS tenant_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.port_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE i.mac_address END AS mac_address, SUM(i.ip_allocation_count) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(i.subnet_id_rows) AS subnet_id_rows FROM q2_inner_cte i GROUP BY i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.mac_address WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY port_id_sort, port_id ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS Down_Ports_In_Network_With_SG_Bindings, AVG(q1.deviation_from_avg_window_min) AS Avg_Deviation_From_Avg_Window_Min_Admin_State_Up, MAX(CASE WHEN q2.port_id = 'TOTAL' THEN q2.ip_allocation_count END) AS Total_Ip_Allocations_For_Admin_Up_Ports_In_Tenant, MAX(CASE WHEN q2.port_id = 'TOTAL' THEN q2.subnet_id_rows END) AS Total_Subnet_Id_Rows_For_Admin_Up_Ports_In_Tenant FROM q1 CROSS JOIN q2;

question: For tenant ID '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7' and port status 'DOWN', list the top 10 device owners (with security-group-bound ports) showing their distinct port count, minimum standard attribute ID, whether any of their ports have multiple security group bindings, the maximum number of ports owned by any single device owner for that same port status among non-shared networks with standard attribute resource type 'ports', and the normalized ratio (device owner distinct port count divided by that per-status maximum).
sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER) SELECT port_status, MAX(port_count) AS max_ports_for_any_device_owner FROM inner_cte GROUP BY port_status ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ) SELECT i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.min_standard_attr_id, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT spb2.security_group_id) > COUNT(DISTINCT p2.id) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_multi_sg_bindings FROM inner_cte i JOIN ports p2 ON p2.status = i.port_status AND p2.device_owner = i.device_owner AND p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') JOIN securitygroupportbindings spb2 ON p2.id = spb2.port_id GROUP BY i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.min_standard_attr_id ORDER BY i.port_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT q2.port_status, q2.device_owner, q2.port_count AS distinct_port_count, q2.min_standard_attr_id, q2.has_multi_sg_bindings, q1.max_ports_for_any_device_owner, ROUND(q2.port_count / NULLIF(q1.max_ports_for_any_device_owner, 0), 2) AS normalized_device_owner_port_count_ratio FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q1.port_status = q2.port_status ORDER BY normalized_device_owner_port_count_ratio DESC, q2.port_count DESC;

question: For tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57", list each ACTIVE network and its MTU details (including the network’s average-MTU benchmark, MTU category, and row number within the tenant by network name) together with all administratively-up ports on that network (including host, VIF/VNIC type, MAC/status/device owner, the 2-preceding-to-2-following window average of standard attribute IDs by VIF type, and the VIF-type port-count benchmark and user category). sql: WITH network_mtu_details AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(tenant_id) OVER (ORDER BY tenant_id_sort, tenant_id, network_name) = tenant_id THEN NULL ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, network_id, network_name, admin_state_up, mtu, standard_attr_updated_at, window_column, total_networks FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE network_id END AS network_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE network_name END AS network_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE admin_state_up END AS admin_state_up, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE mtu END AS mtu, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE standard_attr_updated_at END AS standard_attr_updated_at, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE window_column END AS window_column, COUNT(*) AS total_networks FROM inner_cte GROUP BY tenant_id, network_id, network_name, admin_state_up, mtu, standard_attr_updated_at, window_column WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY tenant_id_sort, tenant_id, network_name;

question: For tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, list ports that (1) are administratively up and have a VIF-type windowed average standard attribute ID (2 preceding and 2 following, ordered by standard attribute ID) greater than the overall average for that VIF type, and that also (2) appear among DOWN ports whose running sum of standard attribute ID within each security group (ordered by standard attribute ID) is greater than the average running sum across those DOWN ports. Return the port ID, host, VIF type, VNIC type, tenant ID, network ID, MAC address, status, device owner, the admin-up windowed average metric, and the DOWN-port running-sum metric. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH down_ports AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')) SELECT port_id, tenant_id, mac_address, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > (SELECT AVG(window_column) FROM inner_cte) ), admin_up_ports AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), VifTypeAverages AS ( SELECT VIF_TYPE, AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte GROUP BY VIF_TYPE ) SELECT i.PORT_ID, i.HOST, i.VIF_TYPE, i.VNIC_TYPE, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, i.STATUS, i.DEVICE_OWNER, i.window_column FROM inner_cte i JOIN VifTypeAverages v ON v.VIF_TYPE = i.VIF_TYPE WHERE i.window_column > v.avg_window_column ) SELECT a.PORT_ID, a.HOST, a.VIF_TYPE, a.VNIC_TYPE, a.TENANT_ID, a.NETWORK_ID, a.MAC_ADDRESS, a.STATUS, a.DEVICE_OWNER, a.window_column AS admin_up_windowed_avg_standard_attr_id, d.window_column AS down_running_sum_standard_attr_id FROM admin_up_ports a JOIN down_ports d ON d.port_id = a.PORT_ID ORDER BY a.window_column DESC, d.window_column DESC;

question: For RBAC entries restricted to the access_as_shared action, list each RBAC action whose referenced subnets have an average IP version greater than 4, and show (1) the average, range (max minus min), and variance of subnet IP version across the referenced subnets, along with (2) the maximum average, maximum variance, and maximum standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP version computed for that same action. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.ACTION AS rbac_action, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, MAX(s.IP_VERSION) - MIN(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_range, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION IN (4, 6) AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_range DESC) SELECT rbac_action, avg_ip_version, ip_version_range, ip_version_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_ip_version > 4 ORDER BY ip_version_range DESC ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ) SELECT i.ACTION, MAX(i.avg_ip_version) AS max_avg_ip_version, MAX(i.ip_version_variance) AS max_ip_version_variance, MAX(i.ip_version_stddev) AS max_ip_version_stddev FROM inner_cte i JOIN NETWORKRBACS n2 ON n2.ACTION = i.ACTION GROUP BY i.ACTION ) SELECT q1.rbac_action, q1.avg_ip_version, q1.ip_version_range, q1.ip_version_variance, q2.max_avg_ip_version, q2.max_ip_version_variance, q2.max_ip_version_stddev FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.ACTION = q1.rbac_action ORDER BY q1.ip_version_range DESC;

question: For the top 10 administratively up ports belonging to tenant `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57` with the most IP allocations, list each port’s ID, tenant ID, MAC address, IP allocation count, subnet-id row count from those allocations, and whether the port has any floating IPs; also show (in the same result) for tenant `17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7` the total number of ports that are `DOWN` with port security enabled and whether any of those ports have floating IPs allocated. sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL AND p.tenant_id IN 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_floating_ips FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN floatingips f ON i.port_id = f.fixed_port_id GROUP BY i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.mac_address, i.ip_allocation_count, i.subnet_id_rows ORDER BY i.ip_allocation_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS down_ports_with_port_security_enabled FROM PORTS p JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND psb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') ) SELECT p.tenant_id, inner_cte.down_ports_with_port_security_enabled AS total_down_ports_with_port_security_enabled, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT f.id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_floating_ips FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON p.id = psb.port_id LEFT JOIN floatingips f ON p.id = f.fixed_port_id CROSS JOIN inner_cte WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND psb.port_security_enabled = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.tenant_id, inner_cte.down_ports_with_port_security_enabled ) SELECT s1.port_id, s1.tenant_id AS tenant_id_admin_up_top_ip_allocations, s1.mac_address, s1.ip_allocation_count, s1.subnet_id_rows, s1.has_floating_ips AS port_has_floating_ips, s2.tenant_id AS tenant_id_down_ports_port_security_enabled, s2.total_down_ports_with_port_security_enabled, s2.has_floating_ips AS down_ports_have_any_floating_ips FROM subq1 s1 CROSS JOIN subq2 s2;

question: For each RBAC action (including subtotals per action and a grand total), show whether the counted ACTIVE, non-shared networks are External or Internal and the number of such networks, along with the subnet IP-version statistics (average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP)) computed for the “access_as_shared” RBAC action on IPv4 subnets; also compute the share of each External/Internal count within its action total.
sql: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM networksecuritybindings b JOIN networks n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN networkrbacs r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') )), ActionExternalSummary AS (SELECT i.action, CASE WHEN en.network_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'External' ELSE 'Internal' END AS external_status, COUNT(*) AS total_rows FROM inner_cte i JOIN networks n ON n.name = i.name AND n.status = i.status AND n.admin_state_up = i.admin_state_up LEFT JOIN externalnetworks en ON n.id = en.network_id GROUP BY i.action, external_status) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(action) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE action END AS action, CASE WHEN GROUPING(external_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(action) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE external_status END AS external_status, SUM(total_rows) AS total_rows FROM ActionExternalSummary GROUP BY action, external_status WITH ROLLUP), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(action) OVER (ORDER BY action_sort, action) = action THEN NULL ELSE action END AS action, avg_ip_version, ip_version_variance, ip_version_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.action) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.action END AS action_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.action) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.action END AS action, AVG(i.avg_ip_version) AS avg_ip_version, AVG(i.ip_version_variance) AS ip_version_variance, AVG(i.ip_version_stddev) AS ip_version_stddev FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.action WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY action_sort) SELECT q1.action, q1.external_status, q1.total_rows, q2.avg_ip_version, q2.ip_version_variance, q2.ip_version_stddev, ROUND(q1.total_rows / NULLIF(SUM(q1.total_rows) OVER (PARTITION BY q1.action), 0), 4) AS sub_sqls: SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM networksecuritybindings b JOIN networks n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN networkrbacs r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') )

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM networksecuritybindings b JOIN networks n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN networkrbacs r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') )), ActionExternalSummary AS (SELECT i.action, CASE WHEN en.network_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'External' ELSE 'Internal' END AS external_status, COUNT(*) AS total_rows FROM inner_cte i JOIN networks n ON n.name = i.name AND n.status = i.status AND n.admin_state_up = i.admin_state_up LEFT JOIN externalnetworks en ON n.id = en.network_id GROUP BY i.action, external_status) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(action) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE action END AS action, CASE WHEN GROUPING(external_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(action) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE external_status END AS external_status, SUM(total_rows) AS total_rows FROM ActionExternalSummary GROUP BY action, external_status WITH ROLLUP;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(action) OVER (ORDER BY action_sort, action) = action THEN NULL ELSE action END AS action, avg_ip_version, ip_version_variance, ip_version_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.action) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.action END AS action_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.action) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.action END AS action, AVG(i.avg_ip_version) AS avg_ip_version, AVG(i.ip_version_variance) AS ip_version_variance, AVG(i.ip_version_stddev) AS ip_version_stddev FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.action WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY action_sort;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), avg_mtu_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(mtu) AS avg_mtu FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.network_id, i.network_name, i.tenant_id, i.admin_state_up, i.mtu, i.standard_attr_updated_at, i.window_column, (i.mtu - a.avg_mtu) AS deviation_from_avg_mtu FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_mtu_cte a;

'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n2.id ) AS per_network )) SELECT inner_cte.network_id, inner_cte.total_subnets, stats.avg_subnet_count FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(subnet_cnt) AS avg_subnet_count FROM r2.action = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n2.id ) AS per_network ) AS stats ON 1 = 1), nonshared_active_network_ranks AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM networksecuritybindings b JOIN networks n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN networkrbacs r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR question: For tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57', for each ACTIVE network, return the network’s ID, name, admin_state_up flag, MTU, standard attribute updated_at timestamp, its row number within the tenant ordered by network name, and its MTU deviation from the average MTU; additionally, for each such network, report how many admin_state_up=1 ports on that network are bound to a security group, the average DNS record count across those ports, and how many of those ports are categorized as HIGH_DNS, LOW_DNS, or AVERAGE_DNS (relative to the tenant-wide average DNS record benchmark used for the ports). Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each port as 'HIGH_DNS' (at least 50% more than average), 'LOW_DNS' (at least 50% less than average), or 'AVERAGE_DNS'.
sql: WITH PortDnsAndSg AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN PORTDNSES pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name ), AverageDns AS ( SELECT AVG(dns_record_count) AS avg_dns_records FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.port_id, ic.tenant_id, ic.port_name, ic.security_group_binding_count, ic.dns_record_count, ad.avg_dns_records AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.dns_record_count > ad.avg_dns_records * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_DNS' WHEN ic.dns_record_count < ad.avg_dns_records * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_DNS' ELSE 'AVERAGE_DNS' END AS dns_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageDns ad ), ActiveNetworksMtu AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), avg_mtu_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(mtu) AS avg_mtu FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.network_id, i.network_name, i.tenant_id, i.admin_state_up, i.mtu, i.standard_attr_updated_at, i.window_column, (i.mtu - a.avg_mtu) AS deviation_from_avg_mtu FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_mtu_cte a ) SELECT an.network_id, an.network_name, an.tenant_id, an.admin_state_up AS network_admin_state_up, an.mtu, an.standard_attr_updated_at, an.window_column, an.deviation_from_avg_mtu, COUNT(DISTINCT pds.port_id) AS admin_up_sg_bound_port_count, AVG(pds.dns_record_count) AS avg_dns_records_per_port, SUM(CASE WHEN pds.dns_category = 'HIGH_DNS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_dns_port_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pds.dns_category = 'LOW_DNS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_dns_port_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pds.dns_category = 'AVERAGE_DNS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS average_dns_port_count FROM ActiveNetworksMtu an JOIN PORTS p ON p.network_id = an.network_id AND p.tenant_id = an.tenant_id AND p.admin_state_up = 1 JOIN PortDnsAndSg pds ON pds.port_id = p.id AND pds.tenant_id = an.tenant_id GROUP BY an.network_id, an.network_name, an.tenant_id, an.admin_state_up, an.mtu, an.standard_attr_updated_at, an.window_column, an.deviation_from_avg_mtu ORDER BY an.tenant_id, an.network_name;

sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.STATUS, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' AND p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS) SELECT b.VIF_TYPE, MAX(inner_cte.min_admin_state_up) AS max_of_min_admin_state_up, MAX(inner_cte.avg_standard_attr_id) AS max_of_avg_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte JOIN PORTS p ON p.STATUS = inner_cte.STATUS JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY b.VIF_TYPE ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, p.TENANT_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE b.HOST = 'drive-59' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')), PortRollup AS (SELECT b.VIF_TYPE, p.STATUS AS port_status, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.PORT_ID) AS total_ports FROM inner_cte JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b ON inner_cte.PORT_ID = b.PORT_ID JOIN PORTS AS p ON inner_cte.PORT_ID = p.ID GROUP BY b.VIF_TYPE, p.STATUS) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(VIF_TYPE) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE VIF_TYPE END AS VIF_TYPE, CASE WHEN GROUPING(port_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(VIF_TYPE) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE port_status END AS port_status, SUM(total_ports) AS total_ports FROM PortRollup GROUP BY VIF_TYPE, port_status WITH ROLLUP ) SELECT subq2.VIF_TYPE, subq2.port_status, subq2.total_ports, subq1.max_of_min_admin_state_up, subq1.max_of_avg_standard_attr_id FROM subq2 LEFT JOIN subq1 ON subq2.VIF_TYPE = subq1.VIF_TYPE;

question: Show the rolled-up subnet summary (subnet name, gateway IP, max IP version, and number of groups) for subnets on networks shared via RBAC action 'access_as_shared' with public target tenant ('*') where the max IP version is greater than 3, alongside the rolled-up counts of distinct subnets by IP version for networks shared via the same RBAC action with target tenant '1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b' (including subtotals and grand totals for both summaries). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.name, MAX(s.ip_version) AS max_ip_version, s.gateway_ip FROM NETWORKRBACS n JOIN SUBNETS s ON n.object_id = s.network_id WHERE n.action = 'access_as_shared' AND n.target_tenant = '*' GROUP BY s.name, s.gateway_ip HAVING MAX(s.ip_version) > 3 ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE name END AS name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(gateway_ip) = 1 AND GROUPING(name) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(gateway_ip) = 1 AND GROUPING(name) = 1 THEN 'ALL' ELSE gateway_ip END AS gateway_ip, MAX(max_ip_version) AS max_ip_version, COUNT(*) AS total_groups FROM inner_cte GROUP BY name, gateway_ip WITH ROLLUP ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, n.TARGET_TENANT AS rbac_target_tenant, SUM(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY s.IP_VERSION ORDER BY s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN NETWORKRBACS AS n ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b') ), SubnetCounts AS ( SELECT s.IP_VERSION, i.rbac_target_tenant, COUNT(DISTINCT s.ID) AS total_subnets FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBNETS s ON s.NAME = i.subnet_name AND s.CIDR = i.subnet_cidr GROUP BY s.IP_VERSION, i.rbac_target_tenant ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(IP_VERSION) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE CAST(IP_VERSION AS CHAR) END AS ip_version, CASE WHEN GROUPING(rbac_target_tenant) = 1 AND GROUPING(IP_VERSION) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE rbac_target_tenant END AS rbac_target_tenant, SUM(total_subnets) AS total_subnets FROM SubnetCounts GROUP BY IP_VERSION, rbac_target_tenant WITH ROLLUP ) SELECT q1.name AS subnet_name, q1.gateway_ip, q1.max_ip_version, q1.total_groups, q2.ip_version, q2.rbac_target_tenant, q2.total_subnets FROM q1 CROSS JOIN q2;

JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), SecurityGroupPorts AS ( SELECT security_group_id, sql: WITH MaxPortsPerStatus AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER) SELECT port_status, MAX(port_count) AS max_ports_for_any_device_owner FROM inner_cte GROUP BY port_status), PortSecurityBindingSpreadByStatus AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC) SELECT ic.status, ic.binding_count_range, ic.binding_count_variance, ic.binding_count_stddev, CASE WHEN ic.binding_count_range >= 5 THEN 'HIGH_SPREAD' ELSE 'LOW_SPREAD' END AS spread_category FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN ports AS p3 ON p3.status = ic.status GROUP BY ic.status, ic.binding_count_range, ic.binding_count_variance, ic.binding_count_stddev ORDER BY ic.binding_count_range DESC) SELECT mpps.port_status, mpps.max_ports_for_any_device_owner, psbs.binding_count_range, psbs.binding_count_variance, psbs.binding_count_stddev, psbs.spread_category FROM MaxPortsPerStatus AS mpps JOIN PortSecurityBindingSpreadByStatus AS psbs ON psbs.status = mpps.port_status ORDER BY psbs.binding_count_range DESC;

sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.status, STDDEV(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) / NULLIF(AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM portsecuritybindings psb JOIN ports p ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON p.id = ia.port_id WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1 AND ia.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.status, i.coefficient_of_variation, (i.coefficient_of_variation - a.avg_coefficient_of_variation) AS deviation_from_avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_cte a ORDER BY deviation_from_avg_coefficient_of_variation DESC ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, VARIANCE(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM PORTS AS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NOT NULL AND ia.IP_ADDRESS IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.STATUS ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.status, inner_cte.standard_attr_id_variance, avg_vars.avg_standard_attr_id_variance FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(standard_attr_id_variance) AS avg_standard_attr_id_variance FROM inner_cte ) AS avg_vars ) SELECT q1.status, q1.coefficient_of_variation, q1.deviation_from_avg_coefficient_of_variation, q2.standard_attr_id_variance, q2.avg_standard_attr_id_variance FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.status = q2.status ORDER BY q1.deviation_from_avg_coefficient_of_variation DESC;
