sub_sqls: SELECT p.status, STDDEV(p.standard_attr_id) / NULLIF(AVG(p.standard_attr_id), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM securitygroupportbindings AS sgpb JOIN ports AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN portsecuritybindings AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(p.standard_attr_id) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER;

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.status, STDDEV(p.standard_attr_id) / NULLIF(AVG(p.standard_attr_id), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM securitygroupportbindings AS sgpb JOIN ports AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN portsecuritybindings AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(p.standard_attr_id) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT i.status, i.coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_ports, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT f.id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_floating_ips FROM inner_cte i JOIN ports p ON p.status = i.status AND p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') JOIN securitygroupportbindings sgpb ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN floatingips f ON f.fixed_port_id = p.id GROUP BY i.status, i.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY i.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ) SELECT i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.min_standard_attr_id, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT spb2.security_group_id) > COUNT(DISTINCT p2.id) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_multi_sg_bindings FROM inner_cte i JOIN ports p2 ON p2.status = i.port_status AND p2.device_owner = i.device_owner AND p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') JOIN securitygroupportbindings spb2 ON p2.id = spb2.port_id GROUP BY i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.min_standard_attr_id ORDER BY i.port_count DESC LIMIT 10;

ORDER BY r.SUBNET_ID) AS window_column FROM SUBNETROUTES r JOIN SUBNETS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')) SELECT subnet_name, subnet_cidr, MAX(destination_count) AS max_destinations_per_nexthop FROM (SELECT subnet_name, subnet_cidr, NEXTHOP, COUNT(DISTINCT DESTINATION) AS destination_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY subnet_name, subnet_cidr, NEXTHOP) t GROUP BY subnet_name, subnet_cidr ), top_routes_and_pools AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT r.DESTINATION, r.NEXTHOP, s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.SUBNET_ID ORDER BY r.SUBNET_ID) AS window_column FROM SUBNETROUTES r JOIN SUBNETS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')) SELECT s.ID AS subnet_id, s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, COUNT(DISTINCT r.DESTINATION) AS total_routes, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_allocation_pools FROM SUBNETS s LEFT JOIN SUBNETROUTES r ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID LEFT JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS p ON p.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN inner_cte i ON i.subnet_name = s.NAME AND i.subnet_cidr = s.CIDR WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.ID, s.NAME, s.CIDR ORDER BY total_routes DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT t.subnet_id, t.subnet_name, t.subnet_cidr, t.total_routes, m.max_destinations_per_nexthop, ROUND(m.max_destinations_per_nexthop / NULLIF(t.total_routes, 0), 2) AS max_nexthop_destination_share, t.has_allocation_pools FROM top_routes_and_pools t JOIN max_dest_per_nexthop m ON m.subnet_name = t.subnet_name AND m.subnet_cidr = t.subnet_cidr ORDER BY max_nexthop_destination_share DESC, t.total_routes DESC;

sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), VifTypeCounts AS ( SELECT VIF_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS ports_in_vif_type FROM inner_cte GROUP BY VIF_TYPE ), OverallWindowAvg AS ( SELECT AVG(window_column) AS overall_avg_window_column FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.PORT_ID, i.HOST, i.VIF_TYPE, i.VNIC_TYPE, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, i.STATUS, i.DEVICE_OWNER, i.window_column, vtc.ports_in_vif_type, (i.window_column - owa.overall_avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_overall_window_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN VifTypeCounts AS vtc ON i.VIF_TYPE = vtc.VIF_TYPE CROSS JOIN OverallWindowAvg AS owa ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') ) SELECT i.NAME, i.NETWORK_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, i.ADMIN_STATE_UP, i.STATUS, i.DEVICE_OWNER, i.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i WHERE i.window_column < (SELECT AVG(window_column) FROM inner_cte) ) SELECT q1.VIF_TYPE, q1.ports_in_vif_type, COUNT(DISTINCT q2.SECURITY_GROUP_ID) AS distinct_security_groups_on_down_ports_in_network, ROUND( COUNT(DISTINCT q2.SECURITY_GROUP_ID) / NULLIF(q1.ports_in_vif_type, 0), 2 ) AS security_groups_per_up_port_ratio FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.NETWORK_ID = q2.NETWORK_ID GROUP BY q1.VIF_TYPE, q1.ports_in_vif_type ORDER BY security_groups_per_up_port_ratio DESC;

question: For ports that have an IP allocation with IP address 10.150.64.113/8, what is (1) the variance of STANDARD_ATTR_ID by port STATUS including subtotals by status and a grand total, and (2) for each STATUS the same variance alongside the overall average of these per-status variances? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH rollup_vars AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, VARIANCE(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM PORTS AS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NOT NULL AND ia.IP_ADDRESS IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.STATUS ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE status END AS status, SUM(standard_attr_id_variance) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY status WITH ROLLUP ), status_vars_with_avg AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, VARIANCE(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM PORTS AS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NOT NULL AND ia.IP_ADDRESS IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.STATUS ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.status, inner_cte.standard_attr_id_variance, avg_vars.avg_standard_attr_id_variance FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(standard_attr_id_variance) AS avg_standard_attr_id_variance FROM inner_cte ) AS avg_vars ), avg_only AS (SELECT DISTINCT avg_standard_attr_id_variance FROM status_vars_with_avg) SELECT rv.status, rv.standard_attr_id_variance AS rollup_standard_attr_id_variance, sva.standard_attr_id_variance AS per_status_standard_attr_id_variance, ao.avg_standard_attr_id_variance FROM rollup_vars rv LEFT JOIN status_vars_with_avg sva ON rv.status = sva.status CROSS JOIN avg_only ao;

question: For RBAC actions that (a) have more than 5 DHCP-enabled subnets per network after excluding shared networks (networks with an `access_as_shared` RBAC entry targeting `'*'` or `9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b`), and that also appear in the top 10 `access_as_shared` actions by subnet IP-version range (considering only IP versions 4 and 6), return the action name, the maximum per-network standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP version, the average subnet IP version, the IP-version range, the variance of subnet IP version, and whether any referenced subnets have DHCP enabled. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.ACTION, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 AND s.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.ACTION HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY ip_version_stddev DESC) , inner_cte_2 AS ( SELECT n.ACTION AS rbac_action, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, MAX(s.IP_VERSION) - MIN(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_range, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION IN (4, 6) AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_range DESC ) SELECT q1.ACTION, q1.max_ip_version_stddev, q2.avg_ip_version, q2.ip_version_range, q2.ip_version_variance, q2.has_dhcp_enabled_subnets FROM (SELECT n.ACTION, MAX(inner_cte.ip_version_stddev) AS max_ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID JOIN inner_cte ON inner_cte.ACTION = n.ACTION WHERE s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 AND s.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY max_ip_version_stddev DESC) q1 JOIN (SELECT i.rbac_action, i.avg_ip_version, i.ip_version_range, i.ip_version_variance, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 THEN s.ID END) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_dhcp_enabled_subnets FROM inner_cte_2 i JOIN NETWORKRBACS n ON n.ACTION = i.rbac_action JOIN SUBNETS s ON s.NETWORK_ID = n.OBJECT_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION IN (4, 6) AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY i.rbac_action, i.avg_ip_version, i.ip_version_range, i.ip_version_variance ORDER BY i.ip_version_range DESC LIMIT 10) q2 ON q1.ACTION = q2.rbac_action ORDER BY q1.max_ip_version_stddev DESC;

o.overall_avg_ip_version) AS deviation_avg_ip_version, (i.ip_version_variance - o.overall_avg_variance) AS deviation_ip_version_variance, (i.ip_version_stddev - o.overall_avg_stddev) AS deviation_ip_version_stddev FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN overall_avgs o ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT = '*' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(ip_version_variance) AS avg_ip_version_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.ACTION, i.ip_version_variance, a.avg_ip_version_variance AS benchmark, CASE WHEN i.ip_version_variance > a.avg_ip_version_variance * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN i.ip_version_variance < a.avg_ip_version_variance * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_cte a ) SELECT q1.ACTION, q1.avg_ip_version, q1.ip_version_variance AS ip_version_variance_ipv4_only, q1.ip_version_stddev, q1.deviation_avg_ip_version, q1.deviation_ip_version_variance, q1.deviation_ip_version_stddev, q2.ip_version_variance AS ip_version_variance_public_access, q2.benchmark AS variance_benchmark_across_actions, q2.variance_category FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.ACTION = q2.ACTION ORDER BY q2.ip_version_variance DESC;

sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.earliest_standard_attr_update, (i.port_count - a.avg_port_count) AS deviation_from_avg_port_count FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_cte a ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ) SELECT i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.min_standard_attr_id, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT spb2.security_group_id) > COUNT(DISTINCT p2.id) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_multi_sg_bindings FROM inner_cte i JOIN ports p2 ON p2.status = i.port_status AND p2.device_owner = i.device_owner AND p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') JOIN securitygroupportbindings spb2 ON p2.id = spb2.port_id GROUP BY i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.min_standard_attr_id ORDER BY i.port_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT q2.port_status, q2.device_owner, q2.port_count AS distinct_port_count, q2.min_standard_attr_id, q2.has_multi_sg_bindings, q1.earliest_standard_attr_update, q1.deviation_from_avg_port_count FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q1.port_status = q2.port_status AND q1.device_owner = q2.device_owner ORDER BY q2.port_count DESC;

sql: WITH PortStatusOwnerRollup AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(port_status) OVER (ORDER BY port_status_sort, port_status, device_owner) = port_status THEN NULL ELSE port_status END AS port_status, device_owner, port_count, earliest_standard_attr_update FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.port_status) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.port_status END AS port_status_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.port_status) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.port_status END AS port_status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.device_owner) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE i.device_owner END AS device_owner, SUM(i.port_count) AS port_count, MIN(i.earliest_standard_attr_update) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.port_status, i.device_owner WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY port_status_sort, port_status, device_owner ), PortStatusBindingStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(binding_count_range) AS avg_binding_count_range FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.status, i.binding_count_range, i.binding_count_variance, i.binding_count_stddev, (i.binding_count_range - a.avg_binding_count_range) AS deviation_from_avg_binding_count_range FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_cte a ORDER BY i.binding_count_range DESC ), CombinedStatusMetrics AS ( SELECT psor.port_status AS port_status, psor.device_owner AS device_owner, psor.port_count AS port_count, psor.earliest_standard_attr_update AS earliest_standard_attr_update, NULL AS binding_count_range, NULL AS binding_count_variance, NULL AS binding_count_stddev, NULL AS deviation_from_avg_binding_count_range, 'Port Count / Earliest Update (non-shared networks)' AS metric_type FROM PortStatusOwnerRollup psor UNION ALL SELECT psbs.status AS port_status, NULL AS device_owner, NULL AS port_count, NULL AS earliest_standard_attr_update, psbs.binding_count_range AS binding_count_range, psbs.binding_count_variance AS binding_count_variance, psbs.binding_count_stddev AS binding_count_stddev, psbs.deviation_from_avg_binding_count_range AS deviation_from_avg_binding_count_range, 'Port Security Binding Stats (tenant 17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7)' AS metric_type FROM PortStatusBindingStats psbs ) SELECT port_status, device_owner, port_count, earliest_standard_attr_update, binding_count_range, binding_count_variance, binding_count_stddev, deviation_from_avg_binding_count_range, metric_type FROM CombinedStatusMetrics ORDER BY port_status, metric_type, device_owner;

sql: WITH rbac_action_ip_version_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.ACTION, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACTION, inner_cte.avg_ip_version, inner_cte.ip_version_variance, inner_cte.ip_version_stddev, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 THEN s.ID END) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_dhcp_enabled_subnets FROM inner_cte JOIN NETWORKRBACS AS n ON n.ACTION = inner_cte.ACTION JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON s.NETWORK_ID = n.OBJECT_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY inner_cte.ACTION, inner_cte.avg_ip_version, inner_cte.ip_version_variance, inner_cte.ip_version_stddev ORDER BY inner_cte.ip_version_variance DESC LIMIT 10 ), public_shared_subnet_pairs AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.name, MAX(s.ip_version) AS max_ip_version, s.gateway_ip FROM NETWORKRBACS n JOIN SUBNETS s ON n.object_id = s.network_id WHERE n.action = 'access_as_shared' AND n.target_tenant = '*' GROUP BY s.name, s.gateway_ip HAVING MAX(s.ip_version) > 3) SELECT i.name, i.gateway_ip, i.max_ip_version, CASE WHEN MAX(s.enable_dhcp) = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_dhcp_enabled FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBNETS s ON s.name = i.name AND s.gateway_ip = i.gateway_ip GROUP BY i.name, i.gateway_ip, i.max_ip_version ORDER BY i.max_ip_version DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT p.name AS subnet_name, p.gateway_ip, p.max_ip_version, p.has_dhcp_enabled, a.ACTION, a.avg_ip_version, a.ip_version_variance, a.ip_version_stddev, a.has_dhcp_enabled_subnets FROM public_shared_subnet_pairs p JOIN rbac_action_ip_version_stats a ON a.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' ORDER BY p.max_ip_version DESC, p.name, p.gateway_ip;

For each subnet name and its gateway IP, find the maximum IP version among subnets whose network has a RBAC action of 'access_as_shared' **and whose RBAC target tenant is public (i.e., `'*'`)**, and only keep subnet name/gateway IP groups where that maximum IP version is greater than 3.

Among the top 10 RBAC actions (restricted to "access_as_shared") with the highest subnet IP-version variance across referenced subnets, show the action, the average/variance/standard deviation of subnet IP version, and whether any of those referenced subnets have DHCP enabled.

Among the top 10 subnet name/gateway IP pairs (ranked by the maximum IP version) for subnets whose network has an RBAC action of 'access_as_shared' and whose RBAC target tenant is public (`'*'`), show the subnet name, gateway IP, that maximum IP version, and whether any of those subnets have DHCP enabled.
sub_sqls: SELECT n.ACTION, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC;

SELECT s.name, MAX(s.ip_version) AS max_ip_version, s.gateway_ip FROM NETWORKRBACS n JOIN SUBNETS s ON n.object_id = s.network_id WHERE n.action = 'access_as_shared' AND n.target_tenant = '*' GROUP BY s.name, s.gateway_ip HAVING MAX(s.ip_version) > 3;

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.ACTION, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACTION, inner_cte.avg_ip_version, inner_cte.ip_version_variance, inner_cte.ip_version_stddev, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 THEN s.ID END) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_dhcp_enabled_subnets FROM inner_cte JOIN NETWORKRBACS AS n ON n.ACTION = inner_cte.ACTION JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON s.NETWORK_ID = n.OBJECT_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY inner_cte.ACTION, inner_cte.avg_ip_version, inner_cte.ip_version_variance, inner_cte.ip_version_stddev ORDER BY inner_cte.ip_version_variance DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.name, MAX(s.ip_version) AS max_ip_version, s.gateway_ip FROM NETWORKRBACS n JOIN SUBNETS s ON n.object_id = s.network_id WHERE n.action = 'access_as_shared' AND n.target_tenant = '*' GROUP BY s.name, s.gateway_ip HAVING MAX(s.ip_version) > 3) SELECT i.name, i.gateway_ip, i.max_ip_version, CASE WHEN MAX(s.enable_dhcp) = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_dhcp_enabled FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBNETS s ON s.name = i.name AND s.gateway_ip = i.gateway_ip GROUP BY i.name, i.gateway_ip, i.max_ip_version ORDER BY i.max_ip_version DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For DOWN ports on network ID '0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d', list the port name, (non-repeated) network ID, MAC address, admin state, status, device owner, bound security group ID, the windowed minimum admin_state_up (3 preceding to 1 following ordered by port ID), and the subtotal count of matching ports per network; additionally, for any of these rows whose MAC address matches a DOWN port owned by tenant '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7' with a running sum of standard attribute IDs (partitioned by resource type and ordered by standard attribute ID) greater than 1000, also show that port’s ID, tenant ID, and the running-sum value. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(sa.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY sa.RESOURCE_TYPE ORDER BY sa.ID) AS window_column FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')) SELECT port_id, tenant_id, mac_address, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > 1000 ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(network_id) OVER (ORDER BY network_id_sort, network_id, name, mac_address, security_group_id) = network_id THEN NULL ELSE network_id END AS network_id, name, mac_address, admin_state_up, status, device_owner, security_group_id, window_column, total_ports FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.network_id) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.network_id END AS network_id_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.network_id) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.network_id END AS network_id, i.name, i.mac_address, i.admin_state_up, i.status, i.device_owner, i.security_group_id, i.window_column, COUNT(*) AS total_ports FROM inner_cte AS i GROUP BY i.network_id, i.name, i.mac_address, i.admin_state_up, i.status, i.device_owner, i.security_group_id, i.window_column WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY network_id_sort, network_id, name, mac_address, security_group_id ) SELECT q2.network_id, q2.name, q2.mac_address, q2.admin_state_up, q2.status, q2.device_owner, q2.security_group_id, q2.window_column AS min_admin_state_window, q2.total_ports, q1.port_id, q1.tenant_id, q1.window_column AS running_sum_standard_attr_ids FROM q2 LEFT JOIN q1 ON q1.mac_address = q2.mac_address ORDER BY q2.network_id, q2.name, q2.mac_address, q2.security_group_id;

question: For ACTIVE networks belonging to tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57", return (1) the rollup summary grouped by admin_state_up showing the admin_state_up label (including a GRAND TOTAL row), the number of networks, and the maximum standard attribute updated_at timestamp, and (2) the per-network details (network ID, name, tenant ID, admin_state_up, MTU, standard attribute updated_at, row number within the tenant ordered by network name, and each network’s MTU deviation from the average MTU), aligned to the matching admin_state_up group. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH net_rollup AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(admin_state_up) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE CAST(admin_state_up AS CHAR) END AS admin_state_up, COUNT(DISTINCT network_id) AS total_networks, MAX(standard_attr_updated_at) AS max_standard_attr_updated_at FROM inner_cte GROUP BY admin_state_up WITH ROLLUP ), net_details AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), avg_mtu_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(mtu) AS avg_mtu FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.network_id, i.network_name, i.tenant_id, i.admin_state_up, i.mtu, i.standard_attr_updated_at, i.window_column, (i.mtu - a.avg_mtu) AS deviation_from_avg_mtu FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_mtu_cte a ) SELECT r.admin_state_up, r.total_networks, r.max_standard_attr_updated_at, d.network_id, d.network_name, d.tenant_id, d.mtu, d.standard_attr_updated_at, d.window_column, d.deviation_from_avg_mtu FROM net_rollup r LEFT JOIN net_details d ON r.admin_state_up = CAST(d.admin_state_up AS CHAR) ORDER BY CASE WHEN r.admin_state_up = 'GRAND TOTAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, r.admin_state_up, d.window_column;

question: For networks that are marked as default external networks (IS_DEFAULT = 0) and have the RBAC permission action set to 'access_as_external', list the (non-repeated) network name, its dense rank (ordered by the RBAC action using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows), the RBAC tenant ID and target tenant, the total number of matching networks, the average number of matching networks per tenant, and the ratio of total matching networks to the average per tenant (rounded to 2 decimals).
sql: WITH sq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.NAME, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY r.ACTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM EXTERNALNETWORKS e JOIN NETWORKS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID JOIN NETWORKRBACS r ON n.ID = r.OBJECT_ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND r.ACTION = 'access_as_external' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(inner_cte.NAME) OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.NAME, r.TENANT_ID) = inner_cte.NAME THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.NAME END AS name, inner_cte.window_column, r.TENANT_ID AS rbac_tenant_id, r.TARGET_TENANT AS rbac_target_tenant FROM inner_cte JOIN NETWORKS n ON n.NAME = inner_cte.NAME JOIN NETWORKRBACS r ON r.OBJECT_ID = n.ID AND r.ACTION = 'access_as_external' ORDER BY inner_cte.NAME, r.TENANT_ID ), sq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.NAME, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY r.ACTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM EXTERNALNETWORKS e JOIN NETWORKS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID JOIN NETWORKRBACS r ON n.ID = r.OBJECT_ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND r.ACTION = 'access_as_external' ), tenant_counts AS ( SELECT n.TENANT_ID, COUNT(*) AS tenant_network_count FROM EXTERNALNETWORKS e JOIN NETWORKS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID JOIN NETWORKRBACS r ON n.ID = r.OBJECT_ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND r.ACTION = 'access_as_external' GROUP BY n.TENANT_ID ), avg_counts AS ( SELECT AVG(tenant_network_count) AS avg_networks_per_tenant FROM tenant_counts ) SELECT inner_cte.NAME, inner_cte.window_column, totals.total_matching_networks, avg_counts.avg_networks_per_tenant FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_matching_networks FROM EXTERNALNETWORKS e JOIN NETWORKS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID JOIN NETWORKRBACS r ON n.ID = r.OBJECT_ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND r.ACTION = 'access_as_external' ) AS totals ON 1 = 1 JOIN avg_counts ON 1 = 1 ) SELECT sq1.name, sq1.window_column, sq1.rbac_tenant_id, sq1.rbac_target_tenant, sq2.total_matching_networks, sq2.avg_networks_per_tenant, ROUND(sq2.total_matching_networks / NULLIF(sq2.avg_networks_per_tenant, 0), 2) AS total_to_avg_ratio FROM sq1 JOIN sq2 ON sq2.NAME = sq1.name AND sq2.window_column = sq1.window_column ORDER BY sq1.name, sq1.rbac_tenant_id;

sql: WITH net_rollup AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(admin_state_up) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE CAST(admin_state_up AS CHAR) END AS admin_state_up, COUNT(DISTINCT network_id) AS total_networks, MAX(standard_attr_updated_at) AS max_standard_attr_updated_at FROM inner_cte GROUP BY admin_state_up WITH ROLLUP ), net_details AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), avg_mtu_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(mtu) AS avg_mtu FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.network_id, i.network_name, i.tenant_id, i.admin_state_up, i.mtu, i.standard_attr_updated_at, i.window_column, (i.mtu - a.avg_mtu) AS deviation_from_avg_mtu FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_mtu_cte a ) SELECT d.network_id, d.network_name, d.tenant_id, d.admin_state_up, d.mtu, d.standard_attr_updated_at, d.window_column, d.deviation_from_avg_mtu, r.total_networks, r.max_standard_attr_updated_at FROM net_details d JOIN net_rollup r ON r.admin_state_up = CAST(d.admin_state_up AS CHAR) WHERE r.total_networks >= 2 ORDER BY d.window_column, d.network_name;

question: For ports bound with VIF type 'ovs' and device_id 'da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7', list the rollup (including a TOTAL row) of port statuses, but only keep statuses that are in the top 10 by number of ports; for each returned status show the status, total number of ports, the minimum admin_state_up value, and the average standard_attr_id. sql: WITH Top10PortStatuses AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' AND p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS ) SELECT i.status, COUNT(DISTINCT p2.id) AS total_ports, i.min_admin_state_up, i.avg_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte i JOIN ports p2 ON p2.status = i.status JOIN ml2_port_bindings b2 ON p2.id = b2.port_id WHERE b2.vif_type = 'ovs' AND p2.device_id IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY i.status, i.min_admin_state_up, i.avg_standard_attr_id ORDER BY total_ports DESC LIMIT 10 ), StatusRollup AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' AND p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(status) OVER (ORDER BY status_sort, status) = status THEN NULL ELSE status END AS status, min_admin_state_up, avg_standard_attr_id FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE status END AS status_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE status END AS status, MIN(min_admin_state_up) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(avg_standard_attr_id) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte GROUP BY status WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY status_sort, status ) SELECT sr.status, t10.total_ports, sr.min_admin_state_up, sr.avg_standard_attr_id FROM StatusRollup sr LEFT JOIN Top10PortStatuses t10 ON t10.status = sr.status WHERE sr.status IN (SELECT status FROM Top10PortStatuses) OR sr.status = 'TOTAL' ORDER BY CASE WHEN sr.status = 'TOTAL' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END, sr.status;

a.avg_ip_allocation_count) AS deviation_from_avg_ip_allocations FROM inner_cte i JOIN ports p2 ON p2.id = i.port_id JOIN ipallocations ia2 ON ia2.port_id = p2.id CROSS JOIN avg_cte a WHERE ia2.ip_address IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.mac_address, i.ip_allocation_count, a.avg_ip_allocation_count ) SELECT n.network_id, n.network_name, n.tenant_id, n.admin_state_up AS network_admin_state_up, n.mtu, n.standard_attr_updated_at AS network_standard_attr_updated_at, n.window_column AS network_row_number_within_tenant, n.total_active_networks, n.avg_active_networks, p.port_id, p.mac_address, p.ip_allocation_count, p.distinct_subnet_count, p.deviation_from_avg_ip_allocations FROM networks_subq n JOIN ports prt ON prt.network_id = n.network_id AND prt.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') JOIN ports_subq p ON p.port_id = prt.id AND p.tenant_id = n.tenant_id ORDER BY n.tenant_id, n.network_name, p.port_id;

For active networks that belong to tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57", list the network ID, network name, tenant ID, admin_state_up flag, MTU, and the standard attribute updated_at timestamp, along with the total number of such active networks per tenant and the average active-network count across all tenants; also assign row numbers within each tenant ordered by network name.
sub_sqls: SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57');

SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57');

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')) SELECT port_id, tenant_id, mac_address, security_group_id, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > (SELECT AVG(window_column) FROM inner_cte);

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT inner_cte.network_id, inner_cte.network_name, inner_cte.tenant_id, inner_cte.admin_state_up, inner_cte.mtu, inner_cte.standard_attr_updated_at, inner_cte.window_column, tenant_counts.total_active_networks, avg_counts.avg_active_networks FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(network_id) AS total_active_networks FROM inner_cte GROUP BY tenant_id ) AS tenant_counts ON tenant_counts.tenant_id = inner_cte.tenant_id JOIN ( SELECT AVG(active_network_count) AS avg_active_networks FROM ( SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(network_id) AS active_network_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY tenant_id ) AS sub ) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1;

question: For subnets whose networks are shared via RBAC action `access_as_shared` to target tenant `1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b`, group results by RBAC target tenant, IP version, and the IP-version subnet usage category (HIGH/LOW/AVERAGE). For each group, return how many matching subnet rows there are, the average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of DNS nameserver order values (from the IPv4 subnet DNS-order variability rollup results, matched by subnet name), and the average running-sum of subnet standard attribute IDs. Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each IP version as 'HIGH_SUBNET_USAGE' (at least 50% more than average), 'LOW_SUBNET_USAGE' (at least 50% less than average), or 'AVERAGE_SUBNET_USAGE'.
sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, STDDEV(d.order) / NULLIF(AVG(d.order), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM subnets AS s JOIN dnsnameservers AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN ipallocationpools AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id JOIN networks AS n ON n.id = s.network_id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT r.object_id FROM networkrbacs AS r WHERE r.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (r.target_tenant = '*' OR r.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY s.name HAVING AVG(d.order) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), SubnetSharedStatus AS ( SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, CASE WHEN r.object_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Shared' ELSE 'Not Shared' END AS shared_status, i.coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte i JOIN subnets s ON s.name = i.subnet_name JOIN networks n ON n.id = s.network_id LEFT JOIN networkrbacs r ON r.object_id = n.id AND r.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (r.target_tenant = '*' OR r.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(shared_status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE shared_status END AS shared_status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(subnet_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(shared_status) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(subnet_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(shared_status) = 1 THEN 'ALL SUBNETS' ELSE subnet_name END AS subnet_name, AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM SubnetSharedStatus GROUP BY shared_status, subnet_name WITH ROLLUP ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, n.TARGET_TENANT AS rbac_target_tenant, SUM(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.IP_VERSION ORDER BY s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN NETWORKRBACS AS n ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b')), IpVersionCounts AS (SELECT s.IP_VERSION, COUNT(*) AS total_subnets FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN NETWORKRBACS AS n ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b') GROUP BY s.IP_VERSION), AverageSubnets AS (SELECT AVG(total_subnets) AS avg_subnets FROM IpVersionCounts) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.subnet_cidr, i.rbac_target_tenant, i.window_column, c.IP_VERSION, c.total_subnets, a.avg_subnets AS benchmark, CASE WHEN c.total_subnets > a.avg_subnets * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_SUBNET_USAGE' WHEN c.total_subnets < a.avg_subnets * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_SUBNET_USAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_SUBNET_USAGE' END AS usage_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBNETS s2 ON s2.NAME = i.subnet_name AND s2.CIDR = i.subnet_cidr JOIN IpVersionCounts c ON c.IP_VERSION = s2.IP_VERSION CROSS JOIN AverageSubnets a ) SELECT q2.rbac_target_tenant, q2.IP_VERSION, q2.usage_category, COUNT(*) AS matched_subnet_rows, AVG(q1.avg_coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_dns_order_coefficient_of_variation, AVG(q2.window_column) AS avg_running_sum_standard_attr_id FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q1.subnet_name = q2.subnet_name WHERE q2.rbac_target_tenant IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b') GROUP BY q2.rbac_target_tenant, q2.IP_VERSION, q2.usage_category ORDER BY avg_dns_order_coefficient_of_variation DESC;

For each IPv4 subnet (by subnet name) and whether its network is shared or not (treat as 'Shared' if the network has an `access_as_shared` RBAC entry to `*` or to tenant `9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b`, otherwise 'Not Shared'), return the coefficient of variation of the DNS nameserver order values across all DNS nameservers on that subnet. sub_sqls: SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, STDDEV(d.order) / NULLIF(AVG(d.order), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM subnets AS s JOIN dnsnameservers AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN ipallocationpools AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id JOIN networks AS n ON n.id = s.network_id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT r.object_id FROM networkrbacs AS r WHERE r.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (r.target_tenant = '*' OR r.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY s.name HAVING AVG(d.order) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, n.TARGET_TENANT AS rbac_target_tenant, SUM(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.IP_VERSION ORDER BY s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN NETWORKRBACS AS n ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b');

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, STDDEV(d.order) / NULLIF(AVG(d.order), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM subnets AS s JOIN dnsnameservers AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN ipallocationpools AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id JOIN networks AS n ON n.id = s.network_id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT r.object_id FROM networkrbacs AS r WHERE r.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (r.target_tenant = '*' OR r.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY s.name HAVING AVG(d.order) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), SubnetSharedStatus AS ( SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, CASE WHEN r.object_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Shared' ELSE 'Not Shared' END AS shared_status, i.coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte i JOIN subnets s ON s.name = i.subnet_name JOIN networks n ON n.id = s.network_id LEFT JOIN networkrbacs r ON r.object_id = n.id AND r.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (r.target_tenant = '*' OR r.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(shared_status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE shared_status END AS shared_status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(subnet_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(shared_status) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(subnet_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(shared_status) = 1 THEN 'ALL SUBNETS' ELSE subnet_name END AS subnet_name, AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM SubnetSharedStatus GROUP BY shared_status, subnet_name WITH ROLLUP;

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, n.TARGET_TENANT AS rbac_target_tenant, SUM(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.IP_VERSION ORDER BY s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN NETWORKRBACS AS n ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b')), IpVersionCounts AS (SELECT s.IP_VERSION, COUNT(*) AS total_subnets FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN NETWORKRBACS AS n ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b') GROUP BY s.IP_VERSION), AverageSubnets AS (SELECT AVG(total_subnets) AS avg_subnets FROM IpVersionCounts) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.subnet_cidr, i.rbac_target_tenant, i.window_column, c.IP_VERSION, c.total_subnets, a.avg_subnets AS benchmark, CASE WHEN c.total_subnets > a.avg_subnets * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_SUBNET_USAGE' WHEN c.total_subnets < a.avg_subnets * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_SUBNET_USAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_SUBNET_USAGE' END AS usage_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBNETS s2 ON s2.NAME = i.subnet_name AND s2.CIDR = i.subnet_cidr JOIN IpVersionCounts c ON c.IP_VERSION = s2.IP_VERSION CROSS JOIN AverageSubnets a;

question: For default external networks (IS_DEFAULT = 0), identify the top 10 tenants by how many of their networks have an RBAC action of 'access_as_external', and for each of those tenants show: the tenant ID, the total number of qualifying networks, whether any of those networks have a targeted RBAC entry (TARGET_TENANT is not '*'), and a breakdown of how many default external networks they have in each network status after excluding networks shared via RBAC (action = 'access_as_shared' with TARGET_TENANT = '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH TopTenantsExternalAccess AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.NAME, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY r.ACTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM EXTERNALNETWORKS e JOIN NETWORKS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID JOIN NETWORKRBACS r ON n.ID = r.OBJECT_ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND r.ACTION = 'access_as_external' ) SELECT n.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id) AS total_qualifying_networks, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.target_tenant <> '*' THEN r.id END) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_targeted_rbac FROM inner_cte i JOIN networks n ON n.name = i.name JOIN externalnetworks e ON e.network_id = n.id JOIN networkrbacs r ON r.object_id = n.id WHERE e.is_default = 0 AND r.action = 'access_as_external' GROUP BY n.tenant_id ORDER BY total_qualifying_networks DESC LIMIT 10 ), TenantStatusRollup AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT e.NETWORK_ID, e.IS_DEFAULT, n.TENANT_ID, n.NAME, n.STATUS, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP, n.MTU, n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID, MIN(n.MTU) OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.TENANT_ID) AS window_column FROM EXTERNALNETWORKS e JOIN NETWORKS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND n.ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ), TenantStatusCounts AS ( SELECT i.tenant_id, i.status, COUNT(DISTINCT i.network_id) AS total_networks FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.tenant_id, i.status ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 AND GROUPING(tenant_id) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE status END AS status, SUM(total_networks) AS total_networks FROM TenantStatusCounts GROUP BY tenant_id, status WITH ROLLUP ) SELECT t.tenant_id, t.total_qualifying_networks, t.has_targeted_rbac, r.status, r.total_networks FROM TopTenantsExternalAccess t JOIN TenantStatusRollup r ON r.tenant_id = t.tenant_id WHERE r.status <> 'SUBTOTAL' AND r.tenant_id <> 'GRAND TOTAL' ORDER BY t.total_qualifying_networks DESC, r.status;

SELECT e.NETWORK_ID, e.IS_DEFAULT, n.TENANT_ID, n.NAME, n.STATUS, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP, n.MTU, n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID, MIN(n.MTU) OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.TENANT_ID) AS window_column FROM EXTERNALNETWORKS e JOIN NETWORKS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND n.ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') );

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.NAME, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY r.ACTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM EXTERNALNETWORKS e JOIN NETWORKS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID JOIN NETWORKRBACS r ON n.ID = r.OBJECT_ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND r.ACTION = 'access_as_external' ) SELECT n.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id) AS total_qualifying_networks, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.target_tenant <> '*' THEN r.id END) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_targeted_rbac FROM inner_cte i JOIN networks n ON n.name = i.name JOIN externalnetworks e ON e.network_id = n.id JOIN networkrbacs r ON r.object_id = n.id WHERE e.is_default = 0 AND r.action = 'access_as_external' GROUP BY n.tenant_id ORDER BY total_qualifying_networks DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT e.NETWORK_ID, e.IS_DEFAULT, n.TENANT_ID, n.NAME, n.STATUS, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP, n.MTU, n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID, MIN(n.MTU) OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.TENANT_ID) AS window_column FROM EXTERNALNETWORKS e JOIN NETWORKS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND n.ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ), TenantStatusCounts AS ( SELECT i.tenant_id, i.status, COUNT(DISTINCT i.network_id) AS total_networks FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.tenant_id, i.status ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 AND GROUPING(tenant_id) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE status END AS status, SUM(total_networks) AS total_networks FROM TenantStatusCounts GROUP BY tenant_id, status WITH ROLLUP;

question: For subnets whose network RBAC action is 'access_as_shared' and whose RBAC target tenant is public ('*'), show (1) the rollup results per subnet name and gateway IP (including subtotals and a grand total) with the maximum IP version (only where that maximum IP version is greater than 3), and (2) the corresponding detail rows where the subnet name is suppressed when it repeats in the ordered list. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.name, MAX(s.ip_version) AS max_ip_version, s.gateway_ip FROM NETWORKRBACS n JOIN SUBNETS s ON n.object_id = s.network_id WHERE n.action = 'access_as_shared' AND n.target_tenant = '*' GROUP BY s.name, s.gateway_ip HAVING MAX(s.ip_version) > 3 ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE name END AS name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(gateway_ip) = 1 AND GROUPING(name) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(gateway_ip) = 1 AND GROUPING(name) = 1 THEN 'ALL' ELSE gateway_ip END AS gateway_ip, MAX(max_ip_version) AS max_ip_version, COUNT(*) AS total_groups FROM inner_cte GROUP BY name, gateway_ip WITH ROLLUP ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.name, MAX(s.ip_version) AS max_ip_version, s.gateway_ip FROM NETWORKRBACS n JOIN SUBNETS s ON n.object_id = s.network_id WHERE n.action = 'access_as_shared' AND n.target_tenant = '*' GROUP BY s.name, s.gateway_ip HAVING MAX(s.ip_version) > 3 ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(name) OVER (ORDER BY name, gateway_ip) = name THEN NULL ELSE name END AS name, max_ip_version, gateway_ip FROM inner_cte ORDER BY name, gateway_ip ) SELECT q1.name, q1.gateway_ip, q1.max_ip_version, q1.total_groups, q2.name AS non_repeated_name, q2.max_ip_version AS detail_max_ip_version, q2.gateway_ip AS detail_gateway_ip FROM q1 LEFT JOIN q2 ON q1.name = q2.name AND q1.gateway_ip = q2.gateway_ip ORDER BY q1.name, q1.gateway_ip;

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(admin_state_up) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE CAST(admin_state_up AS CHAR) END AS admin_state_up, COUNT(DISTINCT network_id) AS total_networks, MAX(standard_attr_updated_at) AS max_standard_attr_updated_at FROM inner_cte GROUP BY admin_state_up WITH ROLLUP;

question: For subnets on networks shared via the RBAC action `access_as_shared` with target tenant `1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b`, list each subnet’s name and CIDR, the RBAC target tenant, the running sum of subnet standard attribute IDs within each IP version group (ordered by standard attribute ID), the deviation of each subnet’s standard attribute ID from the overall average standard attribute ID across these shared subnets, and (for those same subnets) the DNS nameserver-order coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) for IPv4 subnets that is above the overall average—along with a normalized coefficient-of-variation ratio (subnet CV divided by the average CV across the returned subnets).
sql: WITH SubnetRbacStdAttr AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, n.TARGET_TENANT AS rbac_target_tenant, SUM(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.IP_VERSION ORDER BY s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN NETWORKRBACS AS n ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b')), AvgStdAttr AS (SELECT AVG(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN NETWORKRBACS AS n ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b')) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.subnet_cidr, i.rbac_target_tenant, i.window_column, (s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID - a.avg_standard_attr_id) AS deviation_from_avg_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBNETS s ON s.NAME = i.subnet_name AND s.CIDR = i.subnet_cidr CROSS JOIN AvgStdAttr a ), SubnetDnsCv AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, STDDEV(d.order) / NULLIF(AVG(d.order), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM subnets AS s JOIN dnsnameservers AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN ipallocationpools AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id JOIN networks AS n ON n.id = s.network_id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT r.object_id FROM networkrbacs AS r WHERE r.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (r.target_tenant = '*' OR r.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY s.name HAVING AVG(d.order) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN subnets AS s ON s.name = i.subnet_name WHERE i.coefficient_of_variation > ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) FROM inner_cte ) ORDER BY i.coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT s1.subnet_name, s1.subnet_cidr, s1.rbac_target_tenant, s1.window_column, s1.deviation_from_avg_standard_attr_id, s2.coefficient_of_variation, ROUND(s2.coefficient_of_variation / NULLIF(AVG(s2.coefficient_of_variation) OVER (), 0), 4) AS normalized_coefficient_of_variation_ratio FROM SubnetRbacStdAttr AS s1 JOIN SubnetDnsCv AS s2 ON s2.subnet_name = s1.subnet_name WHERE s1.rbac_target_tenant IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b') ORDER BY normalized_coefficient_of_variation_ratio DESC, s2.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For each tenant (excluding the subtotal and grand total rollup rows) and each network status, among non-shared networks that are marked as default external networks (excluding networks whose IDs appear in networkrbacs with action = 'access_as_shared' and target_tenant = '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), list the tenant ID, network status, and the count of such networks; also compute the tenant’s total port count under the same non-shared network filter and show the derived ports-per-default-external-network ratio. n.TENANT_ID) AS window_column FROM EXTERNALNETWORKS e JOIN NETWORKS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND n.ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE i.status, COUNT(DISTINCT i.network_id) AS total_networks FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.tenant_id, i.status ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 AND GROUPING(tenant_id) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE status END AS status, SUM(total_networks) AS total_networks FROM TenantStatusCounts GROUP BY tenant_id, status WITH ROLLUP ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = avg_port_count FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.earliest_standard_attr_update, a.avg_port_count AS benchmark, CASE WHEN i.port_count > a.avg_port_count * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VOLUME' WHEN i.port_count < a.avg_port_count * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VOLUME' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VOLUME' END AS volume_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_cte a ), TenantPortCounts AS ( SELECT p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, COUNT(p.ID) AS tenant_port_count FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.TENANT_ID ) SELECT q1.tenant_id, q1.status AS network_status, q1.total_networks, tpc.tenant_port_count, ROUND(tpc.tenant_port_count / NULLIF(q1.total_networks, 0), 2) AS ports_per_default_external_network, q2.port_status, q2.device_owner, q2.port_count, q2.benchmark, q2.volume_category, q2.earliest_standard_attr_update FROM q1 JOIN TenantPortCounts tpc ON tpc.tenant_id = q1.tenant_id CROSS JOIN q2 WHERE q1.tenant_id NOT IN ('GRAND TOTAL', 'SUBTOTAL') ORDER BY ports_per_default_external_network DESC, q1.tenant_id, q1.status, q2.port_count DESC;

sub_sqls: SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, VARIANCE(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_variance, STDDEV(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_stddev FROM NETWORKS AS n JOIN NETWORKSECURITYBINDINGS AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.STATUS ORDER BY port_security_enabled_variance DESC;

SELECT e.NETWORK_ID, e.IS_DEFAULT, n.TENANT_ID, n.NAME, n.STATUS, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP, n.MTU, n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID, MIN(n.MTU) OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.TENANT_ID) AS window_column FROM EXTERNALNETWORKS e JOIN NETWORKS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND n.ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') );

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, VARIANCE(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_variance, STDDEV(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_stddev FROM NETWORKS AS n JOIN NETWORKSECURITYBINDINGS AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.STATUS ORDER BY port_security_enabled_variance DESC ) SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, COUNT(DISTINCT n.ID) AS total_networks_with_security_binding, inner_cte.port_security_enabled_variance, inner_cte.port_security_enabled_stddev FROM NETWORKS AS n JOIN NETWORKSECURITYBINDINGS AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID JOIN inner_cte ON n.STATUS = inner_cte.network_status WHERE n.ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.STATUS, inner_cte.port_security_enabled_variance, inner_cte.port_security_enabled_stddev ORDER BY total_networks_with_security_binding DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT e.NETWORK_ID, e.IS_DEFAULT, n.TENANT_ID, n.NAME, n.STATUS, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP, n.MTU, n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID, MIN(n.MTU) OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.TENANT_ID) AS window_column FROM EXTERNALNETWORKS e JOIN NETWORKS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND n.ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ), TenantStatusCounts AS ( SELECT i.tenant_id, i.status, COUNT(DISTINCT i.network_id) AS total_networks FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.tenant_id, i.status ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 AND GROUPING(tenant_id) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE status END AS status, SUM(total_networks) AS total_networks FROM TenantStatusCounts GROUP BY tenant_id, status WITH ROLLUP;

question: For tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57", for each administratively-up port (with its binding details) that belongs to an ACTIVE network in the same tenant, list the network details (network ID, name, admin_state_up, MTU, standard attribute updated_at, the row number within the tenant ordered by network name, and the deviation of the network MTU from the average MTU across these networks) together with the port details (port ID, host, VIF type, VNIC type, MAC address, status, device owner, the windowed average standard attribute ID, the total ports in that VIF type, and the deviation of the port’s windowed average from the overall windowed average). sql: WITH networks_subq AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), avg_mtu_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(mtu) AS avg_mtu FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.network_id, i.network_name, i.tenant_id, i.admin_state_up, i.mtu, i.standard_attr_updated_at, i.window_column, (i.mtu - a.avg_mtu) AS deviation_from_avg_mtu FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_mtu_cte a ), ports_subq AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), VifTypeCounts AS ( SELECT VIF_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS ports_in_vif_type FROM inner_cte GROUP BY VIF_TYPE ), OverallWindowAvg AS ( SELECT AVG(window_column) AS overall_avg_window_column FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.PORT_ID, i.HOST, i.VIF_TYPE, i.VNIC_TYPE, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, i.STATUS, i.DEVICE_OWNER, i.window_column, vtc.ports_in_vif_type, (i.window_column - owa.overall_avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_overall_window_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN VifTypeCounts AS vtc ON i.VIF_TYPE = vtc.VIF_TYPE CROSS JOIN OverallWindowAvg AS owa ) SELECT n.network_id, n.network_name, n.tenant_id, n.admin_state_up AS network_admin_state_up, n.mtu, n.standard_attr_updated_at, n.window_column AS network_row_number_within_tenant_by_name, n.deviation_from_avg_mtu, p.PORT_ID, p.HOST, p.VIF_TYPE, p.VNIC_TYPE, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER, p.window_column AS port_windowed_avg_standard_attr_id, p.ports_in_vif_type, p.deviation_from_overall_window_avg FROM networks_subq n JOIN ports_subq p ON p.NETWORK_ID = n.network_id AND p.TENANT_ID = n.tenant_id;

question: From the top 10 RBAC actions with action = 'access_as_shared' (based on highest subnet IP-version variance across referenced subnets, considering IPv4 subnets), show each action’s average subnet IP version, variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), whether any referenced subnets have DHCP enabled, and—using only public RBAC entries where target_tenant = '*'—the overall average variance benchmark across actions and the variance category (HIGH_VARIANCE/LOW_VARIANCE/AVERAGE_VARIANCE). Do not return any rounded answers. Classify each action as 'HIGH_VARIANCE' (at least 50% above the average), 'LOW_VARIANCE' (at least 50% below the average), or 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE'.
sql: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.ACTION, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACTION, inner_cte.avg_ip_version, inner_cte.ip_version_variance, inner_cte.ip_version_stddev, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 THEN s.ID END) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_dhcp_enabled_subnets FROM inner_cte JOIN NETWORKRBACS AS n ON n.ACTION = inner_cte.ACTION JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON s.NETWORK_ID = n.OBJECT_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY inner_cte.ACTION, inner_cte.avg_ip_version, inner_cte.ip_version_variance, inner_cte.ip_version_stddev ORDER BY inner_cte.ip_version_variance DESC LIMIT 10), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT = '*' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(ip_version_variance) AS avg_ip_version_variance FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.ACTION, i.ip_version_variance, a.avg_ip_version_variance AS benchmark, CASE WHEN i.ip_version_variance > a.avg_ip_version_variance * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN i.ip_version_variance < a.avg_ip_version_variance * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_cte a) SELECT q1.ACTION, q1.avg_ip_version, q1.ip_version_variance AS top10_ip_version_variance, q1.ip_version_stddev, q1.has_dhcp_enabled_subnets, q2.benchmark AS avg_variance_benchmark_across_actions, q2.variance_category FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.ACTION = q1.ACTION ORDER BY q1.ip_version_variance DESC;

question: For subnet ID '012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48' (IPv4 only), list the top 10 subnets by number of distinct subnet routes, showing each subnet’s name and CIDR, total distinct routes, whether it has any IP allocation pools, and (for the same subnet name) the tenant-level average route-count range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of routes per subnet as computed per next hop. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subnet_route_dispersion AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(route_count) - MIN(route_count) AS route_count_range, VARIANCE(route_count) AS route_count_variance, STDDEV(route_count) AS route_count_stddev FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN ( SELECT sr.SUBNET_ID, COUNT(*) AS route_count FROM SUBNETROUTES AS sr GROUP BY sr.SUBNET_ID, sr.NEXTHOP ) AS route_stats ON s.ID = route_stats.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY route_count_range DESC), SubnetTenantStats AS ( SELECT s.tenant_id, i.subnet_name, i.route_count_range, i.route_count_variance, i.route_count_stddev FROM inner_cte i JOIN subnets s ON s.name = i.subnet_name AND s.ip_version = 4 AND s.id IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(subnet_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(tenant_id) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(subnet_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE subnet_name END AS subnet_name, AVG(route_count_range) AS avg_route_count_range, AVG(route_count_variance) AS avg_route_count_variance, AVG(route_count_stddev) AS avg_route_count_stddev FROM SubnetTenantStats GROUP BY tenant_id, subnet_name WITH ROLLUP ), top10_subnets_by_distinct_routes AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT r.DESTINATION, r.NEXTHOP, s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.SUBNET_ID ORDER BY r.SUBNET_ID) AS window_column FROM SUBNETROUTES r JOIN SUBNETS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')) SELECT s.ID AS subnet_id, s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, COUNT(DISTINCT r.DESTINATION) AS total_routes, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_allocation_pools FROM SUBNETS s LEFT JOIN SUBNETROUTES r ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID LEFT JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS p ON p.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN inner_cte i ON i.subnet_name = s.NAME AND i.subnet_cidr = s.CIDR WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.ID, s.NAME, s.CIDR ORDER BY total_routes DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT t.subnet_id, t.subnet_name, t.subnet_cidr, t.total_routes, t.has_allocation_pools, d.tenant_id, d.avg_route_count_range, d.avg_route_count_variance, d.avg_route_count_stddev FROM top10_subnets_by_distinct_routes t JOIN subnet_route_dispersion d ON d.subnet_name = t.subnet_name WHERE d.subnet_name <> 'SUBTOTAL' AND d.tenant_id <> 'GRAND TOTAL';

sub_sqls: SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(route_count) - MIN(route_count) AS route_count_range, VARIANCE(route_count) AS route_count_variance, STDDEV(route_count) AS route_count_stddev FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN ( SELECT sr.SUBNET_ID, COUNT(*) AS route_count FROM SUBNETROUTES AS sr GROUP BY sr.SUBNET_ID, sr.NEXTHOP ) AS route_stats ON s.ID = route_stats.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY route_count_range DESC;

SELECT r.DESTINATION, r.NEXTHOP, s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.SUBNET_ID ORDER BY r.SUBNET_ID) AS window_column FROM SUBNETROUTES r JOIN SUBNETS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(route_count) - MIN(route_count) AS route_count_range, VARIANCE(route_count) AS route_count_variance, STDDEV(route_count) AS route_count_stddev FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN ( SELECT sr.SUBNET_ID, COUNT(*) AS route_count FROM SUBNETROUTES AS sr GROUP BY sr.SUBNET_ID, sr.NEXTHOP ) AS route_stats ON s.ID = route_stats.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY route_count_range DESC), SubnetTenantStats AS ( SELECT s.tenant_id, i.subnet_name, i.route_count_range, i.route_count_variance, i.route_count_stddev FROM inner_cte i JOIN subnets s ON s.name = i.subnet_name AND s.ip_version = 4 AND s.id IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(subnet_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(tenant_id) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(subnet_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE subnet_name END AS subnet_name, AVG(route_count_range) AS avg_route_count_range, AVG(route_count_variance) AS avg_route_count_variance, AVG(route_count_stddev) AS avg_route_count_stddev FROM SubnetTenantStats GROUP BY tenant_id, subnet_name WITH ROLLUP;

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT r.DESTINATION, r.NEXTHOP, s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.SUBNET_ID ORDER BY r.SUBNET_ID) AS window_column FROM SUBNETROUTES r JOIN SUBNETS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')) SELECT s.ID AS subnet_id, s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, COUNT(DISTINCT r.DESTINATION) AS total_routes, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_allocation_pools FROM SUBNETS s LEFT JOIN SUBNETROUTES r ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID LEFT JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS p ON p.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN inner_cte i ON i.subnet_name = s.NAME AND i.subnet_cidr = s.CIDR WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.ID, s.NAME, s.CIDR ORDER BY total_routes DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For ports that are administratively up, list the VIF type, total number of distinct ports, and the average of the per-port windowed average standard attribute ID (computed over 2 preceding and 2 following rows partitioned by VIF type and ordered by standard attribute ID). Do not repeat the VIF type if it is the same as the previous row. Include a grand total row across all VIF types. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(vif_type) OVER (ORDER BY vif_type_sort, vif_type) = vif_type THEN NULL ELSE vif_type END AS vif_type, total_ports, avg_windowed_standard_attr_id FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.VIF_TYPE) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.VIF_TYPE END AS vif_type_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.VIF_TYPE) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.VIF_TYPE END AS vif_type, COUNT(DISTINCT i.PORT_ID) AS total_ports, AVG(i.window_column) AS avg_windowed_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte AS i GROUP BY i.VIF_TYPE WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY vif_type_sort, vif_type;
sub_questions: For ports that are administratively up, show the port ID, host, VIF type, VNIC type, tenant ID, network ID, MAC address, status, device owner, and the average standard attribute ID in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows partitioned by VIF type and ordered by standard attribute ID.
sub_sqls: SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1;

question: For each tenant that has ports in DOWN status, list the tenant ID, the total number of DOWN ports they have (based on the DOWN ports joined to their security-group-to-port bindings and port-security bindings), and the average number of DOWN ports per tenant across all such tenants. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' ) SELECT inner_cte.tenant_id, COUNT(inner_cte.port_id) AS total_down_ports, avg_down.avg_down_port_count FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(down_port_count) AS avg_down_port_count FROM ( SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(port_id) AS down_port_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY tenant_id ) AS sub ) AS avg_down GROUP BY inner_cte.tenant_id, avg_down.avg_down_port_count;
sub_questions: For ports that are DOWN, show the port ID, tenant ID, MAC address, the security group ID from the security-group-to-port binding, and the rank of each port within its security group when ordered by port ID.
sub_sqls: SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN';

question: For load balancers provided by “haproxy”, list the load balancer name, VIP address, bytes in, total connections, and the row number ordered by load balancer name using a window frame of 2 preceding and 1 following rows; additionally, for each tenant show how many haproxy load balancers they have and the average number of haproxy load balancers per tenant. Do not return any rounded answers.
