question: For each binding host, find the host name and the maximum DOWN-status rank (ordered by port ID within the DOWN group) among ports that are DOWN and have port security enabled, where the ports are matched to admin-up ports by MAC address. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DownPortsWithBindings AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.NAME AS port_name, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, b.HOST AS binding_host, b.VIF_TYPE AS vif_type, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.STATUS ORDER BY p.ID) AS window_column FROM PORTS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN'), AdminUpPortsWithSecurity AS (SELECT p.NAME AS port_name, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, psb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED AS port_security_enabled, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY p.MAC_ADDRESS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1) SELECT dpwb.port_id, dpwb.port_name, dpwb.mac_address, dpwb.binding_host, dpwb.vif_type, dpwb.window_column AS down_status_rank, aupws.port_security_enabled, aupws.window_column AS admin_up_row_number FROM DownPortsWithBindings dpwb JOIN AdminUpPortsWithSecurity aupws ON dpwb.mac_address = aupws.mac_address WHERE aupws.port_security_enabled = 1 ORDER BY dpwb.port_id) SELECT binding_host, MAX(down_status_rank) AS max_down_status_rank FROM inner_cte GROUP BY binding_host;

question: For ports that are both (a) bound to security group ID 0008e629-5619-41e0-b86c-4eecfeaacb6c and (b) have status DOWN, produce a report grouped by tenant that lists the tenant ID (do not repeat it if it is the same as the previous row), the number of distinct matching ports, the number of distinct hosts those ports are bound to, and the average of the security-group running-sum window value across the matching rows. Also include a final TOTAL row across all tenants. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH SecurityGroupPorts AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.STATUS AS port_status, ia.IP_ADDRESS AS ip_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY p.NETWORK_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID = '0008e629-5619-41e0-b86c-4eecfeaacb6c' ), DownPorts AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, b.HOST AS host, b.VIF_TYPE AS vif_type, ia.IP_ADDRESS AS ip_address, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY ia.IP_ADDRESS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b JOIN PORTS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' ), SecurityGroupDownPorts AS ( SELECT dp.port_id, dp.tenant_id, dp.host, dp.vif_type, dp.ip_address, dp.window_column AS down_ports_rownum_window, sgp.port_status, sgp.window_column AS sg_ports_running_sum_window FROM DownPorts dp JOIN SecurityGroupPorts sgp ON dp.port_id = sgp.port_id AND dp.ip_address = sgp.ip_address ) SELECT port_id, tenant_id, host, vif_type, ip_address, port_status, down_ports_rownum_window, sg_ports_running_sum_window FROM SecurityGroupDownPorts) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(tenant_id) OVER (ORDER BY tenant_id_sort, tenant_id) = tenant_id THEN NULL ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, matching_ports, distinct_hosts, avg_sg_running_sum_window FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT port_id) AS matching_ports, COUNT(DISTINCT host) AS distinct_hosts, AVG(sg_ports_running_sum_window) AS avg_sg_running_sum_window FROM inner_cte GROUP BY tenant_id WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY tenant_id_sort;

question: For ports that are DOWN, group the results by device owner and whether the port has a security group binding (“Bound” if it has at least one security group, “Unbound” otherwise). For each device owner and binding status, list the device owner, binding status, and the number of distinct DOWN ports. Include subtotals per device owner and a grand total. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DownPortsWithIPs AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.NAME AS port_name, p.NETWORK_ID AS network_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, ia.IP_ADDRESS AS ip_address, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.NETWORK_ID ORDER BY p.ID) AS window_column FROM PORTS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' ), DownPortsWithSecurityWindow AS ( SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' ) SELECT dpi.port_id, dpi.tenant_id, dpi.port_name, dpi.network_id, dpi.mac_address, dpi.device_owner, dpi.ip_address, dpi.window_column AS row_num_within_network, dpsw.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, dpsw.ADMIN_STATE_UP, dpsw.STATUS, dpsw.window_column AS min_admin_state_up_window FROM DownPortsWithIPs dpi JOIN DownPortsWithSecurityWindow dpsw ON dpi.network_id = dpsw.NETWORK_ID AND dpi.port_name = dpsw.NAME AND dpi.mac_address = dpsw.MAC_ADDRESS AND dpi.device_owner = dpsw.DEVICE_OWNER ORDER BY dpi.network_id, dpi.port_id ), PortOwnerBindingCounts AS ( SELECT ic.device_owner, CASE WHEN ic.SECURITY_GROUP_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Bound' ELSE 'Unbound' END AS binding_status, COUNT(DISTINCT ic.port_id) AS total_down_ports FROM inner_cte ic GROUP BY ic.device_owner, binding_status ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(device_owner) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE device_owner END AS device_owner, CASE WHEN GROUPING(binding_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(device_owner) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(binding_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(device_owner) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE binding_status END AS binding_status, SUM(total_down_ports) AS total_down_ports FROM PortOwnerBindingCounts GROUP BY device_owner, binding_status WITH ROLLUP;

question: Across all DOWN ports that share a MAC address with an administratively-up port, return the DOWN port’s ID, tenant ID, MAC address, its running sum of standard attribute ID within its security group, plus the administratively-up port’s name, port security enabled flag, and MAC-address-ordered row number; also include the deviation of each DOWN port’s running-sum value from the overall average running-sum across all such matched DOWN ports, and only keep rows where the running-sum value is greater than 0. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DownPortsBySecurityGroup AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' ), AdminUpPortsWithRowNumbers AS ( SELECT p.NAME AS port_name, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, psb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED AS port_security_enabled, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY p.MAC_ADDRESS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 ) SELECT dpsg.port_id, dpsg.tenant_id, dpsg.mac_address, dpsg.window_column AS down_ports_running_sum_standard_attr_id, aup.port_name, aup.port_security_enabled, aup.window_column AS admin_up_ports_row_number FROM DownPortsBySecurityGroup dpsg JOIN AdminUpPortsWithRowNumbers aup ON dpsg.mac_address = aup.mac_address WHERE dpsg.window_column > 0 ORDER BY dpsg.window_column DESC, dpsg.mac_address ), AverageRunningSum AS ( SELECT AVG(down_ports_running_sum_standard_attr_id) AS avg_running_sum FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.mac_address, i.down_ports_running_sum_standard_attr_id, i.port_name, i.port_security_enabled, i.admin_up_ports_row_number, (i.down_ports_running_sum_standard_attr_id - a.avg_running_sum) AS deviation_from_avg_running_sum FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN AverageRunningSum a ORDER BY i.down_ports_running_sum_standard_attr_id DESC, i.mac_address;

question: For each port status (considering only administratively up ports), return the count of administratively up ports and the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of port security bindings per port (considering only ports that have at least one port security binding), but only include statuses whose administratively up port count is greater than the average administratively up port count across all statuses. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH administratively_up_ports AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 ), port_status_binding_stats AS ( SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC ), up_port_counts_by_status AS ( SELECT aup.STATUS, COUNT(*) AS administratively_up_port_count FROM administratively_up_ports aup GROUP BY aup.STATUS ) SELECT psbs.status, ucs.administratively_up_port_count, psbs.binding_count_range, psbs.binding_count_variance, psbs.binding_count_stddev FROM port_status_binding_stats psbs JOIN up_port_counts_by_status ucs ON psbs.status = ucs.STATUS ORDER BY psbs.binding_count_range DESC ) SELECT status, administratively_up_port_count, binding_count_range, binding_count_variance, binding_count_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE administratively_up_port_count > (SELECT AVG(administratively_up_port_count) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY administratively_up_port_count DESC;

question: Using the RBAC action-level stats from the existing query, list the top 10 actions (ranked by the shared/IPv4 subnet IP-version variance) and show: the action, the shared/IPv4 average/variance/stddev of subnet IP version, the DHCP-enabled non-shared stddev of subnet IP version, and whether any of the shared/IPv4 subnets for that action have DHCP enabled. sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH RbacSharedIpVersionStats AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ), RbacDhcpNonSharedStddev AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 AND s.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.ACTION HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY ip_version_stddev DESC ) SELECT rs.ACTION, rs.avg_ip_version, rs.ip_version_variance, rs.ip_version_stddev AS shared_ip_version_stddev, rd.ip_version_stddev AS dhcp_nonshared_ip_version_stddev FROM RbacSharedIpVersionStats rs JOIN RbacDhcpNonSharedStddev rd ON rs.ACTION = rd.ACTION ) SELECT i.ACTION, i.avg_ip_version, i.ip_version_variance, i.shared_ip_version_stddev, i.dhcp_nonshared_ip_version_stddev, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT s2.ID) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS shared_ipv4_has_any_dhcp_enabled_subnet FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN NETWORKRBACS n2 ON n2.ACTION = i.ACTION AND n2.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' LEFT JOIN SUBNETS s2 ON s2.NETWORK_ID = n2.OBJECT_ID AND s2.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s2.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 GROUP BY i.ACTION, i.avg_ip_version, i.ip_version_variance, i.shared_ip_version_stddev, i.dhcp_nonshared_ip_version_stddev ORDER BY i.ip_version_variance DESC LIMIT 10;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' AND p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS ) SELECT s1.PORT_ID, s1.HOST, s1.VIF_TYPE, s1.VNIC_TYPE, s1.TENANT_ID, s1.NETWORK_ID, s1.MAC_ADDRESS, s1.STATUS, s1.DEVICE_OWNER, s1.window_column, s2.min_admin_state_up, s2.avg_standard_attr_id FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.STATUS = s2.STATUS ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(status) OVER (ORDER BY status_sort, status, port_id) = status THEN NULL ELSE status END AS status, port_id, host, vif_type, vnic_type, tenant_id, network_id, mac_address, device_owner, window_column, min_admin_state_up, avg_standard_attr_id FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.status) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.status END AS status_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.status) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.status END AS status, i.port_id, i.host, i.vif_type, i.vnic_type, i.tenant_id, i.network_id, i.mac_address, i.device_owner, i.window_column, i.min_admin_state_up, i.avg_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.status, i.port_id, i.host, i.vif_type, i.vnic_type, i.tenant_id, i.network_id, i.mac_address, i.device_owner, i.window_column, i.min_admin_state_up, i.avg_standard_attr_id WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY status_sort, status, port_id;

question: Using the same RBAC-action-level results as before, produce a report that lists each RBAC action (suppressing repeated action values on consecutive rows), the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP versions for DHCP-enabled subnets on non-shared networks (excluding networks that have an `access_as_shared` RBAC entry targeting `'*'` or `9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b`, and only keeping actions with more than 5 matching subnets), the variance of subnet IP versions for publicly shared `access_as_shared` RBAC entries (target tenant `'*'`), and also the total number of distinct subnet tenants contributing to each action’s DHCP-enabled/non-shared calculation. Include a final TOTAL row across all actions. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 AND s.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.ACTION HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY ip_version_stddev DESC ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT = '*' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ) SELECT s1.ACTION, s1.ip_version_stddev, s2.ip_version_variance FROM Subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN Subq2 s2 ON s1.ACTION = s2.ACTION ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(action) OVER (ORDER BY action_sort, action) = action THEN NULL ELSE action END AS action, ip_version_stddev, ip_version_variance, distinct_subnet_tenants FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.action) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.action END AS action_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.action) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.action END AS action, i.ip_version_stddev, i.ip_version_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT s.tenant_id) AS distinct_subnet_tenants FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN networkrbacs n ON n.action = i.action LEFT JOIN subnets s ON s.network_id = n.object_id AND s.enable_dhcp = 1 AND s.network_id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY i.action, i.ip_version_stddev, i.ip_version_variance WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY action_sort;

'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), AdminUpTenantPorts AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), TenantPortCounts AS ( SELECT ap.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.PORT_ID) AS admin_up_port_count FROM AdminUpTenantPorts ap GROUP BY ap.TENANT_ID ) SELECT an.tenant_id, tpc.admin_up_port_count, COUNT(DISTINCT an.network_id) AS active_network_count, MAX(an.standard_attr_updated_at) AS latest_network_standard_attr_updated_at FROM ActiveTenantNetworks an JOIN TenantPortCounts tpc ON an.tenant_id = tpc.tenant_id WHERE tpc.admin_up_port_count >= 2 GROUP BY an.tenant_id, tpc.admin_up_port_count ORDER BY tpc.admin_up_port_count DESC, active_network_count DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(tenant_id) OVER (ORDER BY tenant_id_sort, tenant_id) = tenant_id THEN NULL ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, admin_up_port_count, active_network_count, latest_network_standard_attr_updated_at FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, SUM(admin_up_port_count) AS admin_up_port_count, SUM(active_network_count) AS active_network_count, MAX(latest_network_standard_attr_updated_at) AS latest_network_standard_attr_updated_at FROM inner_cte GROUP BY tenant_id WITH question: Using the combined port status–level metrics result set (DOWN ports in tenant '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7' that are security-group bound, plus ports on device 'da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7' with VIF type 'ovs'), show for each status/reason row the device owner, port counts/attribute aggregates, and also indicate whether any of the involved ports have an OVS binding and whether any are bound to a security group. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH SecurityGroupBoundPorts AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER), OvsBoundPorts AS (SELECT p.STATUS, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' AND p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS), CombinedPortStatusMetrics AS ( SELECT sg.port_status AS status, sg.device_owner AS device_owner, sg.port_count AS port_count, sg.min_standard_attr_id AS min_standard_attr_id, NULL AS min_admin_state_up, NULL AS avg_standard_attr_id, 'Security Group Bound Ports' AS reason FROM SecurityGroupBoundPorts sg UNION ALL SELECT ov.STATUS AS status, NULL AS device_owner, NULL AS port_count, NULL AS min_standard_attr_id, ov.min_admin_state_up AS min_admin_state_up, ov.avg_standard_attr_id AS avg_standard_attr_id, 'OVS VIF Bound Ports' AS reason FROM OvsBoundPorts ov ) SELECT * FROM CombinedPortStatusMetrics ORDER BY status, device_owner, reason) SELECT i.status, i.reason, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.min_standard_attr_id, i.min_admin_state_up, i.avg_standard_attr_id, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT b.port_id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_ovs_binding, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT spb.port_id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_security_group_binding FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN ports p ON p.status = i.status AND (i.device_owner IS NULL OR p.device_owner = i.device_owner) LEFT JOIN ml2_port_bindings b ON p.id = b.port_id AND b.vif_type = 'ovs' LEFT JOIN securitygroupportbindings spb ON p.id = spb.port_id GROUP BY i.status, i.reason, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.min_standard_attr_id, i.min_admin_state_up, i.avg_standard_attr_id ORDER BY i.status, i.device_owner, i.reason;

question: Using the same exclusions for shared networks (i.e., networks with an RBAC entry where action = 'access_as_shared' and target_tenant is '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), take the combined result set that reports (1) per network status the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED across networks that have at least one security binding, and (2) per port status and device owner (restricted to standard attributes with resource_type = 'ports') the number of ports and the earliest standard attribute updated timestamp. sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH NetworkStatusSecurityStats AS ( SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, VARIANCE(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_variance, STDDEV(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_stddev FROM NETWORKS AS n JOIN NETWORKSECURITYBINDINGS AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.STATUS ORDER BY port_security_enabled_variance DESC ), PortStatusOwnerStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ) SELECT nsss.network_status, nsss.port_security_enabled_variance, nsss.port_security_enabled_stddev, pss.port_status, pss.device_owner, pss.port_count, pss.earliest_standard_attr_update FROM NetworkStatusSecurityStats nsss CROSS JOIN PortStatusOwnerStats pss) SELECT network_status, MAX(port_count) AS max_port_count_across_port_groups FROM inner_cte GROUP BY network_status;

question: For each tenant that has at least one admin-state-up port in tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57' which is bound to a security group that also appears on at least one DOWN port in network ID '0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d', list the tenant ID, the number of qualifying ports, the average DNS-per-security-group-binding ratio across those ports (rounded to 2 decimals), and also show the overall average number of qualifying ports per tenant.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH PortSecurityAndDns AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN PORTDNSES pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name ), DownPortsWithWindow AS ( SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') ), DownPortsAgg AS ( SELECT d.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, COUNT(*) AS down_port_rows, AVG(d.window_column) AS avg_window_min_admin_state_up FROM DownPortsWithWindow d GROUP BY d.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ) SELECT psd.port_id, psd.tenant_id, psd.port_name, psd.security_group_binding_count, psd.dns_record_count, ROUND( psd.dns_record_count / NULLIF(psd.security_group_binding_count, 0), 2 ) AS dns_per_security_group_binding_ratio, dpa.down_port_rows, ROUND(dpa.avg_window_min_admin_state_up, 2) AS avg_window_min_admin_state_up FROM PortSecurityAndDns psd JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb2 ON sgpb2.PORT_ID = psd.port_id JOIN DownPortsAgg dpa ON dpa.SECURITY_GROUP_ID = sgpb2.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY dns_per_security_group_binding_ratio DESC, psd.port_id ), tenant_agg AS ( SELECT i.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT i.port_id) AS qualifying_port_count, ROUND(AVG(i.dns_per_security_group_binding_ratio), 2) AS avg_dns_per_sg_binding_ratio FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.tenant_id ), avg_across_tenants AS ( SELECT AVG(qualifying_port_count) AS sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH PortCountsAndEarliestUpdate AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), PortStatusIpLengthCV AS ( SELECT p.status, STDDEV(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) / NULLIF(AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM portsecuritybindings psb JOIN ports p ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON p.id = ia.port_id WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1 AND ia.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT pceu.port_status, pceu.device_owner, pceu.port_count, pceu.earliest_standard_attr_update, psilcv.coefficient_of_variation FROM PortCountsAndEarliestUpdate pceu JOIN PortStatusIpLengthCV psilcv ON psilcv.status = pceu.port_status) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(port_status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE port_status END AS port_status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(device_owner) = 1 AND GROUPING(port_status) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE device_owner END AS device_owner, SUM(port_count) AS port_count, MIN(earliest_standard_attr_update) AS earliest_standard_attr_update, AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY port_status, device_owner WITH ROLLUP;

question: For the tenant_id '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7', list each port status along with the two stacked coefficient-of-variation metrics from the original analysis, but also include a subtotal row per status (and a grand total) showing the average coefficient_of_variation across the two metrics. sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH StdAttrIdCVByStatus AS ( SELECT p.status, STDDEV(p.standard_attr_id) / NULLIF(AVG(p.standard_attr_id), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM securitygroupportbindings AS sgpb JOIN ports AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN portsecuritybindings AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(p.standard_attr_id) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), IpAddressLengthCVByStatus AS ( SELECT p.status, STDDEV(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) / NULLIF(AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM portsecuritybindings psb JOIN ports p ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON p.id = ia.port_id WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1 AND ia.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), CombinedStatusCVs AS ( SELECT status, coefficient_of_variation, 'Standard Attr ID CV (SG Port Binding + Port Security Binding)' AS metric FROM StdAttrIdCVByStatus UNION ALL SELECT status, coefficient_of_variation, 'Allocated IP Address Length CV (Port Security Enabled, Specific IP)' AS metric FROM IpAddressLengthCVByStatus ) SELECT status, metric, coefficient_of_variation FROM CombinedStatusCVs ORDER BY status, metric) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(status) OVER (ORDER BY status_sort, status, metric_sort, metric) = status THEN NULL ELSE status END AS status, metric, coefficient_of_variation, avg_cv_across_metrics FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE status END AS status_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(metric) = 1 AND GROUPING(status) = 0 THEN 'zz_status_subtotal' WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 THEN 'zz_grand_total' ELSE 'aa_detail' END AS metric_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(metric) = 1 AND GROUPING(status) = 0 THEN 'STATUS SUBTOTAL (Avg CV across metrics)' WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL (Avg CV across metrics)' ELSE metric END AS metric, CASE WHEN GROUPING(metric) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE AVG(coefficient_of_variation) END AS coefficient_of_variation, AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_cv_across_metrics, status FROM inner_cte GROUP BY status, metric WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY status_sort, status, metric_sort, metric;

question: For tenant ID '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7' and considering only DOWN ports, for each (port status, device owner) combination where the ports are bound to a security group, return the distinct port count and the minimum standard attribute ID, and also include (by matching on port status) the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of port security bindings per port for that same tenant. sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH PortStatusOwnerSecurityGroupStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), PortStatusBindingCountDispersion AS ( SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC ) SELECT psosgs.port_status, psosgs.device_owner, psosgs.port_count, psosgs.min_standard_attr_id, psbcd.binding_count_range, psbcd.binding_count_variance, psbcd.binding_count_stddev FROM PortStatusOwnerSecurityGroupStats psosgs JOIN PortStatusBindingCountDispersion psbcd ON psosgs.port_status = psbcd.status ORDER BY psosgs.port_status, psosgs.device_owner ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.port_status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.port_status END AS port_status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.device_owner) = 1 AND GROUPING(inner_cte.port_status) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.device_owner) = 1 AND GROUPING(inner_cte.port_status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.device_owner END AS device_owner, SUM(inner_cte.port_count) AS port_count, MIN(inner_cte.min_standard_attr_id) AS min_standard_attr_id, MAX(inner_cte.binding_count_range) AS binding_count_range, MAX(inner_cte.binding_count_variance) AS binding_count_variance, MAX(inner_cte.binding_count_stddev) AS binding_count_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.port_status, inner_cte.device_owner WITH ROLLUP;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH TenantUpPortsWithIPs AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address), DownPortsOnNetworkWithSG AS (SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d')), TenantUpPortsWithIPsOnNetwork AS ( SELECT t.port_id, t.tenant_id, t.mac_address, t.ip_allocation_count, t.subnet_id_rows FROM TenantUpPortsWithIPs t JOIN PORTS p ON p.ID = t.port_id WHERE p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') ) SELECT d.NETWORK_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT d.NAME) AS down_port_name_count, COUNT(DISTINCT d.SECURITY_GROUP_ID) AS down_port_security_group_count, COUNT(DISTINCT t.port_id) AS tenant_up_port_count_with_ips, SUM(t.ip_allocation_count) AS tenant_up_total_ip_allocations, SUM(t.subnet_id_rows) AS tenant_up_total_subnet_id_rows FROM DownPortsOnNetworkWithSG d LEFT JOIN TenantUpPortsWithIPsOnNetwork t ON t.mac_address = d.MAC_ADDRESS GROUP BY d.NETWORK_ID) SELECT network_id, down_port_name_count, down_port_security_group_count, tenant_up_port_count_with_ips, tenant_up_total_ip_allocations, tenant_up_total_subnet_id_rows, (tenant_up_port_count_with_ips * 1.0 / NULLIF(down_port_name_count, 0)) AS tenant_up_to_down_name_ratio FROM inner_cte WHERE down_port_name_count > 0 AND (tenant_up_port_count_with_ips * 1.0 / down_port_name_count) > 0.25;

question: For tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57', among the security groups whose ratio is greater than 75% of (ports that are administratively up and have at least one IP allocation) compared to (ports that are DOWN and bound to that security group), what is the maximum number of distinct IP allocation subnets (SUBNET_ID) observed on any single admin-up port associated with that security group? sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DownPortsBySecurityGroup AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), AdminUpPortsWithIPAllocations AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ) SELECT dpsg.security_group_id, COUNT(DISTINCT dpsg.port_id) AS down_port_count, COUNT(DISTINCT aup.port_id) AS admin_up_port_with_ip_count FROM DownPortsBySecurityGroup dpsg LEFT JOIN AdminUpPortsWithIPAllocations aup ON aup.tenant_id = dpsg.tenant_id GROUP BY dpsg.security_group_id HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT aup.port_id) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT dpsg.port_id), 0)) > 0.75) , PortSubnetCounts AS ( SELECT spb.security_group_id, p.id AS port_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.subnet_id) AS distinct_subnet_count FROM ports p JOIN securitygroupportbindings spb ON spb.port_id = p.id JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY spb.security_group_id, p.id ) SELECT i.security_group_id, MAX(psc.distinct_subnet_count) AS max_distinct_subnets_on_any_admin_up_port FROM inner_cte i JOIN PortSubnetCounts psc ON psc.security_group_id = i.security_group_id GROUP BY i.security_group_id;

WITH SubnetPoolAndAttrStats AS ( SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') ), SubnetRouteCountDispersion AS ( SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(route_count) - MIN(route_count) AS route_count_range, VARIANCE(route_count) AS route_count_variance, STDDEV(route_count) AS route_count_stddev FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN ( SELECT sr.SUBNET_ID, COUNT(*) AS route_count FROM SUBNETROUTES AS sr GROUP BY sr.SUBNET_ID, sr.NEXTHOP ) AS route_stats ON s.ID = route_stats.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY route_count_range DESC ) SELECT spa.NAME AS subnet_name, spa.TENANT_ID, spa.NETWORK_ID, spa.IP_VERSION, spa.CIDR, spa.GATEWAY_IP, spa.ENABLE_DHCP, spa.FIRST_IP AS allocation_pool_first_ip, spa.LAST_IP AS allocation_pool_last_ip, spa.max_standard_attr_id_next2, srcd.route_count_range, srcd.route_count_variance, srcd.route_count_stddev FROM SubnetPoolAndAttrStats spa JOIN SubnetRouteCountDispersion srcd ON spa.NAME = srcd.subnet_name ORDER BY spa.NAME;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' AND p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS ) SELECT s1.PORT_ID, s1.HOST, s1.VIF_TYPE, s1.VNIC_TYPE, s1.TENANT_ID, s1.NETWORK_ID, s1.MAC_ADDRESS, s1.STATUS, s1.DEVICE_OWNER, s1.window_column, s2.min_admin_state_up, s2.avg_standard_attr_id FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.STATUS = s2.STATUS ) SELECT i.PORT_ID, i.HOST, i.VIF_TYPE, i.VNIC_TYPE, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, i.STATUS, i.DEVICE_OWNER, i.window_column, i.min_admin_state_up, i.avg_standard_attr_id, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT f.ID) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_floating_ip FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN FLOATINGIPS f ON i.PORT_ID = f.FIXED_PORT_ID GROUP BY i.PORT_ID, i.HOST, i.VIF_TYPE, i.VNIC_TYPE, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, i.STATUS, i.DEVICE_OWNER, i.window_column, i.min_admin_state_up, i.avg_standard_attr_id;

question: For each port status (considering only ports with an IP allocation of '10.150.64.113/8', and with port security enabled where applicable), show the status along with (1) the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the allocated IP address string length and (2) the variance of STANDARD_ATTR_ID; then, across those statuses, report the maximum coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) observed. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH sq1 AS ( SELECT p.status, STDDEV(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) / NULLIF(AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM portsecuritybindings psb JOIN ports p ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON p.id = ia.port_id WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1 AND ia.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), sq2 AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, VARIANCE(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM PORTS AS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NOT NULL AND ia.IP_ADDRESS IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.STATUS ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC ) SELECT sq1.status, sq1.coefficient_of_variation, sq2.standard_attr_id_variance FROM sq1 JOIN sq2 ON sq1.status = sq2.status ORDER BY sq1.coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT MAX(coefficient_of_variation) AS max_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte;

question: For each port status and device owner pair returned by the existing analysis, report the status, device owner, distinct DOWN-port count (bound to a security group) and minimum standard attribute ID for tenant `17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7`, together with the VIF type, the number of administratively-up ports, and the average (by VIF type) of the 2-preceding/2-following windowed average standard attribute ID for tenant `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`; then, for each status/device owner, also return the maximum of those per-VIF-type average window values across all VIF types. sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH PortStatusOwnerStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), AdminUpPortWindowStats AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT psos.port_status, psos.device_owner, psos.port_count, psos.min_standard_attr_id, aupws.VIF_TYPE, COUNT(DISTINCT aupws.PORT_ID) AS admin_up_ports, AVG(aupws.window_column) AS avg_window_standard_attr_id FROM PortStatusOwnerStats psos JOIN AdminUpPortWindowStats aupws ON psos.port_status = aupws.STATUS AND psos.device_owner = aupws.DEVICE_OWNER GROUP BY psos.port_status, psos.device_owner, psos.port_count, psos.min_standard_attr_id, aupws.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY psos.port_count DESC) SELECT port_status, device_owner, MAX(avg_window_standard_attr_id) AS max_avg_window_standard_attr_id_across_vif_types FROM inner_cte GROUP BY port_status, device_owner;

question: For each ACTIVE network (excluding shared networks), list the network name, status, and admin_state_up along with its RBAC action and target tenant (including the dense-rank window column), and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP version for that same RBAC action computed over DHCP-enabled subnets on non-shared networks (only actions with more than 5 matching subnets). Additionally, for each RBAC action, show the maximum of the per-network subnet counts (counting DHCP-enabled subnets on non-shared networks) across all networks that have that action. sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 AND s.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.ACTION HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY ip_version_stddev DESC ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM networksecuritybindings b JOIN networks n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN networkrbacs r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ) SELECT s2.name, s2.status, s2.admin_state_up, s2.action, s2.target_tenant, s2.window_column, s1.ip_version_stddev FROM Subq2 s2 JOIN Subq1 s1 ON s2.action = s1.ACTION ), PerNetworkSubnetCounts AS ( SELECT r.action, s.network_id, COUNT(*) AS dhcp_subnet_count FROM networkrbacs r JOIN subnets s ON r.object_id = s.network_id WHERE s.enable_dhcp = 1 AND s.network_id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY r.action, s.network_id ), MaxSubnetCountsByAction AS ( SELECT action, MAX(dhcp_subnet_count) AS max_dhcp_subnet_count_per_network FROM PerNetworkSubnetCounts GROUP BY action ) SELECT i.name, i.status, i.admin_state_up, i.action, i.target_tenant, i.window_column, i.ip_version_stddev, m.max_dhcp_subnet_count_per_network FROM inner_cte i JOIN MaxSubnetCountsByAction m ON i.action = m.action;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH PortStatusOwnerSecurityGroupStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), PortStatusBindingCountDispersion AS ( SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC ) SELECT psosgs.port_status, psosgs.device_owner, psosgs.port_count, psosgs.min_standard_attr_id, psbcd.binding_count_range, psbcd.binding_count_variance, psbcd.binding_count_stddev FROM PortStatusOwnerSecurityGroupStats psosgs JOIN PortStatusBindingCountDispersion psbcd ON psosgs.port_status = psbcd.status ORDER BY psosgs.port_status, psosgs.device_owner ), StatusOwnerAverages AS ( SELECT port_status, AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count_per_owner FROM inner_cte GROUP BY port_status ) SELECT i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.min_standard_attr_id, i.binding_count_range, i.binding_count_variance, i.binding_count_stddev FROM inner_cte i JOIN StatusOwnerAverages soa ON i.port_status = soa.port_status WHERE i.port_count > soa.avg_port_count_per_owner ORDER BY i.port_status, i.device_owner;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DownPortsBySecurityGroup AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), AdminUpPortBindingAndDnsCounts AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN PORTDNSES pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name ) SELECT dpsg.security_group_id, COUNT(DISTINCT dpsg.port_id) AS down_port_count, MAX(au.security_group_binding_count) AS max_security_group_binding_count_among_admin_up_ports, SUM(au.dns_record_count) AS total_dns_record_count_for_admin_up_ports, ROUND( SUM(au.dns_record_count) / NULLIF(MAX(au.security_group_binding_count), 0), 2 ) AS dns_records_per_max_binding_ratio FROM DownPortsBySecurityGroup dpsg JOIN AdminUpPortBindingAndDnsCounts au ON au.port_id = dpsg.port_id AND au.tenant_id = dpsg.tenant_id WHERE dpsg.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY dpsg.security_group_id ORDER BY dns_records_per_max_binding_ratio DESC) , NetworkSecurityGroupRatios AS ( SELECT p.network_id, i.security_group_id, i.dns_records_per_max_binding_ratio FROM inner_cte i JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb ON sgpb.security_group_id = i.security_group_id JOIN PORTS p ON p.id = sgpb.port_id ) SELECT network_id, MAX(dns_records_per_max_binding_ratio) AS max_dns_records_per_max_binding_ratio FROM NetworkSecurityGroupRatios GROUP BY network_id;

question: Using the existing result set of ACTIVE networks that have an RBAC entry and max MTU greater than 8000 (restricted to the shared RBAC action) along with the IPv4 subnet IP-version statistics for the "access_as_shared" permission, show the same network-level rows but also include subtotals by RBAC action and a grand total, reporting the number of networks and the maximum MTU across each rollup level. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH RbacIpVersionStats AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ), HighMtuRbacNetworks AS ( SELECT n.name AS network_name, r.action AS rbac_action, MAX(n.mtu) AS max_mtu FROM NETWORKSECURITYBINDINGS nsb JOIN NETWORKS n ON nsb.network_id = n.id JOIN NETWORKRBACS r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.action IN ('access_as_shared', 'access_as_external') GROUP BY n.name, r.action HAVING MAX(n.mtu) > 8000 ), FilteredHighMtuSharedNetworks AS ( SELECT hmn.network_name, hmn.rbac_action, hmn.max_mtu FROM HighMtuRbacNetworks hmn WHERE hmn.rbac_action = 'access_as_shared' ) SELECT f.network_name, f.rbac_action, f.max_mtu, r.avg_ip_version, r.ip_version_variance, r.ip_version_stddev FROM FilteredHighMtuSharedNetworks f JOIN RbacIpVersionStats r ON r.ACTION = f.rbac_action ORDER BY f.max_mtu DESC, f.network_name) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.rbac_action) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.rbac_action END AS rbac_action, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.network_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(inner_cte.rbac_action) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.network_name END AS network_name, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.network_name) AS total_networks, MAX(inner_cte.max_mtu) AS max_mtu, MAX(inner_cte.avg_ip_version) AS avg_ip_version, MAX(inner_cte.ip_version_variance) AS ip_version_variance, MAX(inner_cte.ip_version_stddev) AS ip_version_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.rbac_action, inner_cte.network_name WITH ROLLUP;

sub_sqls: SELECT n.ACTION, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC;

SELECT n.name AS network_name, r.action AS rbac_action, MAX(n.mtu) AS max_mtu FROM NETWORKSECURITYBINDINGS nsb JOIN NETWORKS n ON nsb.network_id = n.id JOIN NETWORKRBACS r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.action IN ('access_as_shared', 'access_as_external') GROUP BY n.name, r.action HAVING MAX(n.mtu) > 8000;

WITH RbacIpVersionStats AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ), HighMtuRbacNetworks AS ( SELECT n.name AS network_name, r.action AS rbac_action, MAX(n.mtu) AS max_mtu FROM NETWORKSECURITYBINDINGS nsb JOIN NETWORKS n ON nsb.network_id = n.id JOIN NETWORKRBACS r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.action IN ('access_as_shared', 'access_as_external') GROUP BY n.name, r.action HAVING MAX(n.mtu) > 8000 ), FilteredHighMtuSharedNetworks AS ( SELECT hmn.network_name, hmn.rbac_action, hmn.max_mtu FROM HighMtuRbacNetworks hmn WHERE hmn.rbac_action = 'access_as_shared' ) SELECT f.network_name, f.rbac_action, f.max_mtu, r.avg_ip_version, r.ip_version_variance, r.ip_version_stddev FROM FilteredHighMtuSharedNetworks f JOIN RbacIpVersionStats r ON r.ACTION = f.rbac_action ORDER BY f.max_mtu DESC, f.network_name;

question: For tenant ID '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7' and port status 'DOWN', produce the same combined two-part report as before (security-group-bound port summary by device owner, plus port-security-binding dispersion by status with a reason label), and additionally include a tenant-level context column that shows the total number of ports owned by that tenant and the average number of ports per tenant across the whole system. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH PortStatusOwnerStats AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER), PortSecurityBindingDispersion AS (SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC), CombinedPortStats AS ( SELECT pso.port_status AS status, pso.device_owner AS device_owner, pso.port_count AS port_count, pso.min_standard_attr_id AS min_standard_attr_id, NULL AS binding_count_range, NULL AS binding_count_variance, NULL AS binding_count_stddev, 'Security Group Bound Port Summary' AS reason FROM PortStatusOwnerStats pso UNION ALL SELECT psbd.status AS status, NULL AS device_owner, NULL AS port_count, NULL AS min_standard_attr_id, psbd.binding_count_range AS binding_count_range, psbd.binding_count_variance AS binding_count_variance, psbd.binding_count_stddev AS binding_count_stddev, 'Port Security Binding Dispersion' AS reason FROM PortSecurityBindingDispersion psbd ) SELECT * FROM CombinedPortStats ORDER BY status, reason, device_owner) SELECT inner_cte.*, tenant_totals.total_ports_for_tenant, avg_ports.avg_port_count_across_tenants FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT p.tenant_id, COUNT(p.id) AS total_ports_for_tenant FROM ports p GROUP BY p.tenant_id) AS tenant_totals ON tenant_totals.tenant_id = '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7' JOIN (SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count_across_tenants FROM (SELECT COUNT(id) AS port_count FROM ports GROUP BY tenant_id) AS sub) AS avg_ports ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY inner_cte.status, inner_cte.reason, inner_cte.device_owner;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH network_status_security_stats AS ( SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, VARIANCE(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_variance, STDDEV(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_stddev FROM NETWORKS AS n JOIN NETWORKSECURITYBINDINGS AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.STATUS ORDER BY port_security_enabled_variance DESC ), active_network_rbac_details AS ( SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM networksecuritybindings b JOIN networks n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN networkrbacs r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ), active_network_rbac_summary AS ( SELECT status AS network_status, COUNT(*) AS active_network_rbac_row_count FROM active_network_rbac_details GROUP BY status ) SELECT nsss.network_status, nsss.port_security_enabled_variance, nsss.port_security_enabled_stddev, anrs.active_network_rbac_row_count FROM network_status_security_stats nsss LEFT JOIN active_network_rbac_summary anrs ON anrs.network_status = nsss.network_status) SELECT i.network_status, i.port_security_enabled_variance, i.port_security_enabled_stddev, i.active_network_rbac_row_count, avg_counts.avg_active_network_rbac_row_count FROM inner_cte i JOIN (SELECT AVG(active_network_rbac_row_count) AS avg_active_network_rbac_row_count FROM inner_cte) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1;

question: For each ACTIVE network (with a security binding) that has an RBAC action of either 'access_as_shared' or 'access_as_external' and whose maximum MTU is greater than 8000, list the network name, the RBAC action, that maximum MTU, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP version numbers for that RBAC action considering only DHCP-enabled subnets and excluding shared networks (those with an `access_as_shared` RBAC entry targeting `'*'` or `'9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'`), keeping only RBAC actions with more than 5 matching subnets, and also include the deviation of each network’s maximum MTU from the overall average of these maximum MTUs across all returned networks. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH RbacActionIpVersionStddev AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 AND s.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.ACTION HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY ip_version_stddev DESC ), ActiveHighMtuNetworksByRbacAction AS ( SELECT n.name AS network_name, r.action AS rbac_action, MAX(n.mtu) AS max_mtu FROM NETWORKSECURITYBINDINGS nsb JOIN NETWORKS n ON nsb.network_id = n.id JOIN NETWORKRBACS r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.action IN ('access_as_shared', 'access_as_external') GROUP BY n.name, r.action HAVING MAX(n.mtu) > 8000 ) SELECT ahmn.network_name, ahmn.rbac_action, ahmn.max_mtu, raivs.ip_version_stddev FROM ActiveHighMtuNetworksByRbacAction ahmn JOIN RbacActionIpVersionStddev raivs ON ahmn.rbac_action = raivs.ACTION ORDER BY ahmn.max_mtu DESC, raivs.ip_version_stddev DESC), AvgMaxMtu AS (SELECT AVG(max_mtu) AS avg_max_mtu FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.network_name, i.rbac_action, i.max_mtu, i.ip_version_stddev, (i.max_mtu - a.avg_max_mtu) AS deviation_from_avg_max_mtu FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN AvgMaxMtu a ORDER BY i.max_mtu DESC, i.ip_version_stddev DESC;

question: For the IPv4 subnet whose ID is `012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48`, return the subnet name, (1) the dense rank of its associated standard attribute when ordered by the standard attribute UPDATED_AT timestamp using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows, and (2) the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of routes per subnet; additionally, indicate whether the subnet’s standard attribute has a non-empty DESCRIPTION. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH SubnetWindowRanks AS ( SELECT s.NAME, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY sa.UPDATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES AS sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') ), SubnetRouteStats AS ( SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(route_count) - MIN(route_count) AS route_count_range, VARIANCE(route_count) AS route_count_variance, STDDEV(route_count) AS route_count_stddev FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN ( SELECT sr.SUBNET_ID, COUNT(*) AS route_count FROM SUBNETROUTES AS sr GROUP BY sr.SUBNET_ID, sr.NEXTHOP ) AS route_stats ON s.ID = route_stats.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY route_count_range DESC ) SELECT swr.NAME AS subnet_name, swr.window_column, srs.route_count_range, srs.route_count_variance, srs.route_count_stddev FROM SubnetWindowRanks AS swr JOIN SubnetRouteStats AS srs ON srs.subnet_name = swr.NAME ORDER BY swr.NAME, swr.window_column) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.window_column, i.route_count_range, i.route_count_variance, i.route_count_stddev, CASE WHEN COALESCE(sa.DESCRIPTION, '') <> '' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_standardattr_description FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON s.NAME = i.subnet_name AND s.IP_VERSION = 4 JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES AS sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ORDER BY i.subnet_name, i.window_column;

question: For the RBAC action **access_as_shared**, return the action name together with the previously computed subnet IP-version statistics, and additionally report (for that same action) the **maximum number of distinct target tenants** associated with any single referenced network (i.e., per network, count distinct `TARGET_TENANT`, then take the maximum across networks). sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 AND s.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.ACTION HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY ip_version_stddev DESC ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT n.ACTION AS rbac_action, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, MAX(s.IP_VERSION) - MIN(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_range, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION IN (4, 6) AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_range DESC ) SELECT s2.rbac_action, s2.avg_ip_version, s2.ip_version_range, s2.ip_version_variance, s1.ip_version_stddev FROM Subq2 s2 LEFT JOIN Subq1 s1 ON s1.ACTION = s2.rbac_action ) , TargetTenantCountsPerNetwork AS ( SELECT n.action, n.object_id AS network_id, COUNT(DISTINCT n.target_tenant) AS distinct_target_tenants FROM NETWORKRBACS n JOIN SUBNETS s ON s.network_id = n.object_id WHERE n.action = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.action, n.object_id ), MaxTargetTenantsByAction AS ( SELECT action, MAX(distinct_target_tenants) AS max_distinct_target_tenants_on_any_network FROM TargetTenantCountsPerNetwork GROUP BY action ) SELECT i.rbac_action, i.avg_ip_version, i.ip_version_range, i.ip_version_variance, i.ip_version_stddev, m.max_distinct_target_tenants_on_any_network FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN MaxTargetTenantsByAction m ON m.action = i.rbac_action;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH PortStatusOwnerSecurityGroupStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), PortStatusBindingCountDispersion AS ( SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC ) SELECT psosgs.port_status, psosgs.device_owner, psosgs.port_count, psosgs.min_standard_attr_id, psbcd.binding_count_range, psbcd.binding_count_variance, psbcd.binding_count_stddev FROM PortStatusOwnerSecurityGroupStats psosgs JOIN PortStatusBindingCountDispersion psbcd ON psosgs.port_status = psbcd.status ORDER BY psosgs.port_count DESC) , StatusAverages AS ( SELECT port_status, AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY port_status ) SELECT i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.min_standard_attr_id, i.binding_count_range, i.binding_count_variance, i.binding_count_stddev FROM inner_cte i JOIN StatusAverages sa ON sa.port_status = i.port_status WHERE i.port_count > (SELECT avg_port_count FROM StatusAverages WHERE StatusAverages.port_status = i.port_status) ORDER BY i.port_count DESC;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH PortStatusOwnerAgg AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER), DownNetworkPortDetails AS (SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d')) SELECT dnpd.DEVICE_OWNER, dnpd.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, psa.port_count, psa.min_standard_attr_id, COUNT(*) AS matching_down_ports_in_network FROM DownNetworkPortDetails dnpd JOIN PORTS p ON p.MAC_ADDRESS = dnpd.MAC_ADDRESS AND p.NETWORK_ID = dnpd.NETWORK_ID AND p.DEVICE_OWNER = dnpd.DEVICE_OWNER AND p.STATUS = dnpd.STATUS JOIN PortStatusOwnerAgg psa ON psa.port_status = dnpd.STATUS AND psa.device_owner = dnpd.DEVICE_OWNER WHERE p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY dnpd.DEVICE_OWNER, dnpd.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, psa.port_count, psa.min_standard_attr_id ORDER BY matching_down_ports_in_network DESC, dnpd.DEVICE_OWNER, dnpd.SECURITY_GROUP_ID) SELECT inner_cte.DEVICE_OWNER, inner_cte.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, inner_cte.port_count, inner_cte.min_standard_attr_id, inner_cte.matching_down_ports_in_network, avg_stats.avg_matching_down_ports_in_network FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT AVG(matching_down_ports_in_network) AS avg_matching_down_ports_in_network FROM inner_cte) AS avg_stats ON 1 = 1;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH PortStatusOwnerStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), PortStatusAttrIdVariance AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, VARIANCE(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM PORTS AS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NOT NULL AND ia.IP_ADDRESS IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.STATUS ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC ) SELECT psos.port_status, psos.device_owner, psos.port_count, psos.earliest_standard_attr_update, psav.standard_attr_id_variance FROM PortStatusOwnerStats psos JOIN PortStatusAttrIdVariance psav ON psos.port_status = psav.STATUS ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(port_status) OVER (ORDER BY port_status_sort, port_status, device_owner) = port_status THEN NULL ELSE port_status END AS port_status, device_owner, port_count, earliest_standard_attr_update, standard_attr_id_variance FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.port_status) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.port_status END AS port_status_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.port_status) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.port_status END AS port_status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.device_owner) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE i.device_owner END AS device_owner, SUM(i.port_count) AS port_count, MIN(i.earliest_standard_attr_update) AS earliest_standard_attr_update, MAX(i.standard_attr_id_variance) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.port_status, i.device_owner WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY port_status_sort, port_status, device_owner;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH PortIpAllocStats AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address), DownPortsSecurityGroups AS (SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d')) SELECT dpsg.NETWORK_ID, dpsg.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, COUNT(*) AS down_port_rows, AVG(dpsg.window_column) AS avg_window_min_admin_state_up, COUNT(DISTINCT pis.port_id) AS matching_admin_up_ports_with_ip_allocations, SUM(pis.ip_allocation_count) AS total_ip_allocations_on_matching_ports, SUM(pis.subnet_id_rows) AS total_subnet_id_rows_on_matching_ports FROM DownPortsSecurityGroups dpsg LEFT JOIN ports p ON p.network_id = dpsg.network_id AND p.mac_address = dpsg.mac_address LEFT JOIN PortIpAllocStats pis ON pis.port_id = p.id GROUP BY dpsg.NETWORK_ID, dpsg.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY down_port_rows DESC, matching_admin_up_ports_with_ip_allocations DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(network_id) OVER (ORDER BY network_id_sort, network_id, security_group_id) = network_id THEN NULL ELSE network_id END AS network_id, security_group_id, down_port_rows, avg_window_min_admin_state_up, matching_admin_up_ports_with_ip_allocations, total_ip_allocations_on_matching_ports, total_subnet_id_rows_on_matching_ports FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.network_id) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.network_id END AS network_id_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.network_id) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.network_id END AS network_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.network_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE i.security_group_id END AS security_group_id, SUM(i.down_port_rows) AS down_port_rows, AVG(i.avg_window_min_admin_state_up) AS avg_window_min_admin_state_up, SUM(i.matching_admin_up_ports_with_ip_allocations) AS matching_admin_up_ports_with_ip_allocations, SUM(i.total_ip_allocations_on_matching_ports) AS total_ip_allocations_on_matching_ports, SUM(i.total_subnet_id_rows_on_matching_ports) AS total_subnet_id_rows_on_matching_ports FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.network_id, i.security_group_id WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY network_id_sort, network_id, security_group_id;

question: For each RBAC action that appears in both (a) RBAC entries with action = 'access_as_shared' referencing IPv4 subnets and (b) RBAC-referenced networks that have DHCP-enabled subnets and are not shared to target tenant '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b' (with more than 5 matching subnets), list the action along with the shared/IPv4 average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP version, the DHCP-enabled not-shared standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP version, and also include the overall average of the shared/IPv4 average IP version across all such actions. sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH rbac_ip_version_stats_shared AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ), rbac_ip_version_stddev_dhcp_not_shared AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 AND s.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.ACTION HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY ip_version_stddev DESC ) SELECT s1.ACTION, s1.avg_ip_version, s1.ip_version_variance, s1.ip_version_stddev AS shared_ip_version_stddev, s2.ip_version_stddev AS dhcp_not_shared_ip_version_stddev FROM rbac_ip_version_stats_shared s1 JOIN rbac_ip_version_stddev_dhcp_not_shared s2 ON s1.ACTION = s2.ACTION) SELECT i.ACTION, i.avg_ip_version, i.ip_version_variance, i.shared_ip_version_stddev, i.dhcp_not_shared_ip_version_stddev, overall_avg.avg_of_avg_ip_version AS overall_shared_ipv4_avg_ip_version_across_actions FROM inner_cte i JOIN (SELECT AVG(avg_ip_version) AS avg_of_avg_ip_version FROM inner_cte) AS overall_avg;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH PortStatusOwnerAgg AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), DownPortsWithSG AS ( SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') ), DownPortsSGCounts AS ( SELECT dp.STATUS AS port_status, dp.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(*) AS down_ports_in_network_with_sg FROM DownPortsWithSG dp GROUP BY dp.STATUS, dp.DEVICE_OWNER ) SELECT psoa.port_status, psoa.device_owner, psoa.port_count, psoa.earliest_standard_attr_update, dpsc.down_ports_in_network_with_sg FROM PortStatusOwnerAgg psoa JOIN DownPortsSGCounts dpsc ON psoa.port_status = dpsc.port_status AND psoa.device_owner = dpsc.device_owner ORDER BY psoa.port_count DESC) , AvgPortCount AS (SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.earliest_standard_attr_update, i.down_ports_in_network_with_sg, (i.port_count - a.avg_port_count) AS deviation_from_avg_port_count FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN AvgPortCount a ORDER BY i.port_count DESC;

question: For the subnet with ID `012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48` (IPv4 only) and considering only routes whose next hop is `10.30.19.197/8`, return the subnet name along with (1) the range and variance of allocation-pool starting IPs (FIRST_IP) across its IP allocation pools and (2) the dense-rank of its associated standard attribute when ordered by the standard attribute UPDATED_AT timestamp using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows, plus the subnet’s tenant ID and the average FIRST_IP range across all subnets that have routes with next hop `10.30.19.197/8`. binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC ), down_ports_with_security_groups AS ( SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') ), down_ports_with_security_groups_tenant_filtered AS ( SELECT dpsg.NAME, dpsg.NETWORK_ID, dpsg.MAC_ADDRESS, dpsg.ADMIN_STATE_UP, dpsg.STATUS, dpsg.DEVICE_OWNER, dpsg.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, dpsg.window_column FROM down_ports_with_security_groups dpsg JOIN ports p ON p.network_id = dpsg.NETWORK_ID AND p.mac_address = dpsg.MAC_ADDRESS WHERE p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') ) SELECT psbs.status, psbs.binding_count_range, psbs.binding_count_variance, psbs.binding_count_stddev, COUNT(*) AS down_port_rows_for_tenant_and_network FROM port_security_binding_stats_by_status psbs CROSS JOIN down_ports_with_security_groups_tenant_filtered dptf GROUP BY psbs.status, psbs.binding_count_range, psbs.binding_count_variance, psbs.binding_count_stddev ORDER BY psbs.binding_count_range DESC) , DownPortSecurityGroups AS ( SELECT p.network_id, p.id AS port_id, COUNT(DISTINCT spb.security_group_id) AS security_group_count FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ports p ON p.status = ic.status JOIN securitygroupportbindings spb ON p.id = spb.port_id WHERE p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') AND p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.network_id IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') GROUP BY p.network_id, p.id ) SELECT ic.status, ic.binding_count_range, ic.binding_count_variance, ic.binding_count_stddev, ic.down_port_rows_for_tenant_and_network, MAX(dpsg.security_group_count) AS max_security_groups_on_any_down_port FROM inner_cte ic JOIN DownPortSecurityGroups dpsg ON dpsg.network_id IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') GROUP BY ic.status, ic.binding_count_range, ic.binding_count_variance, ic.binding_count_stddev, ic.down_port_rows_for_tenant_and_network ORDER BY ic.binding_count_range DESC;
