question: Among the (port status, device owner) pairs returned by the existing port aggregation (only ports whose standard attribute resource type is 'ports' and excluding shared networks), list only those pairs where more than 25% of the ports are DOWN ports on network ID '0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d' that have a security-group binding. For each qualifying pair, show the total port count, the earliest standard attribute updated timestamp, the count of such DOWN+security-group ports, and the resulting ratio. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH PortStatusOwnerAgg AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), DownPortsWithSG AS ( SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') ), DownPortsSGCounts AS ( SELECT dp.STATUS AS port_status, dp.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(*) AS down_ports_in_network_with_sg FROM DownPortsWithSG dp GROUP BY dp.STATUS, dp.DEVICE_OWNER ) SELECT psoa.port_status, psoa.device_owner, psoa.port_count, psoa.earliest_standard_attr_update, dpsc.down_ports_in_network_with_sg FROM PortStatusOwnerAgg psoa JOIN DownPortsSGCounts dpsc ON psoa.port_status = dpsc.port_status AND psoa.device_owner = dpsc.device_owner ORDER BY psoa.port_count DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.port_status, inner_cte.device_owner, inner_cte.port_count, inner_cte.earliest_standard_attr_update, inner_cte.down_ports_in_network_with_sg, (inner_cte.down_ports_in_network_with_sg * 1.0 / NULLIF(inner_cte.port_count, 0)) AS down_sg_ratio FROM inner_cte JOIN PORTS p2 ON p2.DEVICE_OWNER = inner_cte.device_owner AND p2.STATUS = inner_cte.port_status WHERE (inner_cte.down_ports_in_network_with_sg * 1.0 / NULLIF(inner_cte.port_count, 0)) > 0.25 GROUP BY inner_cte.port_status, inner_cte.device_owner, inner_cte.port_count, inner_cte.earliest_standard_attr_update, inner_cte.down_ports_in_network_with_sg ORDER BY down_sg_ratio DESC, inner_cte.port_count DESC;

question: For the RBAC action access_as_shared, list the top 10 RBAC-owning tenants (by number of distinct networks referenced by that action) and show, for each tenant: (1) the number of distinct networks referenced, (2) the average subnet IP version, (3) the subnet IP version range (max minus min), (4) the variance of subnet IP version considering only public RBAC entries where target_tenant = '*', and (5) the overall variance of subnet IP version across all subnets on networks referenced by that tenant’s RBAC entries for the action. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH q1 AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT = '*' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ), q2 AS ( SELECT n.ACTION AS rbac_action, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, MAX(s.IP_VERSION) - MIN(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_range, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION IN (4, 6) AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_range DESC ) SELECT q1.ACTION AS rbac_action, q2.avg_ip_version, q2.ip_version_range, q1.ip_version_variance AS public_access_ip_version_variance, q2.ip_version_variance AS overall_ip_version_variance FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.ACTION = q2.rbac_action ORDER BY q2.ip_version_range DESC ), tenant_stats AS ( SELECT n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT n.OBJECT_ID) AS distinct_networks_referenced, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, MAX(s.IP_VERSION) - MIN(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_range, VARIANCE(CASE WHEN n.TARGET_TENANT = '*' THEN s.IP_VERSION END) AS public_access_ip_version_variance, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS overall_ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND s.IP_VERSION IN (4, 6) GROUP BY n.TENANT_ID ) SELECT t.tenant_id, t.distinct_networks_referenced, t.avg_ip_version, t.ip_version_range, t.public_access_ip_version_variance, t.overall_ip_version_variance, i.rbac_action AS action_name, i.public_access_ip_version_variance AS action_level_public_access_ip_version_variance, i.overall_ip_version_variance AS action_level_overall_ip_version_variance FROM tenant_stats t CROSS JOIN inner_cte i ORDER BY t.distinct_networks_referenced DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Using the existing result set for tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57" (administratively-up ports on ACTIVE networks owned by the same tenant), summarize by tenant and report: the tenant ID, the total number of distinct matching networks, the total number of distinct matching ports, and whether the tenant has any matching ports with VIF type "ovs". Order by total ports descending and return only the top 10 tenants. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH ActiveTenantNetworks AS (SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), AdminUpTenantPorts AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')) SELECT n.network_id, n.network_name, n.tenant_id, n.admin_state_up AS network_admin_state_up, n.mtu, n.standard_attr_updated_at AS network_standard_attr_updated_at, n.window_column AS network_row_number_within_tenant, p.PORT_ID AS port_id, p.HOST AS port_host, p.VIF_TYPE AS port_vif_type, p.VNIC_TYPE AS port_vnic_type, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS port_mac_address, p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS port_device_owner, p.window_column AS port_avg_standard_attr_id_window FROM ActiveTenantNetworks n JOIN AdminUpTenantPorts p ON p.NETWORK_ID = n.network_id AND p.TENANT_ID = n.tenant_id ORDER BY n.network_name, p.PORT_ID) SELECT i.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT i.network_id) AS total_networks, COUNT(DISTINCT i.port_id) AS total_ports, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN i.port_vif_type = 'ovs' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_ovs_vif_type FROM inner_cte i GROUP BY i.tenant_id ORDER BY total_ports DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each ACTIVE network (with a security binding) that has an RBAC action of either 'access_as_shared' or 'access_as_external' and whose maximum MTU is greater than 8000, list the network name, the RBAC action, that maximum MTU, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP version numbers for that RBAC action considering only DHCP-enabled subnets and excluding shared networks (those with an `access_as_shared` RBAC entry targeting `'*'` or `'9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'`), keeping only RBAC actions with more than 5 matching subnets. Do not repeat the network name if it is the same as the previous row, and include a final TOTAL row across all returned networks. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH RbacActionIpVersionStddev AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 AND s.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.ACTION HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY ip_version_stddev DESC ), ActiveHighMtuNetworksByRbacAction AS ( SELECT n.name AS network_name, r.action AS rbac_action, MAX(n.mtu) AS max_mtu FROM NETWORKSECURITYBINDINGS nsb JOIN NETWORKS n ON nsb.network_id = n.id JOIN NETWORKRBACS r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.action IN ('access_as_shared', 'access_as_external') GROUP BY n.name, r.action HAVING MAX(n.mtu) > 8000 ) SELECT ahmn.network_name, ahmn.rbac_action, ahmn.max_mtu, raivs.ip_version_stddev FROM ActiveHighMtuNetworksByRbacAction ahmn JOIN RbacActionIpVersionStddev raivs ON ahmn.rbac_action = raivs.ACTION ORDER BY ahmn.max_mtu DESC, raivs.ip_version_stddev DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(network_name) OVER (ORDER BY network_name_sort, network_name, rbac_action) = network_name THEN NULL ELSE network_name END AS network_name, rbac_action, max_mtu, ip_version_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(network_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE network_name END AS network_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(network_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE network_name END AS network_name, rbac_action, MAX(max_mtu) AS max_mtu, AVG(ip_version_stddev) AS ip_version_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY network_name, rbac_action WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY network_name_sort, network_name, rbac_action;

question: For the RBAC action restricted to the **access_as_shared** permission, show the action name together with (1) the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP version considering only IPv4 subnets, and (2) the average, range (max minus min), and variance of subnet IP version considering both IPv4 and IPv6 subnets, for subnets whose network is referenced by that RBAC entry; additionally, include the deviation of each “both IPv4/IPv6” average from the overall average of those “both IPv4/IPv6” averages. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH sq1 AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ), sq2 AS ( SELECT n.ACTION AS rbac_action, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, MAX(s.IP_VERSION) - MIN(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_range, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION IN (4, 6) AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_range DESC ) SELECT sq2.rbac_action, sq1.avg_ip_version AS avg_ip_version_ipv4_only, sq1.ip_version_variance AS ip_version_variance_ipv4_only, sq1.ip_version_stddev AS ip_version_stddev_ipv4_only, sq2.avg_ip_version AS avg_ip_version_ipv4_or_ipv6, sq2.ip_version_range, sq2.ip_version_variance AS ip_version_variance_ipv4_or_ipv6 FROM sq2 JOIN sq1 ON sq2.rbac_action = sq1.ACTION ORDER BY sq2.ip_version_range DESC ), overall_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(avg_ip_version_ipv4_or_ipv6) AS overall_avg_ip_version_ipv4_or_ipv6 FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.rbac_action, i.avg_ip_version_ipv4_only, i.ip_version_variance_ipv4_only, i.ip_version_stddev_ipv4_only, i.avg_ip_version_ipv4_or_ipv6, i.ip_version_range, i.ip_version_variance_ipv4_or_ipv6, (i.avg_ip_version_ipv4_or_ipv6 - oa.overall_avg_ip_version_ipv4_or_ipv6) AS deviation_from_overall_avg_ipv4_or_ipv6 FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa ORDER BY i.ip_version_range DESC;

question: For tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57', for each qualifying administratively up port that is both bound to a security group and has at least one IP allocation, return the port ID, tenant ID, port name, MAC address, the number of security group bindings, the total number of DNS records on the port, the number of IP allocations, the total number of subnet-id rows from those allocations, along with the average number of IP allocations per qualifying port for that tenant. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH SecurityGroupAndDnsByPort AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN PORTDNSES pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name ), IpAllocationsByPort AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ) SELECT sgd.port_id, sgd.tenant_id, sgd.port_name, ipa.mac_address, sgd.security_group_binding_count, sgd.dns_record_count, ipa.ip_allocation_count, ipa.subnet_id_rows FROM SecurityGroupAndDnsByPort sgd JOIN IpAllocationsByPort ipa ON ipa.port_id = sgd.port_id AND ipa.tenant_id = sgd.tenant_id) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.port_name, i.mac_address, i.security_group_binding_count, i.dns_record_count, i.ip_allocation_count, i.subnet_id_rows, avg_ip.avg_ip_allocations_per_port FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT tenant_id, AVG(ip_allocation_count) AS avg_ip_allocations_per_port FROM inner_cte GROUP BY tenant_id ) AS avg_ip ON avg_ip.tenant_id = i.tenant_id;

question: For each ACTIVE network (excluding shared networks with an `access_as_shared` RBAC entry targeting `'*'` or `9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b`), list the network name, status, and admin_state_up along with its RBAC action and target tenant (including the dense-rank window column) and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP version for that RBAC action (computed only from DHCP-enabled subnets on non-shared networks, considering only actions that have more than 5 matching subnets). Additionally, only include networks whose DHCP-enabled subnet count is above the average DHCP-enabled subnet count across all non-shared networks. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH RbacActionIpVersionStddev AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 AND s.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.ACTION HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY ip_version_stddev DESC ), ActiveNetworkRbacDetails AS ( SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM networksecuritybindings b JOIN networks n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN networkrbacs r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ) SELECT anrd.name, anrd.status, anrd.admin_state_up, anrd.action, anrd.target_tenant, anrd.window_column, rais.ip_version_stddev FROM ActiveNetworkRbacDetails anrd JOIN RbacActionIpVersionStddev rais ON anrd.action = rais.action ORDER BY rais.ip_version_stddev DESC, anrd.name) , NetworkDhcpSubnetCounts AS ( SELECT n.id AS network_id, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS dhcp_subnet_count FROM networks n JOIN subnets s ON s.network_id = n.id WHERE s.enable_dhcp = 1 AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.id ), AvgDhcpSubnetCount AS ( SELECT AVG(dhcp_subnet_count * 1.0) AS avg_dhcp_subnet_count FROM NetworkDhcpSubnetCounts ) SELECT i.name, i.status, i.admin_state_up, i.action, i.target_tenant, i.window_column, i.ip_version_stddev, ndsc.dhcp_subnet_count FROM inner_cte i JOIN networks n ON n.name = i.name AND n.status = i.status AND n.admin_state_up = i.admin_state_up JOIN NetworkDhcpSubnetCounts ndsc ON ndsc.network_id = n.id CROSS JOIN AvgDhcpSubnetCount adc WHERE ndsc.dhcp_subnet_count > adc.avg_dhcp_subnet_count ORDER BY i.ip_version_stddev DESC, ndsc.dhcp_subnet_count DESC, i.name;

question: For ACTIVE networks that have an RBAC entry with action **access_as_shared** and whose maximum MTU (within each network name and RBAC action group) is greater than 8000, list the network name, RBAC action, and that maximum MTU, along with the average, range (max minus min), and variance of subnet IP version (restricted to IP versions 4 and 6) for subnets whose network is referenced by **access_as_shared** RBAC entries. Do not repeat the network name if it is the same as the previous row, and include a final TOTAL row across all returned networks. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH RbacSubnetIpVersionStats AS ( SELECT n.ACTION AS rbac_action, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, MAX(s.IP_VERSION) - MIN(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_range, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION IN (4, 6) AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_range DESC ), HighMtuActiveRbacNetworks AS ( SELECT n.name AS network_name, r.action AS rbac_action, MAX(n.mtu) AS max_mtu FROM NETWORKSECURITYBINDINGS nsb JOIN NETWORKS n ON nsb.network_id = n.id JOIN NETWORKRBACS r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.action IN ('access_as_shared', 'access_as_external') GROUP BY n.name, r.action HAVING MAX(n.mtu) > 8000 ) SELECT hman.network_name, hman.rbac_action, hman.max_mtu, rsivs.avg_ip_version, rsivs.ip_version_range, rsivs.ip_version_variance FROM HighMtuActiveRbacNetworks hman JOIN RbacSubnetIpVersionStats rsivs ON hman.rbac_action = rsivs.rbac_action WHERE hman.rbac_action = 'access_as_shared' ORDER BY hman.max_mtu DESC, hman.network_name ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(network_name) OVER (ORDER BY network_name_sort, network_name) = network_name THEN NULL ELSE network_name END AS network_name, rbac_action, max_mtu, avg_ip_version, ip_version_range, ip_version_variance FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(network_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE network_name END AS network_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(network_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE network_name END AS network_name, MAX(rbac_action) AS rbac_action, MAX(max_mtu) AS max_mtu, AVG(avg_ip_version) AS avg_ip_version, AVG(ip_version_range) AS ip_version_range, AVG(ip_version_variance) AS ip_version_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY network_name WITH ROLLUP ) AS tbltmp ORDER BY network_name_sort, network_name;

question: For tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57", return the active network count, the latest network standard-attribute updated_at timestamp, and the admin-up port/IP-allocation summary; additionally, compute what percentage of that tenant’s IP allocation rows have a non-NULL subnet_id (subnet-id row utilization percentage) and only return the tenant if this percentage is greater than 75%. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH active_networks AS ( SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), admin_up_ports_with_ip_allocs AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ), tenant_port_ip_summary AS ( SELECT p.tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS admin_up_port_count, SUM(p.ip_allocation_count) AS total_ip_allocations, SUM(p.subnet_id_rows) AS total_subnet_id_rows FROM admin_up_ports_with_ip_allocs p GROUP BY p.tenant_id ) SELECT an.tenant_id, COUNT(an.network_id) AS active_network_count, MAX(an.standard_attr_updated_at) AS latest_network_standard_attr_updated_at, tps.admin_up_port_count, tps.total_ip_allocations, tps.total_subnet_id_rows FROM active_networks an JOIN tenant_port_ip_summary tps ON tps.tenant_id = an.tenant_id WHERE an.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY an.tenant_id, tps.admin_up_port_count, tps.total_ip_allocations, tps.total_subnet_id_rows ) SELECT tenant_id, active_network_count, latest_network_standard_attr_updated_at, admin_up_port_count, total_ip_allocations, total_subnet_id_rows, (total_subnet_id_rows * 1.0 / NULLIF(total_ip_allocations, 0)) AS subnet_id_row_utilization_pct FROM inner_cte WHERE total_ip_allocations > 0 AND (total_subnet_id_rows * 1.0 / total_ip_allocations) > 0.75;

WITH active_networks AS ( SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), admin_up_ports_with_ip_allocs AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ), tenant_port_ip_summary AS ( SELECT p.tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS admin_up_port_count, SUM(p.ip_allocation_count) AS total_ip_allocations, SUM(p.subnet_id_rows) AS total_subnet_id_rows FROM admin_up_ports_with_ip_allocs p GROUP BY p.tenant_id ) SELECT an.tenant_id, COUNT(an.network_id) AS active_network_count, MAX(an.standard_attr_updated_at) AS latest_network_standard_attr_updated_at, tps.admin_up_port_count, tps.total_ip_allocations, tps.total_subnet_id_rows FROM active_networks an JOIN tenant_port_ip_summary tps ON tps.tenant_id = an.tenant_id WHERE an.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY an.tenant_id, tps.admin_up_port_count, tps.total_ip_allocations, tps.total_subnet_id_rows;

question: For each port status and device owner, considering only ports whose standard attribute resource type is 'ports' and excluding shared networks (networks whose IDs appear in networkrbacs with action = 'access_as_shared' and target_tenant = '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), list the port count and the earliest standard attribute updated timestamp, and also include (by port status) the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of allocated IP address string lengths for ports with port security enabled restricted to IP address '10.150.64.113/8'. Then, for each port status, return the maximum coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) observed across its device owners. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH PortCountsAndEarliestUpdate AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), PortStatusIpLengthVariation AS ( SELECT p.status, STDDEV(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) / NULLIF(AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM portsecuritybindings psb JOIN ports p ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON p.id = ia.port_id WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1 AND ia.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), CombinedPortStatusMetrics AS ( SELECT pc.port_status AS port_status, pc.device_owner AS device_owner, pc.port_count AS port_count, pc.earliest_standard_attr_update AS earliest_standard_attr_update, pv.coefficient_of_variation AS coefficient_of_variation FROM PortCountsAndEarliestUpdate pc JOIN PortStatusIpLengthVariation pv ON pv.status = pc.port_status ) SELECT port_status, device_owner, port_count, earliest_standard_attr_update, coefficient_of_variation FROM CombinedPortStatusMetrics ORDER BY port_status, device_owner) SELECT port_status, MAX(coefficient_of_variation) AS max_coefficient_of_variation_across_device_owners FROM inner_cte GROUP BY port_status ORDER BY port_status;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DownTenantPortsBySecurityGroup AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), AdminUpTenantPortsWithVifWindow AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')) SELECT aup.VIF_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS admin_up_port_count, COUNT(dtp.port_id) AS down_port_count, (COUNT(dtp.port_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(*)) AS down_share_of_admin_up_ports FROM AdminUpTenantPortsWithVifWindow aup LEFT JOIN DownTenantPortsBySecurityGroup dtp ON dtp.port_id = aup.PORT_ID GROUP BY aup.VIF_TYPE HAVING (COUNT(dtp.port_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(*)) > 0.25) SELECT i.VIF_TYPE, i.admin_up_port_count, i.down_port_count, i.down_share_of_admin_up_ports, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT sgpb.port_id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_any_security_group_binding_among_admin_up_ports FROM inner_cte i JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON b.VIF_TYPE = i.VIF_TYPE JOIN PORTS p ON p.id = b.port_id AND p.tenant_id = '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57' AND p.admin_state_up = 1 LEFT JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb ON sgpb.port_id = p.id GROUP BY i.VIF_TYPE, i.admin_up_port_count, i.down_port_count, i.down_share_of_admin_up_ports ORDER BY i.down_share_of_admin_up_ports DESC;

question: For each port status, list the status, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) (standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) divided by average) of allocated IP address string lengths for ports with port security enabled restricted to IP address '10.150.64.113/8', along with the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of port security bindings per port for ports belonging to tenant ID '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7', and also include the total number of distinct ports observed for that status and the average of those per-status port totals across all statuses. MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC ) SELECT pilcv.status, pilcv.coefficient_of_variation, pbd.binding_count_range, pbd.binding_count_variance, pbd.binding_count_stddev FROM PortStatusIPLenCV pilcv JOIN PortStatusBindingDispersion pbd ON pilcv.status = pbd.status ORDER BY pilcv.coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT i.status, i.coefficient_of_variation, i.binding_count_range, i.binding_count_variance, i.binding_count_stddev, sp.status_port_count, avg_sp.avg_status_port_count FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN ( SELECT p.status, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS status_port_count FROM ports p JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1 AND ia.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8') AND p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.status ) AS sp ON sp.status = i.status JOIN ( SELECT AVG(status_port_count) AS avg_status_port_count FROM ( SELECT p2.status, COUNT(DISTINCT p2.id) AS status_port_count FROM ports p2 JOIN ipallocations ia2 ON ia2.port_id = p2.id JOIN portsecuritybindings psb2 ON psb2.port_id = p2.id WHERE psb2.port_security_enabled = 1 AND ia2.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8') AND p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.status ) AS sub ) AS avg_sp ORDER BY i.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH SubnetPoolAndMaxAttrNext2 AS (SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')), SubnetAttrDenseRankWindow AS (SELECT s.NAME, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY sa.UPDATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES AS sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')) SELECT sp.NAME AS subnet_name, sp.TENANT_ID, sp.NETWORK_ID, sp.IP_VERSION, sp.CIDR, sp.GATEWAY_IP, sp.ENABLE_DHCP, sp.FIRST_IP, sp.LAST_IP, sp.max_standard_attr_id_next2, sadr.window_column AS standard_attr_dense_rank_window FROM SubnetPoolAndMaxAttrNext2 sp JOIN SubnetAttrDenseRankWindow sadr ON sp.NAME = sadr.NAME) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.tenant_id, i.network_id, i.ip_version, i.cidr, i.gateway_ip, i.enable_dhcp, i.first_ip, i.last_ip, i.max_standard_attr_id_next2, i.standard_attr_dense_rank_window, tenant_subnets.total_ipv4_subnets, avg_subnets.avg_ipv4_subnets_per_tenant FROM inner_cte i JOIN (SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(id) AS total_ipv4_subnets FROM subnets WHERE ip_version = 4 GROUP BY tenant_id) AS tenant_subnets ON tenant_subnets.tenant_id = i.tenant_id JOIN (SELECT AVG(subnet_count) AS avg_ipv4_subnets_per_tenant FROM (SELECT COUNT(id) AS subnet_count FROM subnets WHERE ip_version = 4 GROUP BY tenant_id) AS per_tenant) AS avg_subnets ON 1 = 1;

question: Using the RBAC/subnet IP-version statistics result as an inner CTE, for each RBAC action show the action-level metrics (average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of IP version for the shared IPv4 set; and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of IP version for the DHCP-enabled not-shared set) and also include a rollup that adds a subtotal row per action and a grand total row across all actions. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH rbac_ip_version_stats_shared AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ), rbac_ip_version_stddev_dhcp_not_shared AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 AND s.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.ACTION HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY ip_version_stddev DESC ) SELECT s1.ACTION, s1.avg_ip_version, s1.ip_version_variance, s1.ip_version_stddev AS shared_ip_version_stddev, s2.ip_version_stddev AS dhcp_not_shared_ip_version_stddev FROM rbac_ip_version_stats_shared s1 JOIN rbac_ip_version_stddev_dhcp_not_shared s2 ON s1.ACTION = s2.ACTION) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.ACTION) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE i.ACTION END AS ACTION, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.avg_ip_version) = 1 AND GROUPING(i.ACTION) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE 'DETAIL' END AS row_level, AVG(i.avg_ip_version) AS avg_ip_version, AVG(i.ip_version_variance) AS ip_version_variance, AVG(i.shared_ip_version_stddev) AS shared_ip_version_stddev, AVG(i.dhcp_not_shared_ip_version_stddev) AS dhcp_not_shared_ip_version_stddev FROM inner_cte i JOIN NETWORKRBACS n ON n.ACTION = i.ACTION GROUP BY i.ACTION, i.avg_ip_version WITH ROLLUP;

question: For tenant_id '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7' and ports with status 'DOWN' that are bound to a security group, list each device owner with the distinct port count and the minimum standard attribute ID, also show (by port status) the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of standard attribute IDs for ports that have both a security group port binding and a port security binding, and additionally indicate whether each device owner has any ports that are associated with a floating IP (via fixed_port_id). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT p.status, STDDEV(p.standard_attr_id) / NULLIF(AVG(p.standard_attr_id), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM securitygroupportbindings AS sgpb JOIN ports AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN portsecuritybindings AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(p.standard_attr_id) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ) SELECT s2.port_status, s2.device_owner, s2.port_count, s2.min_standard_attr_id, s1.coefficient_of_variation FROM Subq2 s2 JOIN Subq1 s1 ON s2.port_status = s1.status ) SELECT i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.min_standard_attr_id, i.coefficient_of_variation, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT f.id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_floating_ips FROM inner_cte i JOIN ports p2 ON p2.tenant_id = '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7' AND p2.status = i.port_status AND p2.device_owner = i.device_owner LEFT JOIN floatingips f ON p2.id = f.fixed_port_id GROUP BY i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.min_standard_attr_id, i.coefficient_of_variation;

question: For each port status and device owner (considering only ports whose standard attribute resource type is 'ports' and excluding shared networks where networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' and target_tenant is '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), return the port status, device owner, number of ports, earliest standard attribute updated timestamp, and (for that same port status) the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of allocated IP address string lengths for ports with port security enabled and allocated IP address '10.150.64.113/8', ordered by the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) descending; additionally, only include (port status, device owner) groups whose port_count is greater than the average port_count across all returned (port status, device owner) groups. sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH PortStatusOwnerCounts AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), PortStatusIpLenCV AS ( SELECT p.status, STDDEV(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) / NULLIF(AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM portsecuritybindings psb JOIN ports p ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON p.id = ia.port_id WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1 AND ia.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT psoc.port_status, psoc.device_owner, psoc.port_count, psoc.earliest_standard_attr_update, psicv.coefficient_of_variation FROM PortStatusOwnerCounts psoc JOIN PortStatusIpLenCV psicv ON psoc.port_status = psicv.status WHERE psoc.port_count > 0 ORDER BY psicv.coefficient_of_variation DESC, psoc.port_count DESC ) SELECT port_status, device_owner, port_count, earliest_standard_attr_update, coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte WHERE port_count > (SELECT AVG(port_count) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC, port_count DESC;

question: For RBAC actions that (1) are `access_as_shared` and reference IPv4 subnets and (2) also have more than 5 DHCP-enabled subnets on non-shared networks (excluding networks shared to `'*'` or tenant `9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b`), return the action along with the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP version for the shared/IPv4 case, plus the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP version for the DHCP-enabled non-shared case; also include the overall average of the shared/IPv4 standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all returned actions as a benchmark and label each action as 'HIGH_VOLATILITY' (at least 50% above benchmark), 'LOW_VOLATILITY' (at least 50% below benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_VOLATILITY'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH RbacSharedIpVersionStats AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ), RbacDhcpNonSharedStddev AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 AND s.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.ACTION HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY ip_version_stddev DESC ) SELECT rs.ACTION, rs.avg_ip_version, rs.ip_version_variance, rs.ip_version_stddev AS shared_ip_version_stddev, rd.ip_version_stddev AS dhcp_nonshared_ip_version_stddev FROM RbacSharedIpVersionStats rs JOIN RbacDhcpNonSharedStddev rd ON rs.ACTION = rd.ACTION ), SharedStddevBenchmark AS ( SELECT AVG(shared_ip_version_stddev) AS avg_shared_stddev FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.ACTION, i.avg_ip_version, i.ip_version_variance, i.shared_ip_version_stddev, i.dhcp_nonshared_ip_version_stddev, b.avg_shared_stddev AS benchmark_shared_stddev, CASE WHEN i.shared_ip_version_stddev > b.avg_shared_stddev * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VOLATILITY' WHEN i.shared_ip_version_stddev < b.avg_shared_stddev * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VOLATILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VOLATILITY' END AS volatility_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN SharedStddevBenchmark b;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH SubnetPoolAndMaxAttrNext2 AS (SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')), SubnetAttrDenseRankWindow AS (SELECT s.NAME, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY sa.UPDATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES AS sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')) SELECT sp.NAME AS subnet_name, sp.TENANT_ID, sp.NETWORK_ID, sp.IP_VERSION, sp.CIDR, sp.GATEWAY_IP, sp.ENABLE_DHCP, sp.FIRST_IP, sp.LAST_IP, sp.max_standard_attr_id_next2, sadr.window_column AS standard_attr_dense_rank_window FROM SubnetPoolAndMaxAttrNext2 sp JOIN SubnetAttrDenseRankWindow sadr ON sp.NAME = sadr.NAME) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.IP_VERSION, i.CIDR, i.GATEWAY_IP, i.ENABLE_DHCP, i.FIRST_IP, i.LAST_IP, i.max_standard_attr_id_next2, i.standard_attr_dense_rank_window, sa.RESOURCE_TYPE AS standard_attr_resource_type, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBNETS s ON s.NAME = i.subnet_name AND s.TENANT_ID = i.TENANT_ID AND s.NETWORK_ID = i.NETWORK_ID JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID > ( SELECT AVG(s2.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) FROM SUBNETS s2 WHERE s2.IP_VERSION = 4 );

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH SecurityGroupAndDnsByPort AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN PORTDNSES pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name ), IpAllocationsByPort AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ) SELECT sgd.port_id, sgd.tenant_id, sgd.port_name, ipa.mac_address, sgd.security_group_binding_count, sgd.dns_record_count, ipa.ip_allocation_count, ipa.subnet_id_rows FROM SecurityGroupAndDnsByPort sgd JOIN IpAllocationsByPort ipa ON sgd.port_id = ipa.port_id AND sgd.tenant_id = ipa.tenant_id ORDER BY sgd.security_group_binding_count DESC, ipa.ip_allocation_count DESC, sgd.port_id ), PortStatusDnsRollup AS ( SELECT p.status AS port_status, CASE WHEN inner_cte.dns_record_count > 0 THEN 'Has DNS' ELSE 'No DNS' END AS dns_presence, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.port_id) AS total_ports FROM inner_cte JOIN ports p ON p.id = inner_cte.port_id AND p.tenant_id = inner_cte.tenant_id GROUP BY p.status, dns_presence ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(port_status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE port_status END AS port_status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(dns_presence) = 1 AND GROUPING(port_status) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE dns_presence END AS dns_presence, SUM(total_ports) AS total_ports FROM PortStatusDnsRollup GROUP BY port_status, dns_presence WITH ROLLUP;

question: Using the per-network-status security statistics and ACTIVE-network counts (excluding shared networks where RBAC action = 'access_as_shared' and target tenant is '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), list each network status along with: the ACTIVE network count, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED (only for networks with at least one security binding), and the deviation of that ACTIVE network count from the average ACTIVE network count across all returned statuses. sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH NetworkStatusSecurityStats AS ( SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, VARIANCE(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_variance, STDDEV(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_stddev FROM NETWORKS AS n JOIN NETWORKSECURITYBINDINGS AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.STATUS ORDER BY port_security_enabled_variance DESC ), ActiveNetworkRbacDetails AS ( SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM networksecuritybindings b JOIN networks n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN networkrbacs r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ), ActiveNetworkCountsByStatus AS ( SELECT status AS network_status, COUNT(DISTINCT name) AS active_network_count FROM ActiveNetworkRbacDetails GROUP BY status ) SELECT nsss.network_status, anc.active_network_count, nsss.port_security_enabled_variance, nsss.port_security_enabled_stddev FROM NetworkStatusSecurityStats nsss JOIN ActiveNetworkCountsByStatus anc ON nsss.network_status = anc.network_status ORDER BY anc.active_network_count DESC, nsss.port_security_enabled_variance DESC ), avg_active AS ( SELECT AVG(active_network_count) AS avg_active_network_count FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.network_status, i.active_network_count, i.port_security_enabled_variance, i.port_security_enabled_stddev, (i.active_network_count - a.avg_active_network_count) AS deviation_from_avg_active_network_count FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_active a ORDER BY i.active_network_count DESC, i.port_security_enabled_variance DESC;

question: For DOWN ports in network ID `0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d`, return each port’s name, network ID, MAC address, admin state, status, device owner, bound security group ID, and the minimum admin_state_up over a window of 3 preceding and 1 following rows (ordered by port ID). Also include (for the same port status and device owner) the total number of non-shared ports whose standard attribute resource type is `ports` plus the earliest standard-attribute updated timestamp, but only keep rows where that port_count is greater than the average port_count across all (status, device_owner) groups. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH sq1 AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), sq2 AS ( SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') ) SELECT sq2.NETWORK_ID, sq2.NAME AS port_name, sq2.MAC_ADDRESS, sq2.ADMIN_STATE_UP, sq2.STATUS AS port_status, sq2.DEVICE_OWNER, sq2.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, sq2.window_column AS min_admin_state_up_window, sq1.port_count, sq1.earliest_standard_attr_update FROM sq2 JOIN sq1 ON sq1.port_status = sq2.STATUS AND sq1.device_owner = sq2.DEVICE_OWNER ORDER BY sq1.port_count DESC, sq2.NAME ) , AvgCounts AS ( SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count FROM ( SELECT port_status, device_owner, MAX(port_count) AS port_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY port_status, device_owner ) grouped_counts ) SELECT inner_cte.NETWORK_ID, inner_cte.port_name, inner_cte.MAC_ADDRESS, inner_cte.ADMIN_STATE_UP, inner_cte.port_status, inner_cte.DEVICE_OWNER, inner_cte.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, inner_cte.min_admin_state_up_window, inner_cte.port_count, inner_cte.earliest_standard_attr_update FROM inner_cte JOIN AvgCounts ON 1 = 1 WHERE inner_cte.port_count > (SELECT avg_port_count FROM AvgCounts) ORDER BY inner_cte.port_count DESC, inner_cte.port_name;

question: For each RBAC action that appears in both (a) RBAC entries with action = 'access_as_shared' referencing IPv4 subnets and (b) RBAC-referenced networks that have DHCP-enabled subnets and are not shared to target tenant '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b' (with more than 5 matching subnets), list the action along with the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP version from the shared/IPv4 set, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP version from the DHCP-enabled, not-shared set, and the percentage of DHCP-enabled subnets among all subnets for networks that have that action. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH rbac_ip_version_stats_shared AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ), rbac_ip_version_stddev_dhcp_not_shared AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 AND s.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.ACTION HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY ip_version_stddev DESC ) SELECT s1.ACTION, s1.avg_ip_version, s1.ip_version_variance, s1.ip_version_stddev AS shared_ip_version_stddev, s2.ip_version_stddev AS dhcp_not_shared_ip_version_stddev FROM rbac_ip_version_stats_shared s1 JOIN rbac_ip_version_stddev_dhcp_not_shared s2 ON s1.ACTION = s2.ACTION) SELECT i.ACTION, i.avg_ip_version, i.ip_version_variance, i.shared_ip_version_stddev, i.dhcp_not_shared_ip_version_stddev, (SUM(CASE WHEN s_all.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) AS dhcp_enabled_subnet_pct FROM inner_cte i JOIN NETWORKRBACS n_all ON n_all.ACTION = i.ACTION JOIN SUBNETS s_all ON s_all.NETWORK_ID = n_all.OBJECT_ID GROUP BY i.ACTION, i.avg_ip_version, i.ip_version_variance, i.shared_ip_version_stddev, i.dhcp_not_shared_ip_version_stddev;

question: For each network that contains an IPv4 subnet whose subnet ID is in ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48'), show the network ID and the maximum dense-rank-to-max-standard-attribute ratio among those subnets in that network (where the ratio is computed as the dense rank of the subnet’s standard attribute ID ordered by the standard attribute updated-at timestamp using a window of the current row and 2 preceding rows, divided by the maximum subnet standard attribute ID considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by subnet ID).
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH SubnetPools AS (SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')), SubnetAttrDenseRank AS (SELECT s.NAME, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY sa.UPDATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES AS sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')) SELECT sp.NAME AS subnet_name, sp.TENANT_ID, sp.NETWORK_ID, sp.IP_VERSION, sp.CIDR, sp.GATEWAY_IP, sp.ENABLE_DHCP, sp.FIRST_IP AS allocation_pool_first_ip, sp.LAST_IP AS allocation_pool_last_ip, sp.max_standard_attr_id_next2, sadr.window_column AS standard_attr_dense_rank_window, ROUND(sadr.window_column / NULLIF(sp.max_standard_attr_id_next2, 0), 4) AS dense_rank_to_max_attr_ratio FROM SubnetPools sp JOIN SubnetAttrDenseRank sadr ON sp.NAME = sadr.NAME ORDER BY dense_rank_to_max_attr_ratio DESC) SELECT network_id, MAX(dense_rank_to_max_attr_ratio) AS max_dense_rank_to_max_attr_ratio FROM inner_cte GROUP BY network_id;

WITH SubnetPools AS (SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')), SubnetAttrDenseRank AS (SELECT s.NAME, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY sa.UPDATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES AS sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')) SELECT sp.NAME AS subnet_name, sp.TENANT_ID, sp.NETWORK_ID, sp.IP_VERSION, sp.CIDR, sp.GATEWAY_IP, sp.ENABLE_DHCP, sp.FIRST_IP AS allocation_pool_first_ip, sp.LAST_IP AS allocation_pool_last_ip, sp.max_standard_attr_id_next2, sadr.window_column AS standard_attr_dense_rank_window, ROUND(sadr.window_column / NULLIF(sp.max_standard_attr_id_next2, 0), 4) AS dense_rank_to_max_attr_ratio FROM SubnetPools sp JOIN SubnetAttrDenseRank sadr ON sp.NAME = sadr.NAME ORDER BY dense_rank_to_max_attr_ratio DESC;

atn.tenant_id, atn.network_id, atn.network_name, atn.admin_state_up, atn.mtu, atn.standard_attr_updated_at, atn.window_column AS network_row_number_within_tenant, COUNT(DISTINCT autp.PORT_ID) AS question: Using the port-status statistics query as an inner CTE, produce a rollup report by port status and VIF type for administratively up ports (tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') whose status is among those returned by the inner query. sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH PortStatusBindingStats AS ( SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC ), AdminUpPortWindowDetails AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), PortStatusCounts AS ( SELECT p.status, COUNT(*) AS port_count FROM PORTS p JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.status ) SELECT psbs.status, psc.port_count, psbs.binding_count_range, psbs.binding_count_variance, psbs.binding_count_stddev FROM PortStatusBindingStats psbs JOIN PortStatusCounts psc ON psbs.status = psc.status WHERE psbs.status IN (SELECT STATUS FROM AdminUpPortWindowDetails)) , StatusVifCounts AS ( SELECT p.status, b.vif_type, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_ports FROM PORTS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON p.id = b.port_id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') AND p.status IN (SELECT status FROM inner_cte) GROUP BY p.status, b.vif_type ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE status END AS status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(vif_type) = 1 AND GROUPING(status) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE vif_type END AS vif_type, SUM(total_ports) AS total_ports FROM StatusVifCounts GROUP BY status, vif_type WITH ROLLUP;

question: For each port status and device owner, considering only ports whose standard attribute resource type is 'ports' and excluding shared networks (networks whose IDs appear in networkrbacs with action = 'access_as_shared' and target_tenant = '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), show the number of ports and the earliest standard attribute updated timestamp, and also include (by port status) the variance of the standard attribute ID across ports that have an IP allocation with IP address 10.150.64.113/8; then return only those (port status, device owner) groups whose port_count is greater than the average port_count for the same port_status. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH sq1 AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), sq2 AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, VARIANCE(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM PORTS AS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NOT NULL AND ia.IP_ADDRESS IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.STATUS ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC ) SELECT sq1.port_status, sq1.device_owner, sq1.port_count, sq1.earliest_standard_attr_update, sq2.standard_attr_id_variance FROM sq1 JOIN sq2 ON sq1.port_status = sq2.STATUS ORDER BY sq1.port_count DESC, sq2.standard_attr_id_variance DESC ), StatusAverages AS ( SELECT port_status, AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY port_status ) SELECT i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.earliest_standard_attr_update, i.standard_attr_id_variance FROM inner_cte i JOIN StatusAverages sa ON sa.port_status = i.port_status WHERE i.port_count > sa.avg_port_count ORDER BY i.port_status, i.port_count DESC, i.standard_attr_id_variance DESC;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DownPortsWithWindow AS ( SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') ), SecurityGroupGeomMean AS ( SELECT s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, EXP(AVG(LN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID))) AS geometric_mean_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID > 0 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY geometric_mean_standard_attr_id DESC ) SELECT dpw.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, COUNT(*) AS down_port_count_in_network, AVG(dpw.window_column) AS avg_window_min_admin_state_up, MAX(sgg.geometric_mean_standard_attr_id) AS geometric_mean_standard_attr_id_for_tenant FROM DownPortsWithWindow dpw LEFT JOIN SecurityGroupGeomMean sgg ON dpw.SECURITY_GROUP_ID = sgg.SECURITY_GROUP_ID GROUP BY dpw.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY down_port_count_in_network DESC ), tenant_down_presence AS ( SELECT s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS tenant_down_ports FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ) SELECT i.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, i.down_port_count_in_network, i.avg_window_min_admin_state_up, i.geometric_mean_standard_attr_id_for_tenant, CASE WHEN COALESCE(tdp.tenant_down_ports, 0) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_any_down_ports_in_tenant FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN tenant_down_presence tdp ON i.SECURITY_GROUP_ID = tdp.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY i.down_port_count_in_network DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For tenant ID `17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7`, return the same administratively up port-security summary (tenant ID, admin-up port count, total port-security binding count, total enabled count, enabled-to-binding ratio rounded, and the average down-port standard-attribute running-sum window value), and also include the tenant’s total port count and the overall average port count across all tenants.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH PortSecurityStats AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(psb.port_id) AS binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN psb.port_security_enabled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS port_security_enabled_total FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address), DownPortWindow AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(sa.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY sa.RESOURCE_TYPE ORDER BY sa.ID) AS window_column FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')) SELECT pss.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT pss.port_id) AS admin_up_port_count, SUM(pss.binding_count) AS total_binding_count, SUM(pss.port_security_enabled_total) AS total_port_security_enabled_across_bindings, ROUND( SUM(pss.port_security_enabled_total) / NULLIF(SUM(pss.binding_count), 0), 2 ) AS port_security_enabled_ratio, AVG(dpw.window_column) AS avg_down_port_window_sum FROM PortSecurityStats pss LEFT JOIN DownPortWindow dpw ON dpw.port_id = pss.port_id AND dpw.tenant_id = pss.tenant_id GROUP BY pss.tenant_id ORDER BY port_security_enabled_ratio DESC ) SELECT i.tenant_id, i.admin_up_port_count, i.total_binding_count, i.total_port_security_enabled_across_bindings, i.port_security_enabled_ratio, i.avg_down_port_window_sum, COUNT(p_all.id) AS total_ports_for_tenant, avg_ports.avg_port_count AS avg_ports_across_all_tenants FROM inner_cte i JOIN ports p_all ON p_all.tenant_id = i.tenant_id JOIN ( SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count FROM ( SELECT COUNT(id) AS port_count FROM ports GROUP BY tenant_id ) AS sub ) AS avg_ports GROUP BY i.tenant_id, i.admin_up_port_count, i.total_binding_count, i.total_port_security_enabled_across_bindings, i.port_security_enabled_ratio, i.avg_down_port_window_sum, avg_ports.avg_port_count;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH PortIpAllocStats AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ), PortBindingWindowStats AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT pbws.PORT_ID AS port_id, pbws.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, pbws.NETWORK_ID AS network_id, pbws.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, pbws.HOST AS host, pbws.VIF_TYPE AS vif_type, pbws.VNIC_TYPE AS vnic_type, pbws.STATUS AS status, pbws.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, pbws.window_column AS avg_standard_attr_id_window, pias.ip_allocation_count AS ip_allocation_count, pias.subnet_id_rows AS subnet_id_rows FROM PortBindingWindowStats pbws JOIN PortIpAllocStats pias ON pias.port_id = pbws.PORT_ID ORDER BY pbws.VIF_TYPE, pbws.PORT_ID ), VifTypeAverages AS ( SELECT vif_type, AVG(ip_allocation_count) AS avg_ip_allocations FROM inner_cte GROUP BY vif_type ) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.network_id, i.mac_address, i.host, i.vif_type, i.vnic_type, i.status, i.device_owner, i.avg_standard_attr_id_window, i.ip_allocation_count, i.subnet_id_rows FROM inner_cte i JOIN VifTypeAverages vta ON vta.vif_type = i.vif_type WHERE i.ip_allocation_count > vta.avg_ip_allocations ORDER BY i.vif_type, i.port_id;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH TenantDownPorts AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), NetworkDownPorts AS (SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d')), CombinedDownPorts AS ( SELECT t.port_id AS port_identifier, t.tenant_id AS scope_id, t.mac_address, t.window_column AS window_metric, 'Tenant Filter' AS reason FROM TenantDownPorts t UNION ALL SELECT n.NAME AS port_identifier, n.NETWORK_ID AS scope_id, n.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, n.window_column AS window_metric, 'Network Filter' AS reason FROM NetworkDownPorts n ) SELECT * FROM CombinedDownPorts ORDER BY reason, scope_id, port_identifier ), ReasonCounts AS ( SELECT reason, COUNT(*) AS total_ports FROM inner_cte GROUP BY reason ) SELECT reason, total_ports FROM ReasonCounts WHERE total_ports > (SELECT AVG(total_ports) FROM ReasonCounts) ORDER BY total_ports DESC, reason;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH PortStatusOwnerStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), PortStatusBindingStats AS ( SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC ), CombinedPortStatusStats AS ( SELECT pso.port_status, pso.device_owner, pso.port_count, pso.earliest_standard_attr_update, pbs.binding_count_range, pbs.binding_count_variance, pbs.binding_count_stddev FROM PortStatusOwnerStats pso JOIN PortStatusBindingStats pbs ON pso.port_status = pbs.status ) SELECT port_status, device_owner, port_count, earliest_standard_attr_update, binding_count_range, binding_count_variance, binding_count_stddev FROM CombinedPortStatusStats ORDER BY port_status, device_owner ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(port_status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE port_status END AS port_status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(device_owner) = 1 AND GROUPING(port_status) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(device_owner) = 1 AND GROUPING(port_status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE device_owner END AS device_owner, SUM(port_count) AS port_count, MIN(earliest_standard_attr_update) AS earliest_standard_attr_update, MAX(binding_count_range) AS binding_count_range, AVG(binding_count_variance) AS binding_count_variance, AVG(binding_count_stddev) AS binding_count_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY port_status, device_owner WITH ROLLUP;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH SubnetPoolAndAttrStats AS ( SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') ), SubnetRouteCountDispersion AS ( SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(route_count) - MIN(route_count) AS route_count_range, VARIANCE(route_count) AS route_count_variance, STDDEV(route_count) AS route_count_stddev FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN ( SELECT sr.SUBNET_ID, COUNT(*) AS route_count FROM SUBNETROUTES AS sr GROUP BY sr.SUBNET_ID, sr.NEXTHOP ) AS route_stats ON s.ID = route_stats.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY route_count_range DESC ) SELECT spa.NAME AS subnet_name, spa.TENANT_ID, spa.NETWORK_ID, spa.IP_VERSION, spa.CIDR, spa.GATEWAY_IP, spa.ENABLE_DHCP, spa.FIRST_IP AS allocation_pool_first_ip, spa.LAST_IP AS allocation_pool_last_ip, spa.max_standard_attr_id_next2, srcd.route_count_range, srcd.route_count_variance, srcd.route_count_stddev FROM SubnetPoolAndAttrStats spa JOIN SubnetRouteCountDispersion srcd ON spa.NAME = srcd.subnet_name ORDER BY spa.NAME) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.IP_VERSION, i.CIDR, i.GATEWAY_IP, i.ENABLE_DHCP, i.allocation_pool_first_ip, i.allocation_pool_last_ip, i.max_standard_attr_id_next2, i.route_count_range, i.route_count_variance, i.route_count_stddev, avg_stats.avg_route_count_range FROM inner_cte i JOIN (SELECT AVG(route_count_range) AS avg_route_count_range FROM (SELECT route_count_range FROM inner_cte) AS sub) AS avg_stats ON 1 = 1;

question: Among the top 10 (port status, device owner) combinations by port count—considering only ports whose standard attribute resource type is 'ports' and excluding shared networks (networks whose IDs appear in networkrbacs with action = 'access_as_shared' and target_tenant = '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')—show the number of ports and the earliest standard attribute updated timestamp, and also indicate whether that port status has any ports with an IP allocation of 10.150.64.113/8 (and if so, include the variance of the standard attribute ID for that status). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH sq1 AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), sq2 AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, VARIANCE(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM PORTS AS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NOT NULL AND ia.IP_ADDRESS IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.STATUS ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC ) SELECT sq1.port_status, sq1.device_owner, sq1.port_count, sq1.earliest_standard_attr_update, sq2.standard_attr_id_variance FROM sq1 JOIN sq2 ON sq1.port_status = sq2.STATUS ORDER BY sq1.port_count DESC, sq2.standard_attr_id_variance DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.port_status, inner_cte.device_owner, inner_cte.port_count, inner_cte.earliest_standard_attr_update, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT ia2.PORT_ID) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_ip_10_150_64_113, inner_cte.standard_attr_id_variance FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN PORTS p2 ON p2.STATUS = inner_cte.port_status LEFT JOIN IPALLOCATIONS ia2 ON ia2.PORT_ID = p2.ID AND ia2.IP_ADDRESS = '10.150.64.113/8' GROUP BY inner_cte.port_status, inner_cte.device_owner, inner_cte.port_count, inner_cte.earliest_standard_attr_update, inner_cte.standard_attr_id_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.port_count DESC, inner_cte.standard_attr_id_variance DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each port that is administratively up and belongs to tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57', list the port ID, tenant ID, port name, host, VIF type, VNIC type, network ID, MAC address, status, device owner, the windowed average standard attribute ID (2 preceding to 2 following rows partitioned by VIF type), along with the number of security group bindings for the port and the total number of DNS records associated with the port, but only include ports whose security group binding count is greater than the average security group binding count across all such ports. sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH PortSecurityAndDNSStats AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN PORTDNSES pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name ), PortBindingWindowStats AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT pbws.PORT_ID AS port_id, pbws.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, psds.port_name, pbws.HOST, pbws.VIF_TYPE, pbws.VNIC_TYPE, pbws.NETWORK_ID, pbws.MAC_ADDRESS, pbws.STATUS, pbws.DEVICE_OWNER, pbws.window_column, psds.security_group_binding_count, psds.dns_record_count FROM PortBindingWindowStats pbws JOIN PortSecurityAndDNSStats psds ON pbws.PORT_ID = psds.port_id ORDER BY pbws.PORT_ID) SELECT port_id, tenant_id, port_name, host, vif_type, vnic_type, network_id, mac_address, status, device_owner, window_column, security_group_binding_count, dns_record_count FROM inner_cte WHERE security_group_binding_count > (SELECT AVG(security_group_binding_count) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY port_id;

question: For non-shared networks only, list each default external network (network ID, default flag, tenant ID, name, status, admin state up, MTU, standard attribute ID, and the tenant-level minimum MTU) and also show, for that network’s status, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED across networks that have at least one security binding, plus the deviation of that status-level variance from the overall average variance across all statuses. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH network_status_security_stats AS ( SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, VARIANCE(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_variance, STDDEV(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_stddev FROM NETWORKS AS n JOIN NETWORKSECURITYBINDINGS AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.STATUS ORDER BY port_security_enabled_variance DESC ), default_external_network_details AS ( SELECT e.NETWORK_ID, e.IS_DEFAULT, n.TENANT_ID, n.NAME, n.STATUS, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP, n.MTU, n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID, MIN(n.MTU) OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.TENANT_ID) AS window_column FROM EXTERNALNETWORKS e JOIN NETWORKS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND n.ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ) SELECT den.NETWORK_ID, den.IS_DEFAULT, den.TENANT_ID, den.NAME, den.STATUS, den.ADMIN_STATE_UP, den.MTU, den.STANDARD_ATTR_ID, den.window_column, nsss.port_security_enabled_variance, nsss.port_security_enabled_stddev FROM default_external_network_details den JOIN network_status_security_stats nsss ON den.STATUS = nsss.network_status) , avg_variance_cte AS (SELECT AVG(port_security_enabled_variance) AS avg_port_security_enabled_variance FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.NETWORK_ID, i.IS_DEFAULT, i.TENANT_ID, i.NAME, i.STATUS, i.ADMIN_STATE_UP, i.MTU, i.STANDARD_ATTR_ID, i.window_column, i.port_security_enabled_variance, i.port_security_enabled_stddev, (i.port_security_enabled_variance - a.avg_port_security_enabled_variance) AS deviation_from_avg_variance FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_variance_cte a;
