sql: WITH AdminUpBoundPorts AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN PORTDNSES pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name ), DownPortsWithIPs AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.NAME AS port_name, p.NETWORK_ID AS network_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, ia.IP_ADDRESS AS ip_address, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.NETWORK_ID ORDER BY p.ID) AS window_column FROM PORTS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' ) SELECT d.network_id, d.window_column AS down_port_row_number_in_network, d.port_id, d.tenant_id, d.port_name, d.mac_address, d.device_owner, d.ip_address, a.security_group_binding_count, a.dns_record_count FROM DownPortsWithIPs d JOIN AdminUpBoundPorts a ON d.port_id = a.port_id ORDER BY d.network_id, d.window_column, d.port_id;
sub_questions: For each port that is bound to a security group and has admin_state_up = 1, list the port ID, tenant ID, port name, and the number of security group bindings for that port along with the total number of DNS records associated with the port.
For ports that are DOWN, list the port ID, tenant ID, port name, network ID, MAC address, device owner, and the allocated IP address, and assign row numbers within each network ordered by port ID.
sub_sqls: SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN PORTDNSES pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name;

SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.NAME AS port_name, p.NETWORK_ID AS network_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, ia.IP_ADDRESS AS ip_address, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.NETWORK_ID ORDER BY p.ID) AS window_column FROM PORTS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN';

question: For active networks whose tenant has port-security enabled on over 75% of its port-security bindings (considering only administratively up ports), provide the network ID, network name, tenant ID, admin_state_up flag, MTU, the network standard attribute updated_at timestamp, and the tenant’s total binding count and total port-security-enabled count. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH ActiveNetworks AS ( SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ), AdminUpPortSecurity AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(psb.port_id) AS binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN psb.port_security_enabled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS port_security_enabled_total FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ), TenantPortSecurityTotals AS ( SELECT aups.tenant_id, SUM(aups.binding_count) AS total_binding_count, SUM(aups.port_security_enabled_total) AS total_port_security_enabled FROM AdminUpPortSecurity aups GROUP BY aups.tenant_id ) SELECT an.network_id, an.network_name, an.tenant_id, an.admin_state_up, an.mtu, an.standard_attr_updated_at, tpt.total_binding_count, tpt.total_port_security_enabled FROM ActiveNetworks an JOIN TenantPortSecurityTotals tpt ON an.tenant_id = tpt.tenant_id WHERE (tpt.total_port_security_enabled * 1.0 / NULLIF(tpt.total_binding_count, 0)) > 0.75;
sub_questions: For active networks, show the network ID, network name, tenant ID, admin_state_up flag, MTU, and the standard attribute updated_at timestamp, and assign row numbers within each tenant ordered by network name.

For each port that is administratively up, list the port ID, tenant ID, MAC address, the number of port security bindings on that port, and the total number of times port security is enabled across those bindings.
sub_sqls: SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE';

SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(psb.port_id) AS binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN psb.port_security_enabled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS port_security_enabled_total FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address;

question: For each IPv4 subnet (by subnet name) that belongs to a network with an RBAC action of 'access_as_shared' and has a maximum IP version greater than 3 for that subnet name/gateway IP group, return the subnet name, gateway IP, average DNS nameserver order, variance of DNS nameserver order, and the maximum IP version. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH SubnetDNSStats AS ( SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, AVG(d.ORDER) AS avg_dns_order, VARIANCE(d.ORDER) AS dns_order_variance FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN DNSNAMESERVERS AS d ON s.ID = d.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY dns_order_variance DESC ), SharedNetworkSubnetMaxIP AS ( SELECT s.name, MAX(s.ip_version) AS max_ip_version, s.gateway_ip FROM NETWORKRBACS n JOIN SUBNETS s ON n.object_id = s.network_id WHERE n.action = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY s.name, s.gateway_ip HAVING MAX(s.ip_version) > 3 ) SELECT sds.subnet_name, snsm.gateway_ip, sds.avg_dns_order, sds.dns_order_variance, snsm.max_ip_version FROM SubnetDNSStats sds JOIN SharedNetworkSubnetMaxIP snsm ON sds.subnet_name = snsm.name ORDER BY sds.dns_order_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For each subnet (by subnet name), calculate the average and variance of the DNS nameserver order values for DNS entries associated with that subnet, considering only IPv4 subnets.

For each subnet name and its gateway IP, find the maximum IP version among subnets whose network has a RBAC action of 'access_as_shared', and only keep subnet name/gateway IP groups where that maximum IP version is greater than 3.
sub_sqls: SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, AVG(d.ORDER) AS avg_dns_order, VARIANCE(d.ORDER) AS dns_order_variance FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN DNSNAMESERVERS AS d ON s.ID = d.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY dns_order_variance DESC;

SELECT s.name, MAX(s.ip_version) AS max_ip_version, s.gateway_ip FROM NETWORKRBACS n JOIN SUBNETS s ON n.object_id = s.network_id WHERE n.action = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY s.name, s.gateway_ip HAVING MAX(s.ip_version) > 3;

question: List (1) ports on host "drive-59" with their port ID, tenant ID, MAC address, and the running sum of standard attribute IDs within each VIF type (ordered by standard attribute ID), and also (2) all administratively-up ports with their port name, MAC address, port security status, and a row number ordered by MAC address using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row, combined into a single result set ordered by MAC address. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH HostDrive59Ports AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, p.TENANT_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE b.HOST = 'drive-59'), AdminUpPorts AS (SELECT p.NAME AS port_name, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, psb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED AS port_security_enabled, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY p.MAC_ADDRESS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1), CombinedPortWindows AS ( SELECT h.PORT_ID AS port_identifier, h.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, h.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, h.window_column AS host_viftype_running_sum_standard_attr_id, NULL AS admin_up_port_name, NULL AS port_security_enabled, NULL AS admin_up_row_number_window FROM HostDrive59Ports h UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS port_identifier, NULL AS tenant_id, a.mac_address AS mac_address, NULL AS host_viftype_running_sum_standard_attr_id, a.port_name AS admin_up_port_name, a.port_security_enabled AS port_security_enabled, a.window_column AS admin_up_row_number_window FROM AdminUpPorts a ) SELECT * FROM CombinedPortWindows ORDER BY mac_address;
sub_questions: For ports on host "drive-59", show the port ID, tenant ID, MAC address, and a running sum of the port standard attribute IDs within each VIF type group ordered by standard attribute ID.

For ports that are administratively up, list the port name, MAC address, and port security status, and assign row numbers ordered by MAC address using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row.
sub_sqls: SELECT b.PORT_ID, p.TENANT_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE b.HOST = 'drive-59';

SELECT p.NAME AS port_name, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, psb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED AS port_security_enabled, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY p.MAC_ADDRESS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1;

question: For ports that are DOWN but also administratively up and have at least one IP allocation, return the port ID, tenant ID, MAC address, the running sum of the port’s standard attribute ID within each security group (ordered by standard attribute ID), plus the port’s IP allocation count and the number of rows with a non-null subnet ID among those allocations. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH AdminUpWithIPAllocations AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ), DownPortsRunningStdAttrSumBySecurityGroup AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' ) SELECT d.port_id, d.tenant_id, d.mac_address, d.window_column, a.ip_allocation_count, a.subnet_id_rows FROM DownPortsRunningStdAttrSumBySecurityGroup d JOIN AdminUpWithIPAllocations a ON a.port_id = d.port_id ORDER BY d.tenant_id, d.port_id;
sub_questions: For each port that is administratively up and has at least one IP allocation, list the port ID, tenant ID, MAC address, the number of IP allocations on that port, and the total number of distinct subnets those IP allocations belong to.
For ports that are DOWN, show the port ID, tenant ID, and MAC address, along with the running sum of the port’s standard attribute ID within each security group, ordered by standard attribute ID.
sub_sqls: SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address;

SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN';

question: For ports that are DOWN and are bound to host "drive-59", display each port’s ID, tenant ID, and MAC address, along with (1) the running sum of standard attribute IDs within each resource type group ordered by standard attribute ID and (2) the running sum of port standard attribute IDs within each VIF type group ordered by standard attribute ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(sa.ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY sa.RESOURCE_TYPE ORDER BY sa.ID ) AS window_column FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' ), subq2 AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, p.TENANT_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE b.HOST = 'drive-59' ) SELECT s2.PORT_ID AS port_id, s2.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, s2.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, s1.window_column AS down_ports_running_sum_by_resource_type, s2.window_column AS drive_59_ports_running_sum_by_vif_type FROM subq2 s2 JOIN subq1 s1 ON s1.port_id = s2.PORT_ID AND s1.tenant_id = s2.TENANT_ID AND s1.mac_address = s2.MAC_ADDRESS ORDER BY s2.PORT_ID;
sub_questions: For ports whose status is DOWN, show the port ID, tenant ID, and MAC address, along with the running sum of the standard attribute IDs within each resource type group ordered by standard attribute ID.
For ports on host "drive-59", show the port ID, tenant ID, MAC address, and a running sum of the port standard attribute IDs within each VIF type group ordered by standard attribute ID.
sub_sqls: SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(sa.ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY sa.RESOURCE_TYPE ORDER BY sa.ID ) AS window_column FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN';

SELECT b.PORT_ID, p.TENANT_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE b.HOST = 'drive-59';

question: For RBAC target tenants whose shared subnets (networks with action = 'access_as_shared') have CIDRs starting with '10.' and include at least 2 distinct shared subnets, return the target tenant, the number of shared subnets, the average running-sum of subnet standard attribute IDs (within IP version), and whether any of those subnets have IPv4 routes and allocation pools. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH SharedRbacSubnets AS (SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, n.TARGET_TENANT AS rbac_target_tenant, SUM(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.IP_VERSION ORDER BY s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN NETWORKRBACS AS n ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared'), Ipv4SubnetRoutesAndPools AS (SELECT r.DESTINATION, r.NEXTHOP, s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.SUBNET_ID ORDER BY r.SUBNET_ID) AS window_column FROM SUBNETROUTES r JOIN SUBNETS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4) SELECT srs.rbac_target_tenant, COUNT(DISTINCT srs.subnet_name) AS shared_subnet_count, AVG(srs.window_column) AS avg_running_sum_standard_attr_id, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT isp.subnet_name) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS Has_IPv4_Routes_And_Pools FROM SharedRbacSubnets srs LEFT JOIN Ipv4SubnetRoutesAndPools isp ON srs.subnet_name = isp.subnet_name AND srs.subnet_cidr = isp.subnet_cidr WHERE srs.subnet_cidr LIKE '10.%' GROUP BY srs.rbac_target_tenant HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT srs.subnet_name) >= 2 ORDER BY shared_subnet_count DESC, avg_running_sum_standard_attr_id DESC;
sub_questions: For subnets whose network has a RBAC action of 'access_as_shared', list the subnet name, its CIDR, the RBAC target tenant, and the running sum of subnet standard attribute IDs within each IP version group ordered by standard attribute ID.

Show each subnet route’s destination and next hop together with the subnet name and CIDR, plus the allocation pool’s first and last IP. Also include a dense rank within each subnet (partitioned by subnet ID) ordered by the subnet ID. Only include IPv4 subnets.
sub_sqls: SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, n.TARGET_TENANT AS rbac_target_tenant, SUM(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.IP_VERSION ORDER BY s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN NETWORKRBACS AS n ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared';

SELECT r.DESTINATION, r.NEXTHOP, s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.SUBNET_ID ORDER BY r.SUBNET_ID) AS window_column FROM SUBNETROUTES r JOIN SUBNETS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4

question: For each load balancer operating status that (1) has more than 1 load balancer associated with the “haproxy” provider and (2) has over 1,000,000 total incoming bytes among load balancers in ACTIVE provisioning status, return the operating status, the total number of haproxy-associated load balancers, and the total incoming bytes. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH HapLoadBalancersByOpStatus AS ( SELECT lb.OPERATING_STATUS, COUNT(*) AS total_loadbalancers FROM LBAAS_LOADBALANCERS AS lb JOIN PROVIDERRESOURCEASSOCIATIONS AS pra ON lb.ID = pra.RESOURCE_ID WHERE pra.PROVIDER_NAME = 'haproxy' GROUP BY lb.OPERATING_STATUS HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ), ActiveBytesInByOpStatus AS ( SELECT lb.OPERATING_STATUS, SUM(s.BYTES_IN) AS total_bytes_in FROM LBAAS_LOADBALANCERS AS lb JOIN LBAAS_LOADBALANCER_STATISTICS AS s ON lb.ID = s.LOADBALANCER_ID WHERE lb.PROVISIONING_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY lb.OPERATING_STATUS HAVING SUM(s.BYTES_IN) > 1000000 ) SELECT h.OPERATING_STATUS, h.total_loadbalancers, a.total_bytes_in FROM HapLoadBalancersByOpStatus h JOIN ActiveBytesInByOpStatus a ON h.OPERATING_STATUS = a.OPERATING_STATUS;
sub_questions: For each load balancer operating status, show the operating status and the total number of load balancers that are associated with the “haproxy” provider, only including statuses where the total count of such load balancers is greater than 1.

For each load balancer operating status, show the operating status and the total number of incoming bytes across load balancers that are in ACTIVE provisioning status, keeping only operating statuses where the total incoming bytes exceed 1,000,000.
sub_sqls: SELECT lb.OPERATING_STATUS, COUNT(*) AS total_loadbalancers FROM LBAAS_LOADBALANCERS AS lb JOIN PROVIDERRESOURCEASSOCIATIONS AS pra ON lb.ID = pra.RESOURCE_ID WHERE pra.PROVIDER_NAME = 'haproxy' GROUP BY lb.OPERATING_STATUS HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

SELECT lb.OPERATING_STATUS, SUM(s.BYTES_IN) AS total_bytes_in FROM LBAAS_LOADBALANCERS AS lb JOIN LBAAS_LOADBALANCER_STATISTICS AS s ON lb.ID = s.LOADBALANCER_ID WHERE lb.PROVISIONING_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY lb.OPERATING_STATUS HAVING SUM(s.BYTES_IN) > 1000000;

question: For each IPv4 subnet name, list the DNS nameserver order range (max minus min), the order variance, the average DNS nameserver order, and the variance again from the average-based aggregation, and compute a normalized range metric (order range divided by average order) rounded to 2 decimals.
sql: WITH SubnetOrderRangeVar AS ( SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, MAX(d.ORDER) - MIN(d.ORDER) AS order_range, VARIANCE(d.ORDER) AS order_variance FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN DNSNAMESERVERS AS d ON s.id = d.subnet_id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY order_range DESC ), SubnetOrderAvgVar AS ( SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, AVG(d.ORDER) AS avg_dns_order, VARIANCE(d.ORDER) AS dns_order_variance FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN DNSNAMESERVERS AS d ON s.ID = d.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY dns_order_variance DESC ) SELECT r.subnet_name, r.order_range, r.order_variance, a.avg_dns_order, a.dns_order_variance, ROUND(r.order_range / NULLIF(a.avg_dns_order, 0), 2) AS normalized_range_by_avg_order FROM SubnetOrderRangeVar r JOIN SubnetOrderAvgVar a ON r.subnet_name = a.subnet_name ORDER BY normalized_range_by_avg_order DESC;
sub_questions: For each subnet name, compute the range and variance of the DNS nameserver order values configured for that subnet, considering only IPv4 subnets.
For each subnet (by subnet name), calculate the average and variance of the DNS nameserver order values for DNS entries associated with that subnet, considering only IPv4 subnets.
sub_sqls: SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, MAX(d.ORDER) - MIN(d.ORDER) AS order_range, VARIANCE(d.ORDER) AS order_variance FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN DNSNAMESERVERS AS d ON s.id = d.subnet_id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY order_range DESC;

SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, AVG(d.ORDER) AS avg_dns_order, VARIANCE(d.ORDER) AS dns_order_variance FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN DNSNAMESERVERS AS d ON s.ID = d.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY dns_order_variance DESC;

question: For ports whose status is DOWN, list a combined report that includes (1) each port’s name, MAC address, admin_state_up, binding host, VIF type, and the VIF-type window average of admin_state_up (2 preceding and 2 following rows ordered by MAC address), and (2) each port’s ID, name, MAC address, binding host, VIF type, and its rank within the DOWN status group ordered by port ID, labeling each row with the metric type. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DownPortsWindowAvg AS ( SELECT p.NAME, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, AVG(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.MAC_ADDRESS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' ORDER BY p.MAC_ADDRESS ), DownPortsRank AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.NAME AS port_name, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, b.HOST AS binding_host, b.VIF_TYPE AS vif_type, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.STATUS ORDER BY p.ID) AS window_column FROM PORTS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' ), CombinedDownPortAnalytics AS ( SELECT NULL AS port_id, d1.NAME AS port_name, d1.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, d1.HOST AS binding_host, d1.VIF_TYPE AS vif_type, d1.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, d1.window_column AS window_metric, 'VIF-type window avg(admin_state_up)' AS metric_type FROM DownPortsWindowAvg d1 UNION ALL SELECT d2.port_id AS port_id, d2.port_name AS port_name, d2.mac_address AS mac_address, d2.binding_host AS binding_host, d2.vif_type AS vif_type, NULL AS admin_state_up, d2.window_column AS window_metric, 'Status-group rank by port_id' AS metric_type FROM DownPortsRank d2 ) SELECT * FROM CombinedDownPortAnalytics ORDER BY vif_type, mac_address, metric_type, port_id;
sub_questions: For ports that are DOWN, show the port name, MAC address, admin_state_up flag, binding host, VIF type, and the average admin_state_up in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows partitioned by VIF type and ordered by MAC address.
For ports whose status is DOWN, show the port ID, port name, MAC address, the binding host, VIF type, and the rank of each port within its status group ordered by port ID.
sub_sqls: SELECT p.NAME, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, AVG(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.MAC_ADDRESS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' ORDER BY p.MAC_ADDRESS;

SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.NAME AS port_name, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, b.HOST AS binding_host, b.VIF_TYPE AS vif_type, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.STATUS ORDER BY p.ID) AS window_column FROM PORTS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN';

question: For ports whose status is DOWN, show the down port name, MAC address, admin_state_up flag, binding host, VIF type, and the average admin_state_up over a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows (partitioned by VIF type and ordered by MAC address), along with the matching administratively up port’s name, MAC address, port security enabled flag, and its row number over a window of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row (ordered by MAC address), matching the two sets by MAC address. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DownPortsWithBindings AS ( SELECT p.NAME, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, AVG(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.MAC_ADDRESS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' ORDER BY p.MAC_ADDRESS ), AdminUpPortsWithSecurity AS ( SELECT p.NAME AS port_name, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, psb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED AS port_security_enabled, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY p.MAC_ADDRESS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 ) SELECT dp.NAME AS down_port_name, dp.MAC_ADDRESS AS down_mac_address, dp.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS down_admin_state_up, dp.HOST AS binding_host, dp.VIF_TYPE AS vif_type, dp.window_column AS avg_admin_state_up_window_2p_2f, au.port_name AS admin_up_port_name, au.mac_address AS admin_up_mac_address, au.port_security_enabled, au.window_column AS row_number_window_2p_1f FROM DownPortsWithBindings dp JOIN AdminUpPortsWithSecurity au ON dp.MAC_ADDRESS = au.mac_address ORDER BY dp.MAC_ADDRESS;
sub_questions: For ports that are DOWN, show the port name, MAC address, admin_state_up flag, binding host, VIF type, and the average admin_state_up in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows partitioned by VIF type and ordered by MAC address.

For ports that are administratively up, list the port name, MAC address, and port security status, and assign row numbers ordered by MAC address using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row.

SELECT p.NAME AS port_name, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, psb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED AS port_security_enabled, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY p.MAC_ADDRESS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1;

question: For each IPv4 subnet that has an allocation pool, list the subnet name, tenant ID, network ID, IP version, CIDR, gateway IP, DHCP enabled flag, allocation pool first/last IPs, and the maximum subnet standard attribute ID over the current subnet row plus the next two subnets (ordered by subnet ID), but only for subnet name and gateway IP pairs whose network is shared via RBAC action 'access_as_shared' and whose maximum IP version is greater than 3. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH SubnetPoolWindow AS (SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4), SharedNetworkSubnetMaxIP AS (SELECT s.name, MAX(s.ip_version) AS max_ip_version, s.gateway_ip FROM NETWORKRBACS n JOIN SUBNETS s ON n.object_id = s.network_id WHERE n.action = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY s.name, s.gateway_ip HAVING MAX(s.ip_version) > 3) SELECT spw.NAME AS subnet_name, spw.TENANT_ID, spw.NETWORK_ID, spw.IP_VERSION, spw.CIDR, spw.GATEWAY_IP, spw.ENABLE_DHCP, spw.FIRST_IP, spw.LAST_IP, spw.max_standard_attr_id_next2, sns.max_ip_version FROM SubnetPoolWindow spw JOIN SharedNetworkSubnetMaxIP sns ON spw.NAME = sns.name AND spw.GATEWAY_IP = sns.gateway_ip ORDER BY spw.NAME, spw.GATEWAY_IP;
sub_questions: For each subnet, show the subnet name, tenant ID, network ID, IP version, CIDR, gateway IP, DHCP enabled flag, the allocation pool’s first IP and last IP, and the maximum subnet standard attribute ID considering the current row and the next 2 rows when ordered by subnet ID.

For each subnet name and its gateway IP, find the maximum IP version among subnets whose network has a RBAC action of 'access_as_shared', and only keep subnet name/gateway IP groups where that maximum IP version is greater than 3.
sub_sqls: SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4;

SELECT s.name, MAX(s.ip_version) AS max_ip_version, s.gateway_ip FROM NETWORKRBACS n JOIN SUBNETS s ON n.object_id = s.network_id WHERE n.action = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY s.name, s.gateway_ip HAVING MAX(s.ip_version) > 3;

question: For ports that are DOWN, return each port’s ID, tenant ID, port name, network ID, MAC address, admin state, status, device owner, bound security group ID, and allocated IP address, along with (1) the row number of the port within its network ordered by port ID and (2) the minimum admin_state_up over a window of 3 preceding and 1 following port (ordered by port ID). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DownPortsWithIPs AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.NAME AS port_name, p.NETWORK_ID AS network_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, ia.IP_ADDRESS AS ip_address, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.NETWORK_ID ORDER BY p.ID) AS window_column FROM PORTS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN'), DownPortsWithSecurityGroupWindow AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN') SELECT dpi.port_id, dpi.tenant_id, dpi.port_name, dpi.network_id, dpi.mac_address, dpsgw.ADMIN_STATE_UP, dpsgw.STATUS, dpi.device_owner, dpsgw.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, dpi.ip_address, dpi.window_column AS network_row_number, dpsgw.window_column AS admin_state_up_min_window FROM DownPortsWithIPs dpi JOIN DownPortsWithSecurityGroupWindow dpsgw ON dpi.port_id = dpsgw.port_id;

question: For ports that are DOWN and are bound to security group ID 0008e629-5619-41e0-b86c-4eecfeaacb6c, show the port ID, tenant ID, MAC address, port status, and allocated IP address, along with (1) the running sum of the port’s standard attribute ID within each security group (ordered by standard attribute ID) and (2) the running sum of the port’s standard attribute ID within each network (ordered by standard attribute ID). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH q1 AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' ), q2 AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.STATUS AS port_status, ia.IP_ADDRESS AS ip_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY p.NETWORK_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID = '0008e629-5619-41e0-b86c-4eecfeaacb6c' ) SELECT q2.port_id, q1.tenant_id, q1.mac_address, q2.port_status, q2.ip_address, q1.window_column AS running_sum_standard_attr_id_within_security_group, q2.window_column AS running_sum_standard_attr_id_within_network FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q2.port_id = q1.port_id ORDER BY q2.port_id;

question: For ports that are administratively up, have at least one IP allocation, and are bound to security group ID 0008e629-5619-41e0-b86c-4eecfeaacb6c, return the port ID, tenant ID, MAC address, port status, allocated IP address, the running sum of the port’s standard attribute ID within each network, the total IP allocation count, and the number of distinct subnets—restricted to ports where more than 75% of their IP-allocation rows have a non-null subnet ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH PortIpAllocationStats AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ), SecurityGroupBoundPortIps AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.STATUS AS port_status, ia.IP_ADDRESS AS ip_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY p.NETWORK_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID = '0008e629-5619-41e0-b86c-4eecfeaacb6c' ), PortSubnetCoverage AS ( SELECT ia.port_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.subnet_id) AS distinct_subnet_count FROM ipallocations ia JOIN securitygroupportbindings sgpb ON sgpb.port_id = ia.port_id WHERE sgpb.security_group_id = '0008e629-5619-41e0-b86c-4eecfeaacb6c' GROUP BY ia.port_id ) SELECT pis.port_id, pis.tenant_id, pis.mac_address, sgp.port_status, sgp.ip_address, sgp.window_column, pis.ip_allocation_count, psc.distinct_subnet_count FROM PortIpAllocationStats pis JOIN SecurityGroupBoundPortIps sgp ON pis.port_id = sgp.port_id JOIN PortSubnetCoverage psc ON pis.port_id = psc.port_id WHERE (pis.subnet_id_rows * 1.0 / pis.ip_allocation_count) > 0.75;

question: How many administratively up ports belong to tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, and how many distinct port-status groups have a computed variance of `STANDARD_ATTR_ID` among ports with an IP allocation of `10.150.64.113/8`? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH ports_admin_up_tenant_window AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), status_variance_for_ip AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, VARIANCE(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM PORTS AS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NOT NULL AND ia.IP_ADDRESS IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.STATUS ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS admin_up_ports_for_tenant_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM status_variance_for_ip) AS ip_filtered_status_groups_count FROM ports_admin_up_tenant_window paw CROSS JOIN status_variance_for_ip svi;

question: For each security group bound to ports that are DOWN on network ID `0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d`, show the security group ID, the number of such down ports, the average of the per-port windowed minimum `admin_state_up` (computed over 3 preceding and 1 following port IDs), and the geometric mean of `standard_attr_id` for ports in tenant `17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7` that are bound to the same security group. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DownPortsWithWindow AS ( SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') ), SecurityGroupGeomMean AS ( SELECT s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, EXP(AVG(LN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID))) AS geometric_mean_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID > 0 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY geometric_mean_standard_attr_id DESC ) SELECT dpw.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, COUNT(*) AS down_port_count_in_network, AVG(dpw.window_column) AS avg_window_min_admin_state_up, MAX(sgg.geometric_mean_standard_attr_id) AS geometric_mean_standard_attr_id_for_tenant FROM DownPortsWithWindow dpw LEFT JOIN SecurityGroupGeomMean sgg ON dpw.SECURITY_GROUP_ID = sgg.SECURITY_GROUP_ID GROUP BY dpw.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY down_port_count_in_network DESC;

question: For tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57", list each ACTIVE network and its administratively-up ports on that network, showing the tenant_id, network_id, network_name, network admin_state_up, MTU, the network’s standard attribute updated_at timestamp, the row number of the network within the tenant ordered by network name, plus port details (port_id, host, VIF type, VNIC type, MAC address, port status, device owner) and the average port standard_attr_id computed over a 2-preceding/2-following window partitioned by VIF type. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH ActiveTenantNetworks AS (SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), AdminUpTenantPorts AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), CombinedNetworkPortView AS ( SELECT n.tenant_id, n.network_id, n.network_name, n.admin_state_up AS network_admin_state_up, n.mtu, n.standard_attr_updated_at, n.window_column AS network_row_number_by_name, p.PORT_ID AS port_id, p.HOST AS host, p.VIF_TYPE AS vif_type, p.VNIC_TYPE AS vnic_type, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, p.window_column AS avg_standard_attr_id_window_2_pre_2_fol_by_vif_type FROM ActiveTenantNetworks n JOIN AdminUpTenantPorts p ON p.TENANT_ID = n.tenant_id AND p.NETWORK_ID = n.network_id ) SELECT * FROM CombinedNetworkPortView ORDER BY tenant_id, network_name, port_id;

question: For the RBAC action "access_as_shared", return the action name along with (1) the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP version for IP version 4 subnets on networks referenced by RBAC entries, and (2) the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP version for DHCP-enabled subnets on non-shared networks (excluding networks shared to target tenant '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') where the action has more than 5 matching subnets. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH RbacIpVersionStatsShared AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ), RbacIpVersionStddevDhcpNonShared AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 AND s.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.ACTION HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY ip_version_stddev DESC ) SELECT r1.ACTION, r1.avg_ip_version, r1.ip_version_variance, r1.ip_version_stddev AS shared_access_ip_version_stddev, r2.ip_version_stddev AS dhcp_nonshared_ip_version_stddev FROM RbacIpVersionStatsShared r1 JOIN RbacIpVersionStddevDhcpNonShared r2 ON r1.ACTION = r2.ACTION WHERE r1.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' ORDER BY r1.ip_version_variance DESC;

sql: WITH PortIpAllocStats AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ), PortBindingWindowStats AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT pbws.PORT_ID AS port_id, pbws.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, pbws.NETWORK_ID AS network_id, pbws.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, pbws.HOST AS host, pbws.VIF_TYPE AS vif_type, pbws.VNIC_TYPE AS vnic_type, pbws.STATUS AS status, pbws.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, pbws.window_column AS avg_standard_attr_id_window, pias.ip_allocation_count AS ip_allocation_count, pias.subnet_id_rows AS subnet_id_rows FROM PortBindingWindowStats pbws JOIN PortIpAllocStats pias ON pias.port_id = pbws.PORT_ID ORDER BY pbws.VIF_TYPE, pbws.PORT_ID;

sql: WITH DefaultExternalNonSharedNetworks AS ( SELECT e.NETWORK_ID, e.IS_DEFAULT, n.TENANT_ID, n.NAME, n.STATUS, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP, n.MTU, n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID, MIN(n.MTU) OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.TENANT_ID) AS window_column FROM EXTERNALNETWORKS e JOIN NETWORKS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND n.ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ), ActiveNetworksWithRbacNonShared AS ( SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM networksecuritybindings b JOIN networks n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN networkrbacs r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ), DefaultExternalNonSharedNetworkCount AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS Default_External_NonShared_Network_Count FROM DefaultExternalNonSharedNetworks ) SELECT c.Default_External_NonShared_Network_Count, a.name, a.status, a.admin_state_up, a.action, a.target_tenant, a.window_column AS Active_Network_Rbac_Dense_Rank FROM DefaultExternalNonSharedNetworkCount c CROSS JOIN ActiveNetworksWithRbacNonShared a;

sql: WITH IPAllocStatusVariance AS (SELECT p.STATUS, VARIANCE(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM PORTS AS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NOT NULL AND ia.IP_ADDRESS IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.STATUS ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC), OVSDeviceStatusStats AS (SELECT p.STATUS, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' AND p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS) SELECT o.STATUS, o.min_admin_state_up, o.avg_standard_attr_id, i.standard_attr_id_variance FROM OVSDeviceStatusStats o JOIN IPAllocStatusVariance i ON o.STATUS = i.STATUS ORDER BY i.standard_attr_id_variance DESC;

question: For each port status and device owner (considering only ports whose standard attribute resource type is 'ports' and excluding shared networks), list the port status, device owner, number of ports, earliest standard attribute updated timestamp, and the associated network status; also include, for that network status, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED across networks with at least one security binding (excluding shared networks), and compute a derived metric of ports per security standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) (port_count divided by the network-status PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP)), ordered by this derived metric descending.
sql: WITH NetworkStatusSecurityStats AS ( SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, VARIANCE(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_variance, STDDEV(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_stddev FROM NETWORKS AS n JOIN NETWORKSECURITYBINDINGS AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.STATUS ORDER BY port_security_enabled_variance DESC ), PortStatusOwnerStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), PortStatusOwnerWithNetworkStatus AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, n.STATUS AS network_status FROM PORTS p JOIN NETWORKS n ON n.ID = p.NETWORK_ID JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ) SELECT psos.port_status, psos.device_owner, psos.port_count, psos.earliest_standard_attr_update, psonws.network_status, nsss.port_security_enabled_variance, nsss.port_security_enabled_stddev, ROUND(psos.port_count / NULLIF(nsss.port_security_enabled_stddev, 0), 2) AS ports_per_security_stddev FROM PortStatusOwnerStats psos JOIN PortStatusOwnerWithNetworkStatus psonws ON psonws.port_status = psos.port_status AND psonws.device_owner = psos.device_owner JOIN NetworkStatusSecurityStats nsss ON nsss.network_status = psonws.network_status ORDER BY ports_per_security_stddev DESC;

sql: WITH DownPortsBySecurityGroup AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), AdminUpPortsSecurityGroupAndDNSCounts AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN PORTDNSES pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name) SELECT dp.port_id, dp.tenant_id, dp.mac_address, dp.security_group_id, dp.window_column AS down_port_rank_within_security_group, au.port_name, au.security_group_binding_count, au.dns_record_count FROM DownPortsBySecurityGroup dp JOIN AdminUpPortsSecurityGroupAndDNSCounts au ON au.port_id = dp.port_id AND au.tenant_id = dp.tenant_id;

Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH PortStatusBindingStats AS ( SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC ), AdminUpPortWindowDetails AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), PortStatusCounts AS ( SELECT p.status, COUNT(*) AS port_count FROM PORTS p JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.status ) SELECT psbs.status, psc.port_count, psbs.binding_count_range, psbs.binding_count_variance, psbs.binding_count_stddev FROM PortStatusBindingStats psbs JOIN PortStatusCounts psc ON psbs.status = psc.status WHERE psbs.status IN (SELECT STATUS FROM AdminUpPortWindowDetails);

sql: WITH TenantDownPortsBySecurityGroup AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), NetworkDownPortsWithMinAdminStateWindow AS ( SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') ), SecurityGroupDownPortCounts AS ( SELECT sgpb.security_group_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS down_port_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') AND p.network_id IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') GROUP BY sgpb.security_group_id ) SELECT tdp.port_id, tdp.tenant_id, ndp.network_id, ndp.name AS port_name, tdp.mac_address, ndp.admin_state_up, ndp.status, ndp.device_owner, tdp.security_group_id, tdp.window_column AS port_rank_within_security_group_by_port_id, ndp.window_column AS min_admin_state_up_in_3_preceding_1_following_window, sgc.down_port_count FROM TenantDownPortsBySecurityGroup AS tdp JOIN NetworkDownPortsWithMinAdminStateWindow AS ndp ON tdp.security_group_id = ndp.security_group_id AND tdp.mac_address = ndp.mac_address JOIN SecurityGroupDownPortCounts AS sgc ON tdp.security_group_id = sgc.security_group_id WHERE sgc.down_port_count >= 2 ORDER BY sgc.down_port_count DESC, tdp.security_group_id, tdp.port_id;

sql: WITH port_status_owner_sg_summary AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), admin_up_ports_with_window AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT pso.port_status, pso.device_owner, pso.port_count, pso.min_standard_attr_id, COUNT(DISTINCT aup.PORT_ID) AS admin_up_port_rows, AVG(aup.window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM port_status_owner_sg_summary pso CROSS JOIN admin_up_ports_with_window aup GROUP BY pso.port_status, pso.device_owner, pso.port_count, pso.min_standard_attr_id;

sql: WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT n.ACTION AS rbac_action, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, MAX(s.IP_VERSION) - MIN(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_range, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION IN (4, 6) AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_range DESC ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM networksecuritybindings b JOIN networks n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN networkrbacs r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ) SELECT s2.name, s2.status, s2.admin_state_up, s2.action, s2.target_tenant, s2.window_column, s1.rbac_action, s1.avg_ip_version, s1.ip_version_range, s1.ip_version_variance FROM Subq2 s2 JOIN Subq1 s1 ON s2.action = s1.rbac_action ORDER BY s1.ip_version_range DESC, s2.name;

sql: WITH PortSecurityAgg AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(psb.port_id) AS binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN psb.port_security_enabled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS port_security_enabled_total FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address), HostWindowSum AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, p.TENANT_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE b.HOST = 'drive-59' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')) SELECT psa.port_id, psa.tenant_id, psa.mac_address, psa.binding_count, psa.port_security_enabled_total, hws.window_column FROM PortSecurityAgg psa JOIN HostWindowSum hws ON psa.port_id = hws.PORT_ID AND psa.tenant_id = hws.TENANT_ID AND psa.mac_address = hws.MAC_ADDRESS;

sql: WITH PortStatusOwnerSecurityGroupStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), AdminUpPortBindingWindow AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), AdminUpPortBindingWindow_WithSecurityGroup AS ( SELECT aupbw.PORT_ID, aupbw.HOST, aupbw.VIF_TYPE, aupbw.VNIC_TYPE, aupbw.TENANT_ID, aupbw.NETWORK_ID, aupbw.MAC_ADDRESS, aupbw.STATUS, aupbw.DEVICE_OWNER, aupbw.window_column FROM AdminUpPortBindingWindow aupbw JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON aupbw.PORT_ID = spb.PORT_ID ) SELECT psosgs.port_status, psosgs.device_owner, psosgs.port_count, psosgs.min_standard_attr_id, aupbwsg.PORT_ID, aupbwsg.HOST, aupbwsg.VIF_TYPE, aupbwsg.VNIC_TYPE, aupbwsg.TENANT_ID, aupbwsg.NETWORK_ID, aupbwsg.MAC_ADDRESS, aupbwsg.STATUS, aupbwsg.window_column FROM PortStatusOwnerSecurityGroupStats psosgs JOIN AdminUpPortBindingWindow_WithSecurityGroup aupbwsg ON psosgs.device_owner = aupbwsg.DEVICE_OWNER AND psosgs.port_status = aupbwsg.STATUS;

sql: WITH SubnetPoolDetails AS (SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')), FirstIpStatsBySubnet AS (SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(p.FIRST_IP) - MIN(p.FIRST_IP) AS first_ip_range, VARIANCE(p.FIRST_IP) AS first_ip_variance FROM SUBNETROUTES r JOIN SUBNETS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE r.NEXTHOP = '10.30.19.197/8' AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY first_ip_range DESC) SELECT spd.NAME AS subnet_name, spd.TENANT_ID, spd.NETWORK_ID, spd.IP_VERSION, spd.CIDR, spd.GATEWAY_IP, spd.ENABLE_DHCP, spd.FIRST_IP, spd.LAST_IP, spd.max_standard_attr_id_next2, fis.first_ip_range, fis.first_ip_variance FROM SubnetPoolDetails spd LEFT JOIN FirstIpStatsBySubnet fis ON spd.NAME = fis.subnet_name ORDER BY spd.NAME, spd.FIRST_IP;

sql: WITH SubnetPoolAndMaxAttrNext2 AS (SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')), SubnetAttrDenseRankWindow AS (SELECT s.NAME, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY sa.UPDATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES AS sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')) SELECT sp.NAME AS subnet_name, sp.TENANT_ID, sp.NETWORK_ID, sp.IP_VERSION, sp.CIDR, sp.GATEWAY_IP, sp.ENABLE_DHCP, sp.FIRST_IP, sp.LAST_IP, sp.max_standard_attr_id_next2, sadr.window_column AS standard_attr_dense_rank_window FROM SubnetPoolAndMaxAttrNext2 sp JOIN SubnetAttrDenseRankWindow sadr ON sp.NAME = sadr.NAME;

question: For each admin-state-up port in tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57' that is bound to a security group which also appears on at least one DOWN port in network ID '0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d', list the port ID, tenant ID, port name, the number of security group bindings, the total DNS record count, compute the DNS-per-security-group-binding ratio (DNS records divided by security group bindings, rounded to 2 decimals), and also show (for that shared security group) the number of DOWN-port rows and the average of the windowed minimum admin_state_up value (rounded to 2 decimals).
sql: WITH PortSecurityAndDns AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN PORTDNSES pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name ), DownPortsWithWindow AS ( SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') ), DownPortsAgg AS ( SELECT d.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, COUNT(*) AS down_port_rows, AVG(d.window_column) AS avg_window_min_admin_state_up FROM DownPortsWithWindow d GROUP BY d.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ) SELECT psd.port_id, psd.tenant_id, psd.port_name, psd.security_group_binding_count, psd.dns_record_count, ROUND( psd.dns_record_count / NULLIF(psd.security_group_binding_count, 0), 2 ) AS dns_per_security_group_binding_ratio, dpa.down_port_rows, ROUND(dpa.avg_window_min_admin_state_up, 2) AS avg_window_min_admin_state_up FROM PortSecurityAndDns psd JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb2 ON sgpb2.PORT_ID = psd.port_id JOIN DownPortsAgg dpa ON dpa.SECURITY_GROUP_ID = sgpb2.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY dns_per_security_group_binding_ratio DESC, psd.port_id;

question: Among ACTIVE networks that have an RBAC entry and a maximum MTU greater than 8000, list each network name with the RBAC action (restricted to the shared action) and its max MTU, and also show the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP version (considering only IPv4 subnets) for RBAC entries with the "access_as_shared" permission. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH RbacIpVersionStats AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ), HighMtuRbacNetworks AS ( SELECT n.name AS network_name, r.action AS rbac_action, MAX(n.mtu) AS max_mtu FROM NETWORKSECURITYBINDINGS nsb JOIN NETWORKS n ON nsb.network_id = n.id JOIN NETWORKRBACS r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.action IN ('access_as_shared', 'access_as_external') GROUP BY n.name, r.action HAVING MAX(n.mtu) > 8000 ), FilteredHighMtuSharedNetworks AS ( SELECT hmn.network_name, hmn.rbac_action, hmn.max_mtu FROM HighMtuRbacNetworks hmn WHERE hmn.rbac_action = 'access_as_shared' ) SELECT f.network_name, f.rbac_action, f.max_mtu, r.avg_ip_version, r.ip_version_variance, r.ip_version_stddev FROM FilteredHighMtuSharedNetworks f JOIN RbacIpVersionStats r ON r.ACTION = f.rbac_action ORDER BY f.max_mtu DESC, f.network_name;

sql: WITH q1 AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 AND s.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.ACTION HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY ip_version_stddev DESC ), q2 AS ( SELECT n.name AS network_name, r.action AS rbac_action, MAX(n.mtu) AS max_mtu FROM NETWORKSECURITYBINDINGS nsb JOIN NETWORKS n ON nsb.network_id = n.id JOIN NETWORKRBACS r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.action IN ('access_as_shared', 'access_as_external') GROUP BY n.name, r.action HAVING MAX(n.mtu) > 8000 ) SELECT q2.network_name, q2.rbac_action, q2.max_mtu, q1.ip_version_stddev FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q2.rbac_action = q1.ACTION ORDER BY q2.max_mtu DESC, q1.ip_version_stddev DESC;

sql: WITH SecurityGroupAndDnsByPort AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN PORTDNSES pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name ), IpAllocationsByPort AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ) SELECT sgdp.port_id, sgdp.tenant_id, sgdp.port_name, iap.mac_address, sgdp.security_group_binding_count, sgdp.dns_record_count, iap.ip_allocation_count, iap.subnet_id_rows FROM SecurityGroupAndDnsByPort sgdp JOIN IpAllocationsByPort iap ON sgdp.port_id = iap.port_id AND sgdp.tenant_id = iap.tenant_id WHERE sgdp.security_group_binding_count >= 1 ORDER BY sgdp.security_group_binding_count DESC, iap.ip_allocation_count DESC;

sql: WITH PortStatusVariation AS ( SELECT p.status, STDDEV(p.standard_attr_id) / NULLIF(AVG(p.standard_attr_id), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM securitygroupportbindings AS sgpb JOIN ports AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN portsecuritybindings AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(p.standard_attr_id) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), PortStatusDeviceOwnerStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ) SELECT psdo.port_status, psdo.device_owner, psdo.port_count, psdo.earliest_standard_attr_update, psv.coefficient_of_variation FROM PortStatusDeviceOwnerStats psdo JOIN PortStatusVariation psv ON psdo.port_status = psv.status ORDER BY psdo.port_count DESC, psv.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

sql: WITH PortBindingWindow AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), PortStatusVariance AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, VARIANCE(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM PORTS AS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NOT NULL AND ia.IP_ADDRESS IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.STATUS ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC ) SELECT pbw.PORT_ID, pbw.HOST, pbw.VIF_TYPE, pbw.VNIC_TYPE, pbw.TENANT_ID, pbw.NETWORK_ID, pbw.MAC_ADDRESS, pbw.STATUS, pbw.DEVICE_OWNER, pbw.window_column, psv.standard_attr_id_variance FROM PortBindingWindow pbw JOIN PortStatusVariance psv ON pbw.STATUS = psv.STATUS ORDER BY pbw.VIF_TYPE, pbw.PORT_ID;

sql: WITH sq1 AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), sq2 AS ( SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') ) SELECT sq2.NETWORK_ID, sq2.NAME AS port_name, sq2.MAC_ADDRESS, sq2.ADMIN_STATE_UP, sq2.STATUS AS port_status, sq2.DEVICE_OWNER, sq2.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, sq2.window_column AS min_admin_state_up_window, sq1.port_count, sq1.earliest_standard_attr_update FROM sq2 JOIN sq1 ON sq1.port_status = sq2.STATUS AND sq1.device_owner = sq2.DEVICE_OWNER ORDER BY sq1.port_count DESC, sq2.NAME;

question: For ACTIVE networks that have an RBAC entry with action = 'access_as_shared' and whose maximum MTU (within each network name and RBAC action group) is greater than 8000, list the network name, RBAC action, and that maximum MTU, along with the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP version (restricted to IP_VERSION = 4) for RBAC-referenced subnets under the same action. sql: WITH RbacIpVersionStats AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ), ActiveHighMtuNetworks AS ( SELECT n.name AS network_name, r.action AS rbac_action, MAX(n.mtu) AS max_mtu FROM NETWORKSECURITYBINDINGS nsb JOIN NETWORKS n ON nsb.network_id = n.id JOIN NETWORKRBACS r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.action IN ('access_as_shared', 'access_as_external') GROUP BY n.name, r.action HAVING MAX(n.mtu) > 8000 ) SELECT ahmn.network_name, ahmn.rbac_action, ahmn.max_mtu, rivs.avg_ip_version, rivs.ip_version_variance, rivs.ip_version_stddev FROM ActiveHighMtuNetworks ahmn JOIN RbacIpVersionStats rivs ON ahmn.rbac_action = rivs.ACTION WHERE ahmn.rbac_action = 'access_as_shared' ORDER BY ahmn.max_mtu DESC;

sql: WITH q1 AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT = '*' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ), q2 AS ( SELECT n.ACTION AS rbac_action, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, MAX(s.IP_VERSION) - MIN(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_range, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION IN (4, 6) AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_range DESC ) SELECT q1.ACTION AS rbac_action, q2.avg_ip_version, q2.ip_version_range, q1.ip_version_variance AS public_access_ip_version_variance, q2.ip_version_variance AS overall_ip_version_variance FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.ACTION = q2.rbac_action ORDER BY q2.ip_version_range DESC;

sql: WITH SubnetDetails AS ( SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') ), SubnetRouteStats AS ( SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(route_count) - MIN(route_count) AS route_count_range, VARIANCE(route_count) AS route_count_variance, STDDEV(route_count) AS route_count_stddev FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN ( SELECT sr.SUBNET_ID, COUNT(*) AS route_count FROM SUBNETROUTES AS sr GROUP BY sr.SUBNET_ID, sr.NEXTHOP ) AS route_stats ON s.ID = route_stats.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY route_count_range DESC ) SELECT sd.NAME AS subnet_name, sd.TENANT_ID, sd.NETWORK_ID, sd.IP_VERSION, sd.CIDR, sd.GATEWAY_IP, sd.ENABLE_DHCP, sd.FIRST_IP, sd.LAST_IP, sd.max_standard_attr_id_next2, srs.route_count_range, srs.route_count_variance, srs.route_count_stddev FROM SubnetDetails sd JOIN SubnetRouteStats srs ON sd.NAME = srs.subnet_name;

sql: WITH PortDetails AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), StatusVariance AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, VARIANCE(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM PORTS AS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NOT NULL AND ia.IP_ADDRESS IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.STATUS ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC ) SELECT pd.PORT_ID, pd.HOST, pd.VIF_TYPE, pd.VNIC_TYPE, pd.TENANT_ID, pd.NETWORK_ID, pd.MAC_ADDRESS, pd.STATUS, pd.DEVICE_OWNER, pd.window_column, sv.standard_attr_id_variance FROM PortDetails AS pd LEFT JOIN StatusVariance AS sv ON pd.STATUS = sv.STATUS;

question: For tenant_id '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7' and ports with status 'DOWN' that are bound to a security group, list each device owner with the distinct port count and the minimum standard attribute ID, and also show (by port status) the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of standard attribute IDs for ports that have both a security group port binding and a port security binding. sql: WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT p.status, STDDEV(p.standard_attr_id) / NULLIF(AVG(p.standard_attr_id), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM securitygroupportbindings AS sgpb JOIN ports AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN portsecuritybindings AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(p.standard_attr_id) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ) SELECT s2.port_status, s2.device_owner, s2.port_count, s2.min_standard_attr_id, s1.coefficient_of_variation FROM Subq2 s2 JOIN Subq1 s1 ON s2.port_status = s1.status;

question: For tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57", count how many ACTIVE networks they have and how many administratively-up ports they have on those networks, then compute the ports-per-active-network ratio (ports divided by active networks, rounded to 2 decimals), along with the average of the ports’ windowed standard attribute ID metric and the latest network standard-attribute updated_at timestamp.
sql: WITH ActiveTenantNetworks AS ( SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), AdminUpTenantPorts AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT n.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT n.network_id) AS active_network_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p.PORT_ID) AS admin_up_port_count, ROUND( COUNT(DISTINCT p.PORT_ID) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT n.network_id), 0), 2 ) AS ports_per_active_network_ratio, ROUND(AVG(p.window_column), 2) AS avg_port_window_standard_attr_id, MAX(n.standard_attr_updated_at) AS latest_network_standard_attr_updated_at FROM ActiveTenantNetworks n JOIN AdminUpTenantPorts p ON p.tenant_id = n.tenant_id AND p.NETWORK_ID = n.network_id WHERE n.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY n.tenant_id ORDER BY ports_per_active_network_ratio DESC;

sql: WITH sq1 AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT = '*' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ), sq2 AS ( SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM networksecuritybindings b JOIN networks n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN networkrbacs r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ) SELECT sq2.name, sq2.status, sq2.admin_state_up, sq2.action, sq2.target_tenant, sq2.window_column, sq1.ip_version_variance FROM sq2 CROSS JOIN sq1 ORDER BY sq1.ip_version_variance DESC, sq2.name;
