sql: WITH port_security_binding_stats_by_status AS ( SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC ), down_ports_with_security_groups AS ( SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') ), down_ports_with_security_groups_tenant_filtered AS ( SELECT dpsg.NAME, dpsg.NETWORK_ID, dpsg.MAC_ADDRESS, dpsg.ADMIN_STATE_UP, dpsg.STATUS, dpsg.DEVICE_OWNER, dpsg.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, dpsg.window_column FROM down_ports_with_security_groups dpsg JOIN ports p ON p.network_id = dpsg.NETWORK_ID AND p.mac_address = dpsg.MAC_ADDRESS WHERE p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') ) SELECT psbs.status, psbs.binding_count_range, psbs.binding_count_variance, psbs.binding_count_stddev, COUNT(*) AS down_port_rows_for_tenant_and_network FROM port_security_binding_stats_by_status psbs CROSS JOIN down_ports_with_security_groups_tenant_filtered dptf GROUP BY psbs.status, psbs.binding_count_range, psbs.binding_count_variance, psbs.binding_count_stddev ORDER BY psbs.binding_count_range DESC;

question: For the IPv4 subnet with ID '012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48' (and considering only routes whose next hop is '10.30.19.197/8'), list the subnet name, tenant ID, network ID, IP version, CIDR, gateway IP, DHCP enabled flag, each allocation pool’s first and last IP, the maximum subnet standard attribute ID over the current row and next 2 rows (ordered by subnet ID), and the allocation-pool FIRST_IP range and variance for that subnet name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH SubnetDetails AS ( SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') ), SubnetFirstIpStats AS ( SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(p.FIRST_IP) - MIN(p.FIRST_IP) AS first_ip_range, VARIANCE(p.FIRST_IP) AS first_ip_variance FROM SUBNETROUTES r JOIN SUBNETS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE r.NEXTHOP = '10.30.19.197/8' AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY first_ip_range DESC ) SELECT sd.NAME, sd.TENANT_ID, sd.NETWORK_ID, sd.IP_VERSION, sd.CIDR, sd.GATEWAY_IP, sd.ENABLE_DHCP, sd.FIRST_IP, sd.LAST_IP, sd.max_standard_attr_id_next2, sfs.first_ip_range, sfs.first_ip_variance FROM SubnetDetails sd JOIN SubnetFirstIpStats sfs ON sd.NAME = sfs.subnet_name ORDER BY sfs.first_ip_range DESC, sd.NAME;

Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH FirstIpPoolStats AS ( SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(p.FIRST_IP) - MIN(p.FIRST_IP) AS first_ip_range, VARIANCE(p.FIRST_IP) AS first_ip_variance FROM SUBNETROUTES r JOIN SUBNETS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE r.NEXTHOP = '10.30.19.197/8' AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY first_ip_range DESC ), RouteCountStats AS ( SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(route_count) - MIN(route_count) AS route_count_range, VARIANCE(route_count) AS route_count_variance, STDDEV(route_count) AS route_count_stddev FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN ( SELECT sr.SUBNET_ID, COUNT(*) AS route_count FROM SUBNETROUTES AS sr GROUP BY sr.SUBNET_ID, sr.NEXTHOP ) AS route_stats ON s.ID = route_stats.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY route_count_range DESC ) SELECT fips.subnet_name, fips.first_ip_range, fips.first_ip_variance, rcs.route_count_range, rcs.route_count_variance, rcs.route_count_stddev FROM FirstIpPoolStats fips JOIN RouteCountStats rcs ON fips.subnet_name = rcs.subnet_name ORDER BY fips.first_ip_range DESC, rcs.route_count_range DESC;

sql: WITH q1 AS ( SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(p.FIRST_IP) - MIN(p.FIRST_IP) AS first_ip_range, VARIANCE(p.FIRST_IP) AS first_ip_variance FROM SUBNETROUTES r JOIN SUBNETS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE r.NEXTHOP = '10.30.19.197/8' AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY first_ip_range DESC ), q2 AS ( SELECT s.NAME, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY sa.UPDATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES AS sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') ) SELECT q1.subnet_name, q1.first_ip_range, q1.first_ip_variance, q2.window_column AS standard_attr_updated_at_dense_rank_window FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.subnet_name = q2.NAME ORDER BY q1.first_ip_range DESC;

sql: WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' AND p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') ) SELECT s1.STATUS AS port_status, s1.min_admin_state_up AS ovs_device_min_admin_state_up, s1.avg_standard_attr_id AS ovs_device_avg_standard_attr_id, COUNT(*) AS down_ports_in_network_with_security_group_count, AVG(s2.window_column) AS avg_window_min_admin_state_up_for_down_ports FROM Subq1 s1 CROSS JOIN Subq2 s2 GROUP BY s1.STATUS, s1.min_admin_state_up, s1.avg_standard_attr_id;

question: For each port status, report the port security binding count range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) for ports that have at least one port security binding and belong to tenant ID '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7', along with the variance of STANDARD_ATTR_ID for ports that have an IP allocation with IP address 10.150.64.113/8, and compute the ratio of binding-count variance to STANDARD_ATTR_ID variance.
sql: WITH PortSecurityBindingStats AS ( SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC ), StandardAttrIdVarianceByStatus AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, VARIANCE(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM PORTS AS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NOT NULL AND ia.IP_ADDRESS IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.STATUS ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC ) SELECT psbs.status, psbs.binding_count_range, psbs.binding_count_variance, psbs.binding_count_stddev, saivs.standard_attr_id_variance, ROUND(psbs.binding_count_variance / NULLIF(saivs.standard_attr_id_variance, 0), 4) AS BindingCountVariance_To_StandardAttrIdVariance_Ratio FROM PortSecurityBindingStats psbs JOIN StandardAttrIdVarianceByStatus saivs ON psbs.status = saivs.status ORDER BY BindingCountVariance_To_StandardAttrIdVariance_Ratio DESC;

question: How many distinct tenants have non-shared networks that are marked as default external networks (IS_DEFAULT = 0), and how many (port status, device owner) groups exist for non-shared ports whose standard attribute resource type is 'ports'? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH default_external_networks AS ( SELECT e.NETWORK_ID, e.IS_DEFAULT, n.TENANT_ID, n.NAME, n.STATUS, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP, n.MTU, n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID, MIN(n.MTU) OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.TENANT_ID) AS window_column FROM EXTERNALNETWORKS e JOIN NETWORKS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND n.ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ), port_status_device_owner_summary AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT den.TENANT_ID) AS tenant_count_with_default_external_networks, COUNT(*) AS port_status_device_owner_group_count FROM default_external_networks den CROSS JOIN port_status_device_owner_summary psdos;

sql: WITH ActiveNetworks AS ( SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), PortSecurityAndDns AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN PORTDNSES pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name ) SELECT an.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT an.network_id) AS active_network_count, COUNT(DISTINCT psd.port_id) AS admin_up_sg_bound_port_count, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT psd.port_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT an.network_id), 0), 2) AS avg_ports_per_active_network, SUM(psd.security_group_binding_count) AS total_security_group_bindings_across_ports, SUM(psd.dns_record_count) AS total_dns_records_across_ports FROM ActiveNetworks an CROSS JOIN PortSecurityAndDns psd GROUP BY an.tenant_id;

sql: WITH default_external_networks AS ( SELECT e.NETWORK_ID, e.IS_DEFAULT, n.TENANT_ID, n.NAME, n.STATUS, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP, n.MTU, n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID, MIN(n.MTU) OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.TENANT_ID) AS window_column FROM EXTERNALNETWORKS e JOIN NETWORKS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND n.ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ), port_status_owner_stats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), top10_device_owner_port_counts AS ( SELECT device_owner, SUM(port_count) AS total_ports FROM port_status_owner_stats GROUP BY device_owner ORDER BY total_ports DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT t.device_owner, t.total_ports, den.NETWORK_ID, den.IS_DEFAULT, den.TENANT_ID, den.NAME AS network_name, den.STATUS AS network_status, den.ADMIN_STATE_UP, den.MTU, den.STANDARD_ATTR_ID AS network_standard_attr_id, den.window_column AS min_mtu_within_tenant, psos.port_status, psos.port_count, psos.earliest_standard_attr_update FROM top10_device_owner_port_counts t JOIN port_status_owner_stats psos ON psos.device_owner = t.device_owner CROSS JOIN default_external_networks den ORDER BY t.total_ports DESC, t.device_owner, psos.port_status;

sql: WITH PortStatusOwnerSecurityGroupStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), PortStatusOvsBindingStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' AND p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS ) SELECT psosgs.port_status, psosgs.device_owner, psosgs.port_count, psosgs.min_standard_attr_id, psobs.min_admin_state_up, psobs.avg_standard_attr_id FROM PortStatusOwnerSecurityGroupStats psosgs JOIN PortStatusOvsBindingStats psobs ON psosgs.port_status = psobs.STATUS ORDER BY psosgs.port_count DESC;

sql: WITH PortSecurityGroupRanks AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), ActiveTenantNetworks AS ( SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), DownTenantPortsWithNetwork AS ( SELECT psgr.port_id, psgr.tenant_id, psgr.mac_address, psgr.security_group_id, psgr.window_column AS port_rank_within_security_group, p.network_id FROM PortSecurityGroupRanks psgr JOIN PORTS p ON p.id = psgr.port_id WHERE psgr.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT atn.tenant_id, atn.network_id, atn.network_name, atn.admin_state_up, atn.mtu, atn.standard_attr_updated_at, atn.window_column AS network_row_number_within_tenant, dtp.port_id, dtp.mac_address, dtp.security_group_id, dtp.port_rank_within_security_group FROM ActiveTenantNetworks atn JOIN DownTenantPortsWithNetwork dtp ON dtp.network_id = atn.network_id AND dtp.tenant_id = atn.tenant_id ORDER BY atn.tenant_id, atn.network_name, dtp.security_group_id, dtp.port_id;

question: For tenant ID `17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7`, summarize the administratively up ports by showing the tenant ID, the number of admin-up ports, the total number of port security bindings on those ports, the total number of times port security is enabled across those bindings, the enabled-to-binding ratio (enabled total divided by binding total, rounded), and the average running-sum standard-attribute window value for any of those ports that are also in DOWN status.
sql: WITH PortSecurityStats AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(psb.port_id) AS binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN psb.port_security_enabled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS port_security_enabled_total FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address), DownPortWindow AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(sa.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY sa.RESOURCE_TYPE ORDER BY sa.ID) AS window_column FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')) SELECT pss.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT pss.port_id) AS admin_up_port_count, SUM(pss.binding_count) AS total_binding_count, SUM(pss.port_security_enabled_total) AS total_port_security_enabled_across_bindings, ROUND( SUM(pss.port_security_enabled_total) / NULLIF(SUM(pss.binding_count), 0), 2 ) AS port_security_enabled_ratio, AVG(dpw.window_column) AS avg_down_port_window_sum FROM PortSecurityStats pss LEFT JOIN DownPortWindow dpw ON dpw.port_id = pss.port_id AND dpw.tenant_id = pss.tenant_id GROUP BY pss.tenant_id ORDER BY port_security_enabled_ratio DESC;

question: For each port status that appears in both result sets, show the port status along with (1) the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of allocated IP address string lengths for ports with port security enabled and allocated IP address in ('10.150.64.113/8'), and (2) the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of port security bindings per port for ports belonging to tenant ID '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH sq1 AS ( SELECT p.status, STDDEV(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) / NULLIF(AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM portsecuritybindings psb JOIN ports p ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON p.id = ia.port_id WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1 AND ia.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), sq2 AS ( SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC ) SELECT sq2.status, sq1.coefficient_of_variation, sq2.binding_count_range, sq2.binding_count_variance, sq2.binding_count_stddev FROM sq2 JOIN sq1 ON sq2.status = sq1.status ORDER BY sq2.binding_count_range DESC;

sql: WITH DownPortsBySecurityGroup AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), AdminUpPortBindingAndDNSCounts AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN PORTDNSES pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name), DownPortsThatAreAlsoAdminUp AS ( SELECT dpsg.port_id, dpsg.tenant_id, dpsg.mac_address, dpsg.security_group_id, dpsg.window_column, aup.port_name, aup.security_group_binding_count, aup.dns_record_count FROM DownPortsBySecurityGroup dpsg JOIN AdminUpPortBindingAndDNSCounts aup ON dpsg.port_id = aup.port_id AND dpsg.tenant_id = aup.tenant_id ) SELECT port_id, tenant_id, mac_address, security_group_id, window_column AS port_rank_within_security_group_by_port_id, port_name, security_group_binding_count, dns_record_count FROM DownPortsThatAreAlsoAdminUp ORDER BY security_group_id, port_id;

question: For non-shared networks (excluding any network IDs that appear in networkrbacs with action = 'access_as_shared' and target_tenant = '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), what is the port count and earliest standard-attribute updated timestamp for each port status and device owner (considering only standardattributes.resource_type = 'ports'), and—at the same time—what is the number of RBAC rows for each (action, target_tenant) among ACTIVE networks? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH port_status_owner_summary AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), active_network_rbac_details AS ( SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM networksecuritybindings b JOIN networks n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN networkrbacs r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ), active_network_rbac_counts AS ( SELECT action, target_tenant, COUNT(*) AS active_network_rbac_row_count FROM active_network_rbac_details GROUP BY action, target_tenant ) SELECT p.port_status, p.device_owner, p.port_count, p.earliest_standard_attr_update, c.action, c.target_tenant, c.active_network_rbac_row_count FROM port_status_owner_summary p CROSS JOIN active_network_rbac_counts c;

question: For the RBAC action access_as_shared, return the action name along with (1) the variance of subnet IP version (IPv4 vs IPv6) considering only public RBAC entries where TARGET_TENANT = '*', and (2) the average, range (max minus min), and variance of subnet IP version across all referenced subnets with IP version 4 or 6. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH Subq1 AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT = '*' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ), Subq2 AS ( SELECT n.ACTION AS rbac_action, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, MAX(s.IP_VERSION) - MIN(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_range, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION IN (4, 6) AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_range DESC ) SELECT s1.ACTION, s1.ip_version_variance AS public_access_ip_version_variance, s2.avg_ip_version, s2.ip_version_range, s2.ip_version_variance AS overall_ip_version_variance FROM Subq1 s1 JOIN Subq2 s2 ON s1.ACTION = s2.rbac_action;

sql: WITH SubnetAttributeWindow AS ( SELECT s.NAME, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY sa.UPDATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES AS sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') ), SubnetRouteStats AS ( SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(route_count) - MIN(route_count) AS route_count_range, VARIANCE(route_count) AS route_count_variance, STDDEV(route_count) AS route_count_stddev FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN ( SELECT sr.SUBNET_ID, COUNT(*) AS route_count FROM SUBNETROUTES AS sr GROUP BY sr.SUBNET_ID, sr.NEXTHOP ) AS route_stats ON s.ID = route_stats.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY route_count_range DESC ), CombinedSubnetMetrics AS ( SELECT saw.NAME AS subnet_name, saw.window_column, NULL AS route_count_range, NULL AS route_count_variance, NULL AS route_count_stddev, 'Standard Attribute Window Rank' AS reason FROM SubnetAttributeWindow AS saw UNION ALL SELECT srs.subnet_name, NULL AS window_column, srs.route_count_range, srs.route_count_variance, srs.route_count_stddev, 'Route Count Stats' AS reason FROM SubnetRouteStats AS srs ) SELECT * FROM CombinedSubnetMetrics ORDER BY subnet_name, reason;

sql: WITH CoeffOfVarByStatus AS ( SELECT p.status, STDDEV(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) / NULLIF(AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM portsecuritybindings psb JOIN ports p ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON p.id = ia.port_id WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1 AND ia.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), StdAttrIdVarByStatus AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, VARIANCE(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM PORTS AS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NOT NULL AND ia.IP_ADDRESS IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.STATUS ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC ) SELECT cv.status, cv.coefficient_of_variation, sv.standard_attr_id_variance FROM CoeffOfVarByStatus cv JOIN StdAttrIdVarByStatus sv ON cv.status = sv.status;

sql: WITH SubnetWindowRanks AS ( SELECT s.NAME, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY sa.UPDATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES AS sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') ), SubnetRouteStats AS ( SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(route_count) - MIN(route_count) AS route_count_range, VARIANCE(route_count) AS route_count_variance, STDDEV(route_count) AS route_count_stddev FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN ( SELECT sr.SUBNET_ID, COUNT(*) AS route_count FROM SUBNETROUTES AS sr GROUP BY sr.SUBNET_ID, sr.NEXTHOP ) AS route_stats ON s.ID = route_stats.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY route_count_range DESC ) SELECT swr.NAME AS subnet_name, swr.window_column, srs.route_count_range, srs.route_count_variance, srs.route_count_stddev FROM SubnetWindowRanks AS swr JOIN SubnetRouteStats AS srs ON srs.subnet_name = swr.NAME ORDER BY swr.NAME, swr.window_column;

sql: WITH PortStatusIPLenCV AS (SELECT p.status, STDDEV(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) / NULLIF(AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM portsecuritybindings psb JOIN ports p ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON p.id = ia.port_id WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1 AND ia.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), AdminUpTenantPorts AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')) SELECT a.PORT_ID, a.HOST, a.VIF_TYPE, a.VNIC_TYPE, a.TENANT_ID, a.NETWORK_ID, a.MAC_ADDRESS, a.STATUS, a.DEVICE_OWNER, a.window_column, cv.coefficient_of_variation FROM AdminUpTenantPorts a JOIN PortStatusIPLenCV cv ON a.STATUS = cv.status;

sql: WITH PortIpAllocationStats AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ), DownPortsWindowBySecurityGroup AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), SecurityGroupCountsForTenant AS ( SELECT sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID AS security_group_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS total_ports_in_sg_for_tenant, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.STATUS = 'DOWN' THEN p.ID END) AS down_ports_in_sg_for_tenant FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID WHERE p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ) SELECT sct.security_group_id, sct.total_ports_in_sg_for_tenant, sct.down_ports_in_sg_for_tenant, AVG(dpw.window_column) AS avg_down_port_running_sum_standard_attr_id, COUNT(DISTINCT pia.port_id) AS admin_up_ports_with_ip_allocations_in_sg, AVG(pia.ip_allocation_count) AS avg_ip_allocations_per_admin_up_port_in_sg, MAX(pia.subnet_id_rows) AS max_subnet_id_rows_among_admin_up_ports_in_sg FROM SecurityGroupCountsForTenant sct JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb ON sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID = sct.security_group_id LEFT JOIN DownPortsWindowBySecurityGroup dpw ON dpw.port_id = sgpb.PORT_ID LEFT JOIN PortIpAllocationStats pia ON pia.port_id = sgpb.PORT_ID WHERE sct.down_ports_in_sg_for_tenant > 0 AND (sct.total_ports_in_sg_for_tenant - sct.down_ports_in_sg_for_tenant) > 0 GROUP BY sct.security_group_id, sct.total_ports_in_sg_for_tenant, sct.down_ports_in_sg_for_tenant ORDER BY sct.total_ports_in_sg_for_tenant DESC;

sql: WITH PortIpAllocationStats AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ), DownPortsSecurityGroupWindow AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT dpsgw.tenant_id, dpsgw.port_id, dpsgw.mac_address, dpsgw.window_column, pis.ip_allocation_count, pis.subnet_id_rows FROM DownPortsSecurityGroupWindow dpsgw JOIN PortIpAllocationStats pis ON pis.port_id = dpsgw.port_id AND pis.tenant_id = dpsgw.tenant_id WHERE pis.ip_allocation_count >= 1 ORDER BY dpsgw.window_column DESC, dpsgw.port_id;

question: For the RBAC action access_as_shared, return the action name along with the average, range (max minus min), variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP versions (IPv4/IPv6), where the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is computed only over DHCP-enabled subnets on non-shared networks (excluding networks that have an access_as_shared RBAC entry with target tenant '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') and only if there are more than 5 such matching subnets. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH RbacIpVersionStddev AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 AND s.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.ACTION HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY ip_version_stddev DESC ), AccessAsSharedIpVersionStats AS ( SELECT n.ACTION AS rbac_action, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, MAX(s.IP_VERSION) - MIN(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_range, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION IN (4, 6) AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_range DESC ) SELECT aasis.rbac_action, aasis.avg_ip_version, aasis.ip_version_range, aasis.ip_version_variance, rivs.ip_version_stddev FROM AccessAsSharedIpVersionStats aasis JOIN RbacIpVersionStddev rivs ON aasis.rbac_action = rivs.ACTION ORDER BY aasis.ip_version_range DESC;

question: For each IPv4 subnet whose subnet ID is in ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48'), show the subnet name, tenant ID, network ID, IP version, CIDR, gateway IP, DHCP enabled flag, the allocation pool’s first and last IP, the maximum subnet standard attribute ID considering the current row and the next 2 rows (ordered by subnet ID), the dense rank of its standard attribute ID ordered by the standard attribute updated-at timestamp using a window of the current row and 2 preceding rows, and the ratio of that dense rank to the max standard attribute ID.
sql: WITH SubnetPools AS (SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')), SubnetAttrDenseRank AS (SELECT s.NAME, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY sa.UPDATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES AS sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')) SELECT sp.NAME AS subnet_name, sp.TENANT_ID, sp.NETWORK_ID, sp.IP_VERSION, sp.CIDR, sp.GATEWAY_IP, sp.ENABLE_DHCP, sp.FIRST_IP AS allocation_pool_first_ip, sp.LAST_IP AS allocation_pool_last_ip, sp.max_standard_attr_id_next2, sadr.window_column AS standard_attr_dense_rank_window, ROUND(sadr.window_column / NULLIF(sp.max_standard_attr_id_next2, 0), 4) AS dense_rank_to_max_attr_ratio FROM SubnetPools sp JOIN SubnetAttrDenseRank sadr ON sp.NAME = sadr.NAME ORDER BY dense_rank_to_max_attr_ratio DESC;

question: For administratively up ports belonging to tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, list each port’s ID, host, VIF type, VNIC type, tenant ID, network ID, MAC address, status, device owner, and the 2-preceding/2-following windowed average of standard attribute ID (partitioned by VIF type and ordered by standard attribute ID), along with the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of standard attribute IDs for that same port status computed over ports that have both a security group port binding and a port security binding for tenant `17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7`. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH sq1 AS ( SELECT p.status, STDDEV(p.standard_attr_id) / NULLIF(AVG(p.standard_attr_id), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM securitygroupportbindings AS sgpb JOIN ports AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN portsecuritybindings AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(p.standard_attr_id) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), sq2 AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT sq2.PORT_ID, sq2.HOST, sq2.VIF_TYPE, sq2.VNIC_TYPE, sq2.TENANT_ID, sq2.NETWORK_ID, sq2.MAC_ADDRESS, sq2.STATUS, sq2.DEVICE_OWNER, sq2.window_column, sq1.coefficient_of_variation FROM sq2 JOIN sq1 ON sq2.STATUS = sq1.status ORDER BY sq1.coefficient_of_variation DESC, sq2.window_column DESC;

question: For administratively up ports owned by tenant `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, excluding shared networks (networks listed in `networkrbacs` with action `access_as_shared` and target tenant `*` or `9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b`), show for each VIF type, port status, and device owner: the overall port count and earliest standard-attribute updated timestamp for that status/owner, along with the number of matching tenant port rows and the average of the windowed average standard attribute ID. sql: WITH sq1 AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), sq2 AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT sq2.VIF_TYPE, sq2.STATUS AS port_status, sq2.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, sq1.port_count, sq1.earliest_standard_attr_update, COUNT(sq2.PORT_ID) AS tenant_port_rows, AVG(sq2.window_column) AS avg_window_standard_attr_id FROM sq2 JOIN sq1 ON sq2.STATUS = sq1.port_status AND sq2.DEVICE_OWNER = sq1.device_owner WHERE sq2.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY sq2.VIF_TYPE, sq2.STATUS, sq2.DEVICE_OWNER, sq1.port_count, sq1.earliest_standard_attr_update ORDER BY tenant_port_rows DESC;

sql: WITH ports_rank_within_sg AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), ports_running_sum_std_attr AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT prws.port_id, prws.tenant_id, prws.mac_address, prws.security_group_id, prws.window_column AS rank_within_security_group_by_port_id, prssa.window_column AS running_sum_standard_attr_id_within_security_group FROM ports_rank_within_sg prws JOIN ports_running_sum_std_attr prssa ON prssa.port_id = prws.port_id AND prssa.tenant_id = prws.tenant_id AND prssa.mac_address = prws.mac_address;

question: For tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57", for tenants that have at least 2 administratively-up ports, return the tenant ID, the count of those admin-up ports, the number of ACTIVE networks for that tenant, and the most recent (latest) network standard-attribute updated_at timestamp. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH ActiveTenantNetworks AS (SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), AdminUpTenantPorts AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), TenantPortCounts AS ( SELECT ap.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.PORT_ID) AS admin_up_port_count FROM AdminUpTenantPorts ap GROUP BY ap.TENANT_ID ) SELECT an.tenant_id, tpc.admin_up_port_count, COUNT(DISTINCT an.network_id) AS active_network_count, MAX(an.standard_attr_updated_at) AS latest_network_standard_attr_updated_at FROM ActiveTenantNetworks an JOIN TenantPortCounts tpc ON an.tenant_id = tpc.tenant_id WHERE tpc.admin_up_port_count >= 2 GROUP BY an.tenant_id, tpc.admin_up_port_count ORDER BY tpc.admin_up_port_count DESC, active_network_count DESC;

sql: WITH RankedPortsBySecurityGroup AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), RunningSumStandardAttrIdBySecurityGroup AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT r.port_id, r.tenant_id, r.mac_address, r.security_group_id, r.window_column AS rank_within_security_group_by_port_id, s.window_column AS running_sum_standard_attr_id_within_security_group FROM RankedPortsBySecurityGroup r JOIN RunningSumStandardAttrIdBySecurityGroup s ON s.port_id = r.port_id AND s.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND s.mac_address = r.mac_address;

question: For tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, summarize ports by reporting the number of administratively up ports and the number of DOWN ports, compute the DOWN-to-admin-up port ratio (rounded), and also show the average of the admin-up ports’ windowed average standard attribute ID and the average of the DOWN ports’ running-sum standard attribute ID.
sql: WITH DownPortsBySecurityGroup AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), AdminUpPortsByVifType AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT a.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT a.PORT_ID) AS admin_up_port_count, COUNT(DISTINCT d.port_id) AS down_port_count, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT d.port_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT a.PORT_ID), 0), 2) AS down_to_admin_up_port_ratio, AVG(a.window_column) AS avg_admin_up_window_avg_standard_attr_id, AVG(d.window_column) AS avg_down_window_running_sum_standard_attr_id FROM AdminUpPortsByVifType a LEFT JOIN DownPortsBySecurityGroup d ON d.tenant_id = a.TENANT_ID GROUP BY a.TENANT_ID ORDER BY down_to_admin_up_port_ratio DESC;

question: For the IPv4 subnet with subnet ID in ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48'), return the subnet name, tenant ID, network ID, IP version, CIDR, gateway IP, DHCP enabled flag, allocation pool first and last IPs, the maximum subnet standard attribute ID over the current row and next 2 rows (ordered by subnet ID), and the dense rank of its standard attribute ID ordered by the standard attribute updated-at timestamp over the current row and 2 preceding rows. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH SubnetPoolsAndMaxStdAttrNext2 AS ( SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') ), SubnetStdAttrDenseRankWindow AS ( SELECT s.NAME, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY sa.UPDATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES AS sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') ) SELECT sp.NAME AS subnet_name, sp.TENANT_ID, sp.NETWORK_ID, sp.IP_VERSION, sp.CIDR, sp.GATEWAY_IP, sp.ENABLE_DHCP, sp.FIRST_IP, sp.LAST_IP, sp.max_standard_attr_id_next2, sr.window_column AS dense_rank_by_updated_at_window FROM SubnetPoolsAndMaxStdAttrNext2 sp JOIN SubnetStdAttrDenseRankWindow sr ON sp.NAME = sr.NAME;

question: For tenant ID '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7' and considering only DOWN ports, for each (port status, device owner) combination where the ports are bound to a security group, return the distinct port count and the minimum standard attribute ID, and also include (by matching on port status) the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of port security bindings per port for that same tenant. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH PortStatusOwnerSecurityGroupStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), PortStatusBindingCountDispersion AS ( SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC ) SELECT psosgs.port_status, psosgs.device_owner, psosgs.port_count, psosgs.min_standard_attr_id, psbcd.binding_count_range, psbcd.binding_count_variance, psbcd.binding_count_stddev FROM PortStatusOwnerSecurityGroupStats psosgs JOIN PortStatusBindingCountDispersion psbcd ON psosgs.port_status = psbcd.status ORDER BY psosgs.port_status, psosgs.device_owner;

question: For non-shared networks that are marked as default external networks (IS_DEFAULT = 0), list each such network (network ID, tenant ID, name, status, admin state, MTU, standard attribute ID, and the tenant’s minimum MTU window value) together with port aggregates for ports on those networks: for each port status and device owner, show the number of ports and the earliest standard-attribute updated timestamp (considering only standard attributes with resource type = 'ports'). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DefaultExternalNetworks AS ( SELECT e.NETWORK_ID, e.IS_DEFAULT, n.TENANT_ID, n.NAME, n.STATUS, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP, n.MTU, n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID, MIN(n.MTU) OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.TENANT_ID) AS window_column FROM EXTERNALNETWORKS e JOIN NETWORKS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND n.ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ), PortStatusOwnerAgg AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), PortsOnDefaultExternalNetworks AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.NETWORK_ID, p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner FROM PORTS p WHERE p.NETWORK_ID IN (SELECT NETWORK_ID FROM DefaultExternalNetworks) ) SELECT den.NETWORK_ID, den.IS_DEFAULT, den.TENANT_ID, den.NAME AS network_name, den.STATUS AS network_status, den.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS network_admin_state_up, den.MTU, den.STANDARD_ATTR_ID AS network_standard_attr_id, den.window_column AS tenant_min_mtu, psa.port_status, psa.device_owner, psa.port_count, psa.earliest_standard_attr_update FROM DefaultExternalNetworks den JOIN PortsOnDefaultExternalNetworks pden ON pden.NETWORK_ID = den.NETWORK_ID JOIN PortStatusOwnerAgg psa ON psa.port_status = pden.port_status AND psa.device_owner = pden.device_owner ORDER BY den.TENANT_ID, den.NETWORK_ID, psa.port_status, psa.device_owner;

question: For tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57", for each ACTIVE network, show the network ID and name, admin_state_up, MTU, the network’s standard attribute updated_at timestamp, the row number of the network within the tenant ordered by network name, and also the total number of administratively-up ports on that network (from ports with port security bindings), the number of distinct VIF types among those ports, and the average of the ports’ windowed average standard attribute ID (partitioned by VIF type with a 2-preceding/2-following frame), ordered by networks with the most such ports. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH ActiveTenantNetworks AS ( SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), AdminUpTenantPorts AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), NetworkPortRollup AS ( SELECT atn.tenant_id, atn.network_id, atn.network_name, atn.admin_state_up, atn.mtu, atn.standard_attr_updated_at, atn.window_column AS network_row_number_within_tenant, COUNT(DISTINCT autp.PORT_ID) AS total_admin_up_ports, COUNT(DISTINCT autp.VIF_TYPE) AS distinct_vif_types, AVG(autp.window_column) AS avg_port_window_avg_standard_attr_id FROM ActiveTenantNetworks atn LEFT JOIN AdminUpTenantPorts autp ON autp.NETWORK_ID = atn.network_id AND autp.TENANT_ID = atn.tenant_id GROUP BY atn.tenant_id, atn.network_id, atn.network_name, atn.admin_state_up, atn.mtu, atn.standard_attr_updated_at, atn.window_column ) SELECT tenant_id, network_id, network_name, admin_state_up, mtu, standard_attr_updated_at, network_row_number_within_tenant, total_admin_up_ports, distinct_vif_types, avg_port_window_avg_standard_attr_id FROM NetworkPortRollup ORDER BY total_admin_up_ports DESC, network_name ASC;

question: For tenant_id '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7', for each DOWN port status and device owner (considering only ports bound to a security group, and using the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) computed only from ports that also have both a security group port binding and a port security binding), return the port status, device owner, number of distinct ports, minimum standard attribute ID, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP)—keeping only statuses where the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is greater than 0. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH PortStatusVariation AS ( SELECT p.status, STDDEV(p.standard_attr_id) / NULLIF(AVG(p.standard_attr_id), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM securitygroupportbindings AS sgpb JOIN ports AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN portsecuritybindings AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(p.standard_attr_id) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), PortStatusDeviceOwnerStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ) SELECT psds.port_status, psds.device_owner, psds.port_count, psds.min_standard_attr_id, psv.coefficient_of_variation FROM PortStatusDeviceOwnerStats psds JOIN PortStatusVariation psv ON psv.status = psds.port_status WHERE psv.coefficient_of_variation > 0 ORDER BY psv.coefficient_of_variation DESC, psds.port_count DESC;

question: For ACTIVE (non-shared) networks, list each network’s name, status, and admin_state_up along with its RBAC action, target tenant, and dense-rank-by-network-ID window column, and also include the overall average, range (max minus min), and variance of subnet IP version for RBAC entries with the action set to 'access_as_shared' (considering only IP versions 4 and 6). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH rbac_ip_version_stats AS ( SELECT n.ACTION AS rbac_action, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, MAX(s.IP_VERSION) - MIN(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_range, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION IN (4, 6) AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_range DESC ), active_network_rbac_details AS ( SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM networksecuritybindings b JOIN networks n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN networkrbacs r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) ) SELECT d.name, d.status, d.admin_state_up, d.action, d.target_tenant, d.window_column, s.rbac_action, s.avg_ip_version, s.ip_version_range, s.ip_version_variance FROM active_network_rbac_details d CROSS JOIN rbac_ip_version_stats s WHERE s.rbac_action = 'access_as_shared';

question: For tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57', show the tenant ID, the number of admin-up ports that are bound to a security group, the average number of security-group bindings per such port, the total number of DNS records on those admin-up ports, the number of DOWN ports that are bound to a security group, and the average running sum of standard attribute IDs within each security group for those DOWN ports. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH PortSecurityAndDnsCounts AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN PORTDNSES pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name ), DownPortsWindowedAttrSum AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT psc.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT psc.port_id) AS admin_up_bound_port_count, AVG(psc.security_group_binding_count) AS avg_security_group_bindings_per_admin_up_port, SUM(psc.dns_record_count) AS total_dns_records_on_admin_up_ports, COUNT(DISTINCT dpa.port_id) AS down_bound_port_count, AVG(dpa.window_column) AS avg_running_sum_standard_attr_id_within_security_group_for_down_ports FROM PortSecurityAndDnsCounts psc JOIN DownPortsWindowedAttrSum dpa ON psc.tenant_id = dpa.tenant_id WHERE psc.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY psc.tenant_id ORDER BY admin_up_bound_port_count DESC;

question: For each port status that appears among administratively up ports (that have at least one port security binding) for tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, show the status, the range/variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of port security binding counts per port (computed for tenant ID `17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7`), the number of such admin-up ports, and the average of the per-port windowed average standard attribute ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH PortStatusBindingStats AS ( SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC ), AdminUpPortWindowDetails AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT aupwd.STATUS, psbs.binding_count_range, psbs.binding_count_variance, psbs.binding_count_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT aupwd.PORT_ID) AS admin_up_ports_with_security_bindings, AVG(aupwd.window_column) AS avg_window_standard_attr_id FROM AdminUpPortWindowDetails aupwd JOIN PortStatusBindingStats psbs ON aupwd.STATUS = psbs.status GROUP BY aupwd.STATUS, psbs.binding_count_range, psbs.binding_count_variance, psbs.binding_count_stddev ORDER BY admin_up_ports_with_security_bindings DESC;

question: For tenant ID `17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7` on network ID `0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d`, summarize how many administratively UP ports have port security bindings, the total number of port security bindings and total enabled counts across those bindings, the number of distinct security groups attached to DOWN ports on that network, and the enabled-per-security-group ratio (enabled total divided by distinct security groups) rounded to 2 decimals.
sql: WITH PortSecurityAgg AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(psb.port_id) AS binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN psb.port_security_enabled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS port_security_enabled_total FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address), DownPortsSecurityGroups AS (SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER ( ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d')) SELECT psa.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT psa.port_id) AS admin_up_ports_with_security_bindings, SUM(psa.binding_count) AS total_port_security_bindings, SUM(psa.port_security_enabled_total) AS total_port_security_enabled_across_bindings, COUNT(DISTINCT dpsg.SECURITY_GROUP_ID) AS distinct_security_groups_on_down_ports_in_network, ROUND( SUM(psa.port_security_enabled_total) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT dpsg.SECURITY_GROUP_ID), 0), 2 ) AS enabled_per_security_group_ratio FROM PortSecurityAgg psa JOIN PORTS p ON p.ID = psa.port_id JOIN DownPortsSecurityGroups dpsg ON dpsg.NETWORK_ID = p.NETWORK_ID WHERE p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') AND psa.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY psa.tenant_id ORDER BY enabled_per_security_group_ratio DESC;

question: For each combination of port status and device owner, list the status, the device owner, the number of distinct DOWN ports (bound to a security group) and the minimum standard attribute ID for tenant `17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7`, along with the VIF type, the number of administratively-up ports, and the average (by VIF type) of the 2-preceding/2-following windowed average standard attribute ID for tenant `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, matching rows by the same status and device owner. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH PortStatusOwnerStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), AdminUpPortWindowStats AS ( SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ) SELECT psos.port_status, psos.device_owner, psos.port_count, psos.min_standard_attr_id, aupws.VIF_TYPE, COUNT(DISTINCT aupws.PORT_ID) AS admin_up_ports, AVG(aupws.window_column) AS avg_window_standard_attr_id FROM PortStatusOwnerStats psos JOIN AdminUpPortWindowStats aupws ON psos.port_status = aupws.STATUS AND psos.device_owner = aupws.DEVICE_OWNER GROUP BY psos.port_status, psos.device_owner, psos.port_count, psos.min_standard_attr_id, aupws.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY psos.port_count DESC;

sql: WITH PortSecurityGroupStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), OvsBindingPortStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' AND p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS ) SELECT psgs.port_status, psgs.device_owner, psgs.port_count, psgs.min_standard_attr_id, obs.min_admin_state_up, obs.avg_standard_attr_id FROM PortSecurityGroupStats psgs JOIN OvsBindingPortStats obs ON psgs.port_status = obs.STATUS;

sql: WITH PortSecurityAgg AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(psb.port_id) AS binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN psb.port_security_enabled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS port_security_enabled_total FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ), DownPortsWindow AS ( SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(sa.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY sa.RESOURCE_TYPE ORDER BY sa.ID) AS window_column FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') ) SELECT psa.port_id, psa.tenant_id, psa.mac_address, psa.binding_count, psa.port_security_enabled_total, dpw.window_column FROM PortSecurityAgg psa JOIN DownPortsWindow dpw ON psa.port_id = dpw.port_id AND psa.tenant_id = dpw.tenant_id AND psa.mac_address = dpw.mac_address;

question: For tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57', for each security group that has ports in DOWN status, list the security group ID, the number of distinct DOWN ports in that security group, the maximum number of security-group bindings among the tenant’s admin_state_up = 1 ports in that group, the total DNS record count across those admin_state_up ports, and the DNS-records-per-max-binding ratio rounded to 2 decimals.
sql: WITH DownPortsBySecurityGroup AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), AdminUpPortBindingAndDnsCounts AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS sgpb JOIN PORTS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN PORTDNSES pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name ) SELECT dpsg.security_group_id, COUNT(DISTINCT dpsg.port_id) AS down_port_count, MAX(au.security_group_binding_count) AS max_security_group_binding_count_among_admin_up_ports, SUM(au.dns_record_count) AS total_dns_record_count_for_admin_up_ports, ROUND( SUM(au.dns_record_count) / NULLIF(MAX(au.security_group_binding_count), 0), 2 ) AS dns_records_per_max_binding_ratio FROM DownPortsBySecurityGroup dpsg JOIN AdminUpPortBindingAndDnsCounts au ON au.port_id = dpsg.port_id AND au.tenant_id = dpsg.tenant_id WHERE dpsg.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY dpsg.security_group_id ORDER BY dns_records_per_max_binding_ratio DESC;

question: For administratively up ports belonging to tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57` that have IP allocations, return each port’s ID, tenant ID, network ID, MAC address, host, VIF type, VNIC type, status, device owner, the windowed average standard attribute ID (2 preceding to 2 following within each VIF type), and the port’s IP allocation and subnet-id row counts—restricted to ports whose IP allocation count is greater than the tenant’s average IP allocation count. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH PortIPStats AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address), PortBindingWindow AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), TenantAvgIPAlloc AS ( SELECT p.tenant_id, AVG(ips.ip_allocation_count) AS avg_ip_allocation_count FROM ports p JOIN PortIPStats ips ON ips.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.tenant_id ) SELECT pbw.PORT_ID, pbw.TENANT_ID, pbw.NETWORK_ID, pbw.MAC_ADDRESS, pbw.HOST, pbw.VIF_TYPE, pbw.VNIC_TYPE, pbw.STATUS, pbw.DEVICE_OWNER, pbw.window_column, pis.ip_allocation_count, pis.subnet_id_rows FROM PortBindingWindow pbw JOIN PortIPStats pis ON pis.port_id = pbw.PORT_ID JOIN TenantAvgIPAlloc ta ON ta.tenant_id = pbw.TENANT_ID WHERE pis.ip_allocation_count > ta.avg_ip_allocation_count;

question: For tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57', which security groups have a ratio greater than 75% of (ports that are administratively up and have at least one IP allocation) compared to (ports that are DOWN and bound to that security group)? Return the security group ID, the number of DOWN ports in the group, and the number of admin-up ports with IP allocations used in the ratio. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DownPortsBySecurityGroup AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') ), AdminUpPortsWithIPAllocations AS ( SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM ports p JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND ia.ip_address IS NOT NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address ) SELECT dpsg.security_group_id, COUNT(DISTINCT dpsg.port_id) AS down_port_count, COUNT(DISTINCT aup.port_id) AS admin_up_port_with_ip_count FROM DownPortsBySecurityGroup dpsg LEFT JOIN AdminUpPortsWithIPAllocations aup ON aup.tenant_id = dpsg.tenant_id GROUP BY dpsg.security_group_id HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT aup.port_id) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT dpsg.port_id), 0)) > 0.75;

sql: WITH PortStatusOwnerStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), PortStatusBindingStats AS ( SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC ), CombinedPortStatusStats AS ( SELECT pso.port_status, pso.device_owner, pso.port_count, pso.earliest_standard_attr_update, pbs.binding_count_range, pbs.binding_count_variance, pbs.binding_count_stddev FROM PortStatusOwnerStats pso JOIN PortStatusBindingStats pbs ON pso.port_status = pbs.status ) SELECT port_status, device_owner, port_count, earliest_standard_attr_update, binding_count_range, binding_count_variance, binding_count_stddev FROM CombinedPortStatusStats ORDER BY port_status, device_owner;

sql: WITH PortStatusVariation AS ( SELECT p.status, STDDEV(p.standard_attr_id) / NULLIF(AVG(p.standard_attr_id), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM securitygroupportbindings AS sgpb JOIN ports AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN portsecuritybindings AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(p.standard_attr_id) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), PortStatusDeviceOwnerStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ) SELECT psdos.port_status, psdos.device_owner, psdos.port_count, psdos.min_standard_attr_id, psv.coefficient_of_variation, ROUND(psdos.min_standard_attr_id / NULLIF(psv.coefficient_of_variation, 0), 2) AS min_attr_id_per_variation FROM PortStatusDeviceOwnerStats psdos JOIN PortStatusVariation psv ON psdos.port_status = psv.status ORDER BY min_attr_id_per_variation DESC;

sql: WITH SubnetDNSOrderVariation AS ( SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, STDDEV(d.order) / NULLIF(AVG(d.order), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM subnets AS s JOIN dnsnameservers AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN ipallocationpools AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id JOIN networks AS n ON n.id = s.network_id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 AND n.id NOT IN ( SELECT r.object_id FROM networkrbacs AS r WHERE r.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (r.target_tenant = '*' OR r.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY s.name HAVING AVG(d.order) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), SharedSubnetWindowedAttrs AS ( SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, n.TARGET_TENANT AS rbac_target_tenant, SUM(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.IP_VERSION ORDER BY s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN NETWORKRBACS AS n ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b') ) SELECT sswa.subnet_name, sswa.subnet_cidr, sswa.rbac_target_tenant, sswa.window_column, sdo.coefficient_of_variation FROM SharedSubnetWindowedAttrs sswa JOIN SubnetDNSOrderVariation sdo ON sswa.subnet_name = sdo.subnet_name WHERE sdo.coefficient_of_variation > 0 ORDER BY sdo.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

sql: WITH PortStatusVariation AS ( SELECT p.status, STDDEV(p.standard_attr_id) / NULLIF(AVG(p.standard_attr_id), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM securitygroupportbindings AS sgpb JOIN ports AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN portsecuritybindings AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(p.standard_attr_id) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), PortStatusDeviceOwnerStats AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ) SELECT psd.port_status, psd.device_owner, psd.port_count, psd.min_standard_attr_id, psv.coefficient_of_variation FROM PortStatusDeviceOwnerStats psd JOIN PortStatusVariation psv ON psd.port_status = psv.status ORDER BY psd.port_count DESC, psv.coefficient_of_variation DESC;

sql: WITH RbacSharedIpVersionStats AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ), RbacDhcpNonSharedStddev AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 AND s.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.ACTION HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY ip_version_stddev DESC ) SELECT rs.ACTION, rs.avg_ip_version, rs.ip_version_variance, rs.ip_version_stddev AS shared_ip_version_stddev, rd.ip_version_stddev AS dhcp_nonshared_ip_version_stddev FROM RbacSharedIpVersionStats rs JOIN RbacDhcpNonSharedStddev rd ON rs.ACTION = rd.ACTION;
