sql: WITH SecurityGroupBoundPorts AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER), OvsBoundPorts AS (SELECT p.STATUS, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN ML2_PORT_BINDINGS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' AND p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS), CombinedPortStatusMetrics AS ( SELECT sg.port_status AS status, sg.device_owner AS device_owner, sg.port_count AS port_count, sg.min_standard_attr_id AS min_standard_attr_id, NULL AS min_admin_state_up, NULL AS avg_standard_attr_id, 'Security Group Bound Ports' AS reason FROM SecurityGroupBoundPorts sg UNION ALL SELECT ov.STATUS AS status, NULL AS device_owner, NULL AS port_count, NULL AS min_standard_attr_id, ov.min_admin_state_up AS min_admin_state_up, ov.avg_standard_attr_id AS avg_standard_attr_id, 'OVS VIF Bound Ports' AS reason FROM OvsBoundPorts ov ) SELECT * FROM CombinedPortStatusMetrics ORDER BY status, device_owner, reason;

question: For the subnet with ID `012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48`, considering only subnet routes whose next hop is `10.30.19.197/8`, what are (1) the range and variance of allocation-pool starting IPs (FIRST_IP) for each subnet name, and (2) the dense-rank (using a window of the current row and 2 preceding rows) of its associated standard attribute when ordered by the standard attribute’s UPDATED_AT timestamp? sql: WITH first_ip_stats AS ( SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(p.FIRST_IP) - MIN(p.FIRST_IP) AS first_ip_range, VARIANCE(p.FIRST_IP) AS first_ip_variance FROM SUBNETROUTES r JOIN SUBNETS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE r.NEXTHOP = '10.30.19.197/8' AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY first_ip_range DESC ), subnet_attr_dense_rank AS ( SELECT s.NAME, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY sa.UPDATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES AS sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') ) SELECT fis.subnet_name, fis.first_ip_range, fis.first_ip_variance, sadr.window_column FROM first_ip_stats fis JOIN subnet_attr_dense_rank sadr ON sadr.NAME = fis.subnet_name;

For IPv4 subnets whose subnet ID is `012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48`, list the subnet name and the dense rank of its associated standard attribute ID when ordered by the standard attribute’s updated-at timestamp, using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows.
sub_sqls: SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(p.FIRST_IP) - MIN(p.FIRST_IP) AS first_ip_range, VARIANCE(p.FIRST_IP) AS first_ip_variance FROM SUBNETROUTES r JOIN SUBNETS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE r.NEXTHOP = '10.30.19.197/8' AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY first_ip_range DESC;

question: For tenant ID "98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57", list all administratively-up ports that are on ACTIVE networks owned by the same tenant. Return the network ID and name, network admin_state_up, MTU, and the network standard attribute updated_at timestamp (with a row number per tenant ordered by network name), along with each matching port’s ID, host, VIF type, VNIC type, MAC address, status, device owner, and the VIF-type windowed average of the port standard attribute ID (2 preceding to 2 following rows). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH ActiveTenantNetworks AS (SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM NETWORKS n JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), AdminUpTenantPorts AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')) SELECT n.network_id, n.network_name, n.tenant_id, n.admin_state_up AS network_admin_state_up, n.mtu, n.standard_attr_updated_at AS network_standard_attr_updated_at, n.window_column AS network_row_number_within_tenant, p.PORT_ID AS port_id, p.HOST AS port_host, p.VIF_TYPE AS port_vif_type, p.VNIC_TYPE AS port_vnic_type, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS port_mac_address, p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS port_device_owner, p.window_column AS port_avg_standard_attr_id_window FROM ActiveTenantNetworks n JOIN AdminUpTenantPorts p ON p.NETWORK_ID = n.network_id AND p.TENANT_ID = n.tenant_id ORDER BY n.network_name, p.PORT_ID;

question: For tenant ID '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7' and ports with status 'DOWN', for each device owner return the distinct port count and minimum standard attribute ID (only for ports bound to a security group), along with the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of port security bindings per port for that same port status. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH port_status_device_owner_summary AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), port_status_binding_stats AS ( SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM ports AS p JOIN ( SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM ports AS p2 JOIN portsecuritybindings AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id ) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC ) SELECT psdo.port_status, psdo.device_owner, psdo.port_count, psdo.min_standard_attr_id, psbs.binding_count_range, psbs.binding_count_variance, psbs.binding_count_stddev FROM port_status_device_owner_summary psdo JOIN port_status_binding_stats psbs ON psdo.port_status = psbs.status;

question: For each port status and device owner, considering only ports whose standard attribute resource type is 'ports' and excluding shared networks (networks whose IDs appear in networkrbacs with action = 'access_as_shared' and target_tenant = '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), list the port count and the earliest standard attribute updated timestamp, and also include (by port status) the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of allocated IP address string lengths for ports with port security enabled restricted to IP address '10.150.64.113/8'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH PortCountsAndEarliestUpdate AS ( SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM PORTS p JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND p.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER ), PortStatusIpLengthVariation AS ( SELECT p.status, STDDEV(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) / NULLIF(AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM portsecuritybindings psb JOIN ports p ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations ia ON p.id = ia.port_id WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1 AND ia.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8') GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), CombinedPortStatusMetrics AS ( SELECT pc.port_status AS port_status, pc.device_owner AS device_owner, pc.port_count AS port_count, pc.earliest_standard_attr_update AS earliest_standard_attr_update, pv.coefficient_of_variation AS coefficient_of_variation FROM PortCountsAndEarliestUpdate pc JOIN PortStatusIpLengthVariation pv ON pv.status = pc.port_status ) SELECT port_status, device_owner, port_count, earliest_standard_attr_update, coefficient_of_variation FROM CombinedPortStatusMetrics ORDER BY port_status, device_owner;

question: For each RBAC action that (a) has more than 5 matching DHCP-enabled subnets on its referenced networks and (b) excludes subnets on networks that are shared via an `access_as_shared` RBAC entry with target tenant `'*'` or `'9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'`, show the action name along with the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP version numbers; additionally, for the same action, show the variance of subnet IP version numbers considering only public `access_as_shared` RBAC entries (where `target_tenant = '*'`). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH SubnetIpStddevByAction AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.ENABLE_DHCP = 1 AND s.NETWORK_ID NOT IN ( SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b') ) GROUP BY n.ACTION HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY ip_version_stddev DESC ), SubnetIpVarianceForPublicShared AS ( SELECT n.ACTION, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT = '*' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC ) SELECT s1.ACTION, s1.ip_version_stddev, s2.ip_version_variance FROM SubnetIpStddevByAction s1 JOIN SubnetIpVarianceForPublicShared s2 ON s1.ACTION = s2.ACTION ORDER BY s1.ip_version_stddev DESC;

sql: WITH subnet_details AS ( SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER ( ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') ), subnet_routes AS ( SELECT r.DESTINATION, r.NEXTHOP, s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.SUBNET_ID ORDER BY r.SUBNET_ID) AS window_column FROM SUBNETROUTES r JOIN SUBNETS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') ) SELECT sd.NAME, sd.TENANT_ID, sd.NETWORK_ID, sd.IP_VERSION, sd.CIDR, sd.GATEWAY_IP, sd.ENABLE_DHCP, sd.FIRST_IP AS allocation_first_ip, sd.LAST_IP AS allocation_last_ip, sd.max_standard_attr_id_next2, sr.DESTINATION AS route_destination, sr.NEXTHOP AS route_nexthop, sr.window_column AS route_dense_rank_within_subnet FROM subnet_details sd JOIN subnet_routes sr ON sd.NAME = sr.subnet_name AND sd.CIDR = sr.subnet_cidr AND sd.FIRST_IP = sr.FIRST_IP AND sd.LAST_IP = sr.LAST_IP;

question: For the subnet with ID `012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48` (IPv4 only) and considering only routes whose next hop is `10.30.19.197/8`, return the subnet name along with (1) the range and variance of allocation-pool starting IPs (FIRST_IP) across its IP allocation pools and (2) the dense-rank of its associated standard attribute when ordered by the standard attribute UPDATED_AT timestamp using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH AllocationPoolFirstIpStats AS ( SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(p.FIRST_IP) - MIN(p.FIRST_IP) AS first_ip_range, VARIANCE(p.FIRST_IP) AS first_ip_variance FROM SUBNETROUTES r JOIN SUBNETS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONPOOLS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE r.NEXTHOP = '10.30.19.197/8' AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY first_ip_range DESC ), SubnetStandardAttributeWindowRank AS ( SELECT s.NAME, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY sa.UPDATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM SUBNETS AS s JOIN STANDARDATTRIBUTES AS sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') ) SELECT ap.subnet_name, ap.first_ip_range, ap.first_ip_variance, ss.window_column FROM AllocationPoolFirstIpStats ap JOIN SubnetStandardAttributeWindowRank ss ON ap.subnet_name = ss.NAME ORDER BY ap.first_ip_range DESC;

sub_questions: For each subnet name, calculate the range and variance of the allocation pool starting IP addresses (FIRST_IP) across that subnet’s IP allocation pools, considering only routes whose next hop is 10.30.19.197/8 and only subnets with ID 012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48.

For IPv4 subnets whose subnet ID is `012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48`, list the subnet name and the dense rank of its associated standard attribute ID when ordered by the standard attribute’s updated-at timestamp, using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows.
